Yes this was done before but i wanted to see how much better GPT 2 can do it now Use one character reference for a solo warrior, or attach multiple character references to create a full squad. The prompt is built to count every reference image and turn each one into a separate visible character, with no helmets covering their faces. Type your chosen scene into the SCENE SELECTOR at the top, then attach your character reference image or images. Try scenes like: a brutal battlefield charge a gothic starship boarding action a candlelit shrine world cathedral an industrial forge world a grim underhive alley a quiet off-duty barracks scene a solemn prayer before battle Have fun with this one ⚔️🛡️ ............................PROMPT STARTS HERE............................ SCENE SELECTOR: [Type the 40K-inspired scene you want here.] Examples: brutal battlefield charge through smoke, fire, shell craters, and ruined gothic architecture boarding action inside a colossal warship corridor cathedral-like shrine world interior filled with candles, banners, stained glass, and incense haze industrial forge world with sparks, chains, molten metal, pipes, and huge machinery command deck before battle with tactical holograms and vast void windows grim underhive alleyway with pipes, neon grime, metal walkways, and urban decay heroic last stand surrounded by wreckage, fallen enemies, burning vehicles, and drifting ash quiet off-duty scene inside a fortress barracks, armoury, workshop, canteen, or hangar solemn prayer before battle with relics, banners, candles, incense smoke, and sacred war symbols everyday-life scene in a gothic sci-fi military stronghold, training yard, armoury, repair bay, or mess hall Use the typed scene selector as the main scene concept. If no custom scene is typed, choose one of the example scenes that best fits the attached character reference image or images and the overall character vibe. Adapt the environment, action, pose, props, camera, and mood to match the selected scene. Keep the final scene clearly inspired by 40K-style grimdark far-future gothic military sci-fi. STRICT REFERENCE COUNT RULE: Before creating the image, count the number of attached character reference images. Create exactly one main character from each attached character reference image. The number of main characters in the final image must exactly match the number of attached character reference images. If 1 character reference image is attached, create exactly 1 main character. If 2 character reference images are attached, create exactly 2 main characters. If 3 character reference images are attached, create exactly 3 main characters. If 4 character reference images are attached, create exactly 4 main characters. If more character reference images are attached, create exactly that same number of main characters. Each attached character reference image is a separate person. Each attached character reference image must appear once and only once as their own distinct main character. Do not treat any attached character reference image as optional. Do not ignore, drop, replace, combine, or simplify any attached character reference image. MULTI-CHARACTER IDENTITY RULE: Use every attached character reference image as its own separate character identity source. Character 1 must be based only on the first attached character reference image. Character 2 must be based only on the second attached character reference image. Character 3 must be based only on the third attached character reference image. Character 4 must be based only on the fourth attached character reference image. Continue this pattern for any additional attached character reference images. Do not use the first attached character reference image to create multiple characters. Do not duplicate the first character to fill the group. Do not create variations, twins, clones, alternate outfits, mirrored copies, recolours, or slightly edited versions of the same character. Do not merge two or more attached character references into one design. Do not let one character’s face, hairstyle, colours, outfit motifs, body type, species traits, or accessories replace another character’s identity. SINGLE-CHARACTER FALLBACK RULE: If only one character reference image is attached, create one main character only. Do not create a squad, clone group, twin, alternate version, second warrior, companion, or duplicate of the character. The single character should remain the only main subject. THREE-CHARACTER PRIORITY RULE: If three character reference images are attached, this is a three-character squad image. All three referenced characters must appear together in the same scene. All three faces must be visible. All three armour designs must be distinct. All three characters must be clearly separated in the composition. Use a readable left-center-right squad arrangement unless the selected scene needs another clear formation. CHARACTER REFERENCE RULES: Preserve each attached character’s face shape, hairstyle, hair colour, eye colour, expression, body language, signature colour palette, outfit motifs, accessories, silhouette, species traits, proportions, and overall character vibe. The final image must clearly show every attached character as a separate, recognizable individual. Every character must still clearly look like their own attached reference image. Keep each character’s head uncovered with no helmet, full face mask, or visor covering the face. The face, hair, and identity of every referenced character must remain clearly visible. Hard style rule: Use the attached character reference image or images as the visual style reference for the final image. Preserve the visual art style, rendering language, line quality, colour handling, facial stylization, shading style, texture treatment, background treatment, and overall stylization of the attached reference image or images while transforming the character or characters into 40K-inspired power-armoured warriors. If the references are anime, keep them anime. If they are stylized, keep that stylization. Do not turn the final image photorealistic unless specifically requested. Scene concept: Create a 16:9 horizontal widescreen cinematic illustration based on the scene written in the SCENE SELECTOR. Show the attached character or characters transformed into custom 40K-inspired grimdark far-future power-armoured warriors. The image should feel heavy, dramatic, mythic, warlike, and character-driven, with strong atmosphere, clear storytelling, and a powerful sense of scale. Character transformation: Transform every attached reference character into a custom 40K-inspired power-armoured version of themselves while preserving their original identity. The redesign should center on massive stylized power armour with broad shoulder plates, reinforced chest armour, heavy gauntlets, armoured boots, thick mechanical joints, gothic sci-fi military detailing, sacred-warrior ornamentation, battlefield wear, and an oversized futuristic weapon. The armour must feel imposing, brutal, ceremonial, expensive, and engineered for endless war. Keep the head uncovered so each character’s original face, hair, and expression remain visible. Use each attached character’s colours, motifs, accessories, outfit shapes, symbols, materials, personality, and overall vibe as the foundation for their armour redesign. The armour should feel like it belongs in a 40K-inspired universe, but it must be custom-built from the attached character’s own identity. If multiple characters are present, each one must have a distinct armour design based on their own original reference rather than all wearing identical suits. Armour design: Give each character huge futuristic power armour inspired by 40K-style grimdark gothic sci-fi warfare. Include broad pauldrons, a strong chest plate, layered armour segments, mechanical joints, reinforced thighs, heavy boots, thick gauntlets, power cables, vents, seals, relic-like details, engraved plates, purity-scroll-like decorations, battle damage, and character-specific symbols. Adapt each armour design to that character’s original style, colour palette, outfit motifs, accessories, personality, and silhouette. Keep the armour stylized to match the attached reference image or images rather than realistic. Weapon design: Give each character a fitting oversized futuristic weapon inspired by 40K-style grimdark sci-fi warfare. The weapon can be a heavy explosive sci-fi rifle, massive energy weapon, brutal motorized serrated melee weapon, glowing power blade, ceremonial war hammer, plasma-like cannon, heavy pistol, or other far-future battlefield weapon appropriate to their vibe and role. Each character’s weapon should be different and should match that character’s identity, armour design, and role in the scene. If the selected scene is calm, ceremonial, or off-duty, the weapon may be held at rest, slung, holstered, leaned nearby, placed on a table, or carried ceremonially, but it should still be visible. If the selected scene is battle-heavy, make each weapon active, weighty, readable, and integrated into the pose. Scene adaptation rules: If the selected scene is battle-heavy, make the action dynamic but readable, with strong poses, clear silhouettes, environmental destruction, smoke, fire, debris, and a strong sense of momentum. If the selected scene is solemn, sacred, or ceremonial, focus on mood, scale, banners, relics, candles, incense, stained glass, and reverent atmosphere. If the selected scene is indoors, use gothic sci-fi architecture, industrial machinery, cathedral-scale interiors, fortress spaces, armouries, barracks, command rooms, or military infrastructure that fit the selected location. If the selected scene is everyday-life or off-duty, keep the armour and 40K-inspired universe intact, but show the character or characters in a grounded moment such as maintenance, briefing, prayer, conversation, eating, resting, training, repairing gear, or preparing equipment. If multiple characters are present, make their interaction clear and readable, with each one contributing to the scene rather than standing as vague duplicates. Environment and composition: Build the environment around the selected scene. The setting should feel like the kind of place the character or characters naturally belong in once translated into a 40K-inspired grimdark far-future war universe. Use a wide 16:9 horizontal cinematic composition. Keep the main subject or subjects clearly visible, central or compositionally dominant, and easy to read at a glance. If one character is present, give them a strong hero composition with a clear silhouette and dominant visual presence. If multiple characters are present, arrange them so every character remains readable and identifiable with clean silhouette separation. For three attached references, use a clear three-person squad composition with all three faces visible. Use background architecture, smoke, debris, banners, machinery, sparks, haze, relics, gothic shapes, or cathedral-like scale to support the scene without overpowering the characters. Lighting and mood: Use lighting that matches the selected scene. The image should feel grim, cinematic, epic, and immersive, with dramatic contrast and strong atmosphere. Use battlefield firelight, smoky haze, stained-glass glow, cold ship lighting, industrial sparks, moody rim light, incense haze, harsh military illumination, glowing machinery, or distant explosions where appropriate. The mood should feel powerful, warlike, sacred, brutal, and character-specific while still reflecting each original character’s personality. Quality and rendering: Polished, premium-quality stylized illustration with clean linework, crisp rendering, readable forms, powerful armour design, expressive visible faces, strong weapon design, and clear composition. Keep the strongest detail concentrated on the referenced character or characters, their armour, their faces, and their weapons. Maintain strong visual hierarchy and readability. The background should support the characters rather than becoming busier than them. Do not: Do not ignore the SCENE SELECTOR. Do not create more or fewer main characters than the number of attached character reference images. Do not create only two characters if three character reference images are attached. Do not duplicate the first attached character instead of using the second or third reference. Do not merge multiple attached references into fewer characters. Do not make any referenced character a clone, twin, recolour, armour variant, or alternate version of another referenced character. Do not hide, crop, mask, or cover any referenced character’s face. Do not make every character wear the same identical armour if multiple references are provided. Do not make the weapon tiny, modern, toy-like, or visually unimportant. 复制并生图 ↗ 标题 Sourdough Baker Storyboard 提示词 “Create a crisp, clean infographic storyboard poster for THE SOURDOUGH BAKER. Wide 16:9 layout, white background, black borders, bold black typography, premium Pixar 3D stylized rendering, bright warm colors — creamy dough whites, golden crust browns, warm flour dust, rich amber kitchen light, pops of green from herbs on the windowsill. Top header: THE SOURDOUGH BAKER TOTAL VIDEO TIME: 12 SECONDS 8 SHOTS · WARM · SLOW · BAKED WITH LOVE Legend icons: ACTION, HEAT, TIME HINT, INGREDIENT Same Pixar-style young male baker throughout — flour-dusted white apron, warm rustic kitchen, wooden counter, morning light streaming through the window. And one recurring character — a fluffy orange cat who takes the craft extremely seriously and is present in every single panel. 8 panels: Panel 1 — THE OPENER: Wide shot. Baker walks into his kitchen at dawn carrying a large flour bag under one arm. He drops it onto the wooden counter sending a dramatic puff of white flour into the warm morning light — flour cloud catching the golden sunlight beautifully. The orange cat is already sitting on the counter waiting, completely unbothered by the flour cloud, staring directly at the baker. They look at each other. The day begins. You know exactly what's about to happen. Panel 2 — THE MIX: Overhead locked shot. Baker's hands mixing flour, water and sourdough starter together in a large ceramic bowl — shaggy dough forming, the transformation beginning. The orange cat sits at the edge of the counter, head tilted, watching the bowl with complete concentration. Panel 3 — THE KNEAD: The hero comedy panel. Baker steps aside. The orange cat is on the counter, both front paws pressing and kneading the dough exactly like cats do in real life — slow rhythmic biscuit-making motion, eyes half closed in pure contentment. Baker watches from the side with a resigned smile. The cat is completely unbothered and deeply committed to the process. Panel 4 — THE FOLD: Side angle. Baker performs the stretch and fold — pulling the dough up and folding it over itself, the dough becoming smooth and elastic. Close-up on hands and dough. The orange cat watches from beside the bowl, one paw resting on the counter edge, supervising every movement. Panel 5 — THE SCORE: Close-up dramatic shot. Baker holds a razor lame above the risen dough, scoring a deep curved line across the surface — the blade catching the light. The orange cat sits in the background perfectly framed, watching with complete intensity as if this is the most important moment of the day. It is. Panel 6 — THE OVEN: Wide shot. Baker slides the dough inside the cast iron dutch oven, closes the heavy lid, slides it into the glowing oven. The orange cat sits directly in front of the oven door, staring at it, waiting. Will not move. Will never move. Panel 7 — THE REVEAL: The hero frame. Baker lifts the dutch oven lid — an enormous cloud of steam erupts upward, and beneath it the most perfect golden sourdough loaf, deeply scored crust cracked open, caramelized and blistered. The orange cat stands up on its hind legs trying to see over the counter edge, eyes wide, completely losing its composure for the first time. Panel 8 — THE SLICE: Wide warm shot. Baker slices through the loaf — perfect open crumb revealed inside, steam still rising, golden crust crackling. Butter placed on the warm slice, melting instantly. The orange cat sits beside the cutting board, one paw raised toward the bread. Baker looks at the cat. Cat looks at the bread. Baker smiles. Perfect ending. Footer: VIDEO FLOW: 8 shots × ~1.5s = 12 seconds. Flour drop to first slice. CAMERA TIPS: wide on opener with flour cloud, overhead on the mix, wide medium on the knead with cat in full view, side angle on the fold, close-up on the score, wide on the oven with cat guarding, hero wide shot on the steam reveal, warm wide on the final slice LIGHT & STYLE: warm golden morning light, creamy dough whites, deep golden crust.” 分类 模型对比与实验 来源 查看来源 ↗ 标签 GPT Image 2 comparison

Top header: THE PRETZEL MAKER TOTAL VIDEO TIME: 12 SECONDS 8 SHOTS · GOLDEN · TWISTED · STRAIGHT FROM BAVARIA Legend icons: ACTION, HEAT, TIME HINT, INGREDIENT Same Pixar-style middle-aged Bavarian male baker throughout — warm round face, thick blonde mustache, traditional lederhosen with suspenders, white shirt, small charming wooden pretzel stand, string lights overhead, wooden beer barrels nearby, warm daylight, charming German town square or beer garden visible behind him. 8 panels: Panel 1 — THE OPENER: Wide shot. Baker stands behind his wooden pretzel stand, warm daylight flooding the scene, string lights hanging above, traditional German buildings softly visible behind him. He spreads his arms wide and says "Fresh Pretzel!" with a massive proud smile. His world established. You know exactly what's coming. Panel 2 — THE ROPE: Close-up. Both hands rolling a length of soft pale dough into a long even rope on the wooden counter — rolling back and forth with practiced rhythm, the rope stretching longer and thinner with each pass. Panel 3 — THE TWIST: Hero craft frame. Close-up dramatic. Both hands lifting the dough rope and crossing it into the iconic pretzel shape — looping the ends, twisting them together, folding them down onto the body to form the classic pretzel knot. The shaped pretzel dipped into a pot of bubbling baking soda water — briefly submerged, lifted back out glistening and slightly darkened, ready for the oven. The step that gives pretzels their signature deep color and chew. Panel 5 — THE SALT: Close-up dramatic. Coarse white salt crystals scattered generously over the wet pretzel surface — sticking instantly, catching the daylight, vivid white against the pale dough. Panel 6 — THE OVEN: Wide medium with him visible. Baker slides the tray of pretzels into the glowing oven, closes the door. Steps back with a satisfied nod. The wait begins. Panel 7 — THE REVEAL: The hero frame. Oven door opens — pretzels emerging deep golden brown, glossy, perfectly twisted, steam rising. He lifts the tray with both hands, eyes lighting up with pride. The most beautiful pretzels you have ever seen. Panel 8 — THE TEAR: Wide warm shot. Baker tears a warm pretzel apart with both hands — soft warm interior revealed, steam escaping, salt crystals visible on the golden crust. Eyes closing in pure satisfaction. String lights and the warm Bavarian square glowing behind him. Footer: VIDEO FLOW: 8 shots × ~1.5s = 12 seconds. Dough rope to the tear. 复制并生图 ↗ 标题 Chengdu Food Map Illustration 提示词 一张手绘风格的城市美食地图，以成都为主题。画面以鸟瞰视角的手绘简化城市地图为底，标注主要道路和地标但不追求精确比例而是追求可爱的手绘感。地图上分布着 12 个美食地点的精致手绘小插画：春熙路的串串香（一把竹签插着各种食材冒着热气）、宽窄巷子的三大炮（三个糯米团子飞向铜盘）、建设路的蛋烘糕（金黄酥脆正在翻面）、玉林路的火锅（九宫格锅翻滚冒泡）等，每个插画约占地图的 5% 面积，旁边用手写体标注店名和一句推荐语"凌晨两点还在排队的那家"。地图边缘用手绘藤蔓和辣椒装饰形成边框。右下角有一个手绘指南针和图例说明。左上角标题"成都·吃货暴走地图"使用胖圆的手绘美术字配辣椒装饰。整体画风为水彩+彩铅混合的手绘质感，颜色以暖色系（辣椒红、姜黄、翠绿）为主，图片比例 1:1。 分类 海报与插画 来源 查看来源 ↗ 标签 GPT Image 2 poster

gpt image 2生图能力真的恐怖啊，这是我的提示词： 01 前端（用户看到的部分） 是什么：前端就是界面，是用户能看见、能点、能操作的部分。 在哪里：网页、小程序、App 的界面。 用什么做：HTML（结构）、CSS（样式）、JavaScript（交互）。 02 后端（背后处理的部分） 是什么：后端就是幕后大脑，负责逻辑和运算。 在哪里：服务器上，用户看不见。 作用： 处理登录注册 计算价格、推荐商品 接收前端请求、返回数据 常用的编程语言：Java、Python、Go、JavaScript（Node.js） 03 数据库（记忆的部分） 是什么：数据库就是用来存储和管理数据的。 存什么：账号、密码、订单、库存… 常见的数据库： MySQL、PostgreSQL（关系型，像表格一样） MongoDB（文档型，像文件夹一样） 04 SaaS（软件即服务） 是什么：SaaS = Software as a Service（软件即服务）。 核心特点： 打开网页/小程序/APP就能用 按月或按年订阅 常见形式：网站、移动 App、小程序都可以是 SaaS。 05 总结 前端：用户看到和操作的界面 后端：背后运行的逻辑和计算 数据库：存放和管理数据的地方 SaaS：把软件做成服务，用户随时通过网络使用 前端展示 → 后端处理 → 数据库存储 → SaaS 是交付方式 帮我针对上面的内容画一张易于理解的图 分类 UI 与社交媒体 来源 查看来源 ↗ 标签 GPT Image 2 ui

GPT-Image-2的一个妙用形象 这个提示词是一个老哥发我的 我试了下，效果也太强了 如果放在一年前 你可能三天三夜的ComfyUI工作流 才能做出来 提示词： 请根据我上传的人像照片，做一套个人形象分析图卡，包含发型、妆容、色彩和珠宝。要求：保留五官脸型肤色，不要过度修图，所有变化在同一张脸真实展示，风格干净高级。发型：长短、卷直、刘海，对比最适合/ 普通/不建议（显脸小、显老）妆容：眉眼鼻唇分析，标签（自然、提气色、柔和）色彩：不同颜色上身，对比推荐/普通/不适合（显白、显老）珠宝：珍珠、翡翠、红蓝宝、钻石、黄金，对比推荐/普通/不建议 整体：视觉为主，文字简短，4:5比例 分类 UI 与社交媒体 来源 查看来源 ↗ 标签 GPT Image 2 ui

复制并生图 ↗ 标题 12-Panel Storyboard Poster 提示词 A super simple workflow: 2 character images → GPT Image 2.0 storyboard → Seedance 2.0 animation. Just upload two character images and use the prompt below in GPT Image 2.0 to generate a full storyboard on a single page. Prompt: Create a clean, colorful storyboard poster in a 3x4 grid layout with 12 panels on a single page. Title at the top: "[MAIN TITLE]" Each panel must include: a scene number in a small circle, a short scene title, a colorful illustrated image, a 1–2 line description under the image. Main characters must remain visually consistent across all 12 panels: Character 1: [describe main character in detail] Character 2: [describe second character in detail] Theme/story: [overall story theme] Scene breakdown: [Scene title] – [what happens] [Scene title] – [what happens] [Scene title] – [what happens] [Scene title] – [what happens] [Scene title] – [what happens] [Scene title] – [what happens] [Scene title] – [what happens] [Scene title] – [what happens] [Scene title] – [what happens] [Scene title] – [what happens] [Scene title] – [what happens] [Scene title] – [what happens] Design style: cute 3D animated storybook style, warm emotional lighting, bright colors, soft shadows, child-friendly, clean panel borders, readable typography, neat poster composition, high detail. Important: Keep all 12 panels inside one single image. Make the layout clean and balanced. Keep the characters consistent in face, outfit, and colors. Make the text readable and properly placed. No cropped panels. No extra characters unless mentioned. Then upload that storyboard to Seedance 2.0 and use this prompt: Prompt: Generate a scene using the shots in the uploaded film storyboard. No text on screen. That’s it. 分类 UI 与社交媒体 来源 查看来源 ↗ 标签 GPT Image 2 ui

Act as a Social Media Art Director and Digital Collage Artist specializing in bold, youth-oriented brand content for Instagram and digital campaigns. PHASE 1: CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK Create a dynamic digital collage that merges fashion photography with graphic design chaos. This is controlled rebellion – a composition that feels spontaneous and energetic while maintaining brand coherence. The aesthetic is anti-polished: torn edges, layered textures, hand-drawn elements, and bold color blocking that screams confidence and movement. PHASE 2: MODEL & PHOTOGRAPHY - Subject: One model (diverse casting, age 18-30) in a dynamic, confident pose - Pose Energy: 80% attitude, 20% natural – sitting, jumping, mid-motion, or power stance (avoid static standing) - Outfit: Street style/athleisure that aligns with [BRAND NAME] aesthetic – casual but styled - Hero Product: Feature 1 signature [BRAND NAME] product prominently (sneakers, bag, apparel) – this is the visual anchor - Photography Style: Editorial fashion cutout – model extracted from background with clean edges - Camera Angle: Slight low angle to empower subject (hero perspective) - Crop: Full body or 3/4 body showing hero product clearly - Background Removal: Model cut out cleanly for layering over collage elements PHASE 3: COLOR BLOCKING FOUNDATION - Primary Color Blob: Large organic shape (40-60% of composition) in bold, saturated brand color behind/around model - Shape Style: Irregular, hand-painted aesthetic – think Photoshop brush strokes or torn paper texture (NOT perfect geometric shapes) - Color Selection (Autonomous): Choose 1 hero color from [BRAND NAME] palette: - Texture: Visible brush strokes, grain, or subtle noise (15-25% opacity) – avoid flat digital fills - Placement: Blob positioned to frame model without obscuring key product details PHASE 4: GRAPHIC ELEMENTS LAYER Add 3-5 abstract graphic elements scattered across composition: - Element Types: - Color Palette: Use 2-3 accent colors total (main blob color + 1-2 contrasting tones from brand palette) - Placement: Asymmetric scatter – top-left and bottom-right zones primarily (avoid center crowding) - Scale: Mix small (5% of canvas) and medium (15% of canvas) elements – nothing overpowering - Aesthetic: Analog/handmade feel – imperfect circles, rough edges, visible texture PHASE 5: TYPOGRAPHY INTEGRATION - Brand Logo: Clean [BRAND NAME] logo placed in upper-left or upper-right quadrant (10-15% of width) - Slogan/Tagline: If [BRAND NAME] has an iconic slogan, integrate it using: - Supporting Copy: Optional 1-line descriptor (e.g., "A MOMENT OF YOUR STYLE") in smaller uppercase sans-serif - Type Treatment: Mix of aligned and slightly rotated text (2-5° angles) for dynamic energy - Hierarchy: Logo largest → Slogan medium → Copy smallest PHASE 6: TEXTURE & BACKGROUND - Base Layer: Off-white or light gray textured background (NOT pure white) - Texture Options (Autonomous selection): - Color: RGB 245-250 (near-white with warmth) – maintains brightness while adding depth - Treatment: Texture should be felt, not seen – enhances tactility without competing with foreground PHASE 7: COMPOSITION RULES - Layout: Asymmetric balance – model off-center, graphic elements counter-balance - Breathing Room: 15-20% negative space (textured background visible) to prevent claustrophobia - Layering Order: Background texture → Color blob → Graphic elements → Model (cutout) → Typography top layer - Focal Point: Model + hero product = primary focus (60% visual weight), graphics support (40%) - Movement: Diagonal lines and angled elements create directional flow (top-left to bottom-right or vice versa) PHASE 8: BRAND INTELLIGENCE (AUTONOMOUS) Autonomously adapt composition based on [BRAND NAME] personality: - Streetwear/Sportswear (Nike, Adidas, Supreme): - Luxury Streetwear (Balenciaga, Off-White, Gucci): - Beauty/Lifestyle (Glossier, Fenty, Skims): - Tech/Modern (Apple, Tesla, Beats): PHASE 9: SOCIAL MEDIA FOOTER (OPTIONAL) - Bottom Strip: Clean white or light gray bar at bottom 8-10% of frame - Content: Social media handles (Instagram, Facebook, Twitter) in small sans-serif - Layout: Three-column grid with platform icons or text handles - Aesthetic: Minimal and professional – contrast with chaotic collage above TECHNICAL SPECS: - Aspect Ratio: 4:5 (Instagram feed) or 1:1 (square social post) - Resolution: 2400x3000px minimum (high-quality for zoom and detail) - Color Mode: sRGB, vibrant saturation (Instagram-optimized) - File Aesthetic: Digital collage that mimics analog craft (Photoshop + hand-drawn hybrid) - Model Photography: 85mm lens, f/2.8, shallow depth of field on original shoot (before cutout) - Style Reference: Nike social campaigns, Spotify wrapped graphics, Gen Z Instagram aesthetics, Hypebeast x streetwear collabs - Mood: Confident, energetic, youthful, authentic chaos, anti-corporate polish 分类 UI 与社交媒体 来源 查看来源 ↗ 标签 GPT Image 2 ui

Left: massive bold white text "PET WORLD CUP". Right: two outlined boxes "TOTAL VIDEO TIME: 12 SECONDS" and "8 SHOTS · ENSEMBLE · COMEDY · CINEMATIC". == ICON LEGEND == Four icon+label pairs in a row: soccer ball + "BALL ACTION"; paw + "DUEL"; hamster + "MIGHTY MINI"; trophy + "VICTORY". == MAIN GRID (8 panels, 2×4) == Each panel: thin white border, landscape 16:9. Number badge (1-8) top-left, teal "~1.5s" tag top-right, photorealistic still inside, bottom caption bar with icon + ALL-CAPS text. 1. [ball] "PET WORLD CUP FINAL KICKS OFF" — Wide stadium at golden hour. Midfield: orange tabby cat (red jersey) + golden retriever (blue jersey) facing off, ball between them. Deep background: enormous white goalposts with tiny hamster goalkeeper between them. Side: white rabbits in stands with pom-poms. Sunset cinematic light. 2. [paw] "RABBIT CHEERLEADERS BRING THE NOISE" — Close on stands: 3 fluffy white rabbits in tiny jerseys, mouths open cheering, paws shaking red and blue pom-poms in unison. Stadium lights, blurred crowd silhouettes behind. 3. [paw] "CAT VS DOG MIDFIELD DUEL" — Close-up: cat (red jersey) and dog (blue jersey) facing off, ball between their paws. Intense eye contact. Dirt kicking up. Whiskers and ear fluff in motion. 4. [ball] "DOG STEALS, BREAKS AWAY" — Dog with ball at paws charging through midfield. Cat sprinting behind, paws stretched, ears back. 5. [ball] "DOG WINDS UP — SHOT INCOMING" — Dog in classic kick pose, back leg lifted high, eyes locked on distant goal. Deep background: enormous white goalposts with TINY hamster goalkeeper barely visible — dramatic scale contrast. 6. [hamster] "HAMSTER VS THE GIANT GOAL" — Low angle close-up: enormous white goalposts towering over tiny golden Syrian hamster wearing mini yellow goalie gloves. Looking up determined, paws raised ready. Ball flying in from frame edge. 7. [hamster] "EPIC SAVE — TINY BUT MIGHTY" — Hamster in full sprawl leap, paws extended, blocking ball with tiny body. Mid-air freeze frame. Confetti falling, blurred crowd silhouettes raising arms. 8. [trophy] "HAMSTER HERO — TEAMS UNITE" — Wide final shot at golden hour: cat (red) and dog (blue) standing side by side staring in awe at tiny hamster holding up small golden trophy. White rabbits in stands raise pom-poms wildly. Confetti, golden sparkles. == BOTTOM INFOGRAPHIC (4 sections horizontal) == [Clock] VIDEO FLOW: "8 shots × ~1.5s = 12s. Stadium → rabbit fans → cat-vs-dog rivalry → dog shoots → hamster saves → ensemble celebration." [Camera] CAMERA TIPS: "Wide establishing on stadium, close-up on rabbits, low-angle on midfield duel, side-tracking on breakaway, scale frame on hamster vs goalposts, hero shot on save, wide on celebration." [Sun] LIGHT & STYLE: "Photorealistic cinematic. Golden-hour stadium light throughout. Warm amber grass, lens flares, real DSLR/iPhone aesthetic. Crisp action focus." [Person] CHARACTER NOTES: "Cast: orange tabby cat with M-mark (red jersey), golden retriever (blue jersey), golden Syrian hamster with mini yellow goalie gloves (yellow kit), 3-4 white fluffy rabbits with pom-poms. Hamster MUST appear dramatically tiny vs goalposts. All humans/crowd are faceless silhouettes — no faces. Each animal identical across panels." == STRICT EXCLUSIONS == No real soccer team logos, no FIFA/Champions League/UEFA/World Cup branding, no real player faces, no sponsor logos, no national flags, no jersey numbers, no stadium signage with real text, no captions, no watermarks. Plain colored jerseys only. All 8 panels photorealistic — never cartoon/3D/illustration. All animals identical across panels. 分类 UI 与社交媒体 来源 暂无来源 标签 GPT Image 2 ui

You are a Senior 3D Product Visualization Artist and Cinematic Art Director specializing in luxury brand key visuals for high-end editorial and streetwear campaigns. PHASE 1: LOGO SUBJECT Identify the official logo/logotype of [BRAND NAME]. Render it with maximum fidelity to the original silhouette, proportions, and geometry — no distortion, no stylization. Extrude the logo into a solid 3D object with depth approximately 15–20% of its height. Coat all surfaces — front face, side extrusion, beveled edges — in hyper-polished liquid chrome (reflectance 0.98, near-perfect mirror). Apply full ray-traced environment reflections so the logo mirrors the surrounding sky gradient, flower field, and light sources. Moderate bevel radius on all hard edges to catch sharp specular highlights. Add Subsurface Scattering on thin structural parts (fine lines, serifs, icon details) for a subtle inner glow. Place 4–8 prismatic 4-point star lens-flare sparkles at highest specular peaks — corners, tips, curved peaks. Organic distribution, not uniform. Zero matte surfaces. Zero plastic look. The entire logo must read as cast from liquid silver. PHASE 2: ENVIRONMENT & BACKGROUND Background: wide cinematic landscape at golden-lilac hour (just after sunset). Dense flower field fills the lower third — lavender and white wildflowers with realistic micro-texture and subtle wind motion-blur on far clusters. Middle ground fades to soft purple-grey bokeh. Sky gradient: warm blush rose ( at horizon through lilac ( to cool powder blue ( at top. Add 3–5 silhouetted bird clusters in upper quadrants. Volumetric atmospheric haze on the horizon. Shift the environment's color palette to reflect [BRAND NAME]'s iconic brand identity — introduce the brand's signature hue as a tonal wash in the sky gradient or dominant flower color. The environment must feel art-directed specifically for this brand. PHASE 3: COMPOSITION & LAYOUT Format: 1:1 square. Chrome logo centered horizontally at vertical midpoint, monumental scale spanning 65–80% of frame width. Subtle 2–4 degree forced perspective tilt for dynamic energy without distorting logo recognition. Bottom edge of the logo grazes or slightly overlaps the top of the flower field, integrating the 3D object naturally. Logo casts a soft diffused shadow into the flowers. Lower-left corner: 2–3 lines of micro-copy in clean white sans-serif at minimal optical size — a poetic 3-line brand statement relevant to [BRAND NAME]'s heritage and aesthetic. Bottom-left: "[BRAND NAME]" in small caps logotype label. Bottom-right: a secondary flat 2D chrome version of the same logo as a finishing mark. PHASE 4: LIGHTING Primary: large soft area light from upper-left simulating post-sunset overcast sky — fully diffused, no hard shadows, 5800K with lilac tint overlay. Secondary: warm 3200K rim light grazing bottom and side edges from behind — golden separation halo between object and field. Global Illumination enabled — chrome logo realistically bounces and absorbs landscape ambient color. The field's purple tones should be faintly visible in the lower reflective surfaces. Volumetric god rays faintly visible through any logo negative space or cutouts. TECH SPECS Octane Render aesthetic. Ray Tracing: 16+ bounces. Depth of Field: f/11 equivalent — full logo sharp, far background in soft bokeh only. Tone mapping: lifted blacks, compressed highlights, filmic S-curve. Color grade: desaturated midtones, preserved pastels, cool shadow tones. Film grain: subtle (ISO 200 equivalent). Chromatic Aberration: 0.2–0.3px on peripheral logo edges only. Anti-aliasing: maximum. No AI-plastic normals. No smooth uniform shading. Microscopic surface imperfections on chrome required — micro-scratches, 0.5% roughness noise map. Mood: luxury brand retrospective editorial for Highsnobiety or AnOther Magazine. 分类 UI 与社交媒体 来源 暂无来源 标签 GPT Image 2 ui

[Global Setting] A traditional kung fu temple courtyard at golden hour, stone walls with calligraphy, bamboo stalks, red lanterns, peaceful serene setting. 3D stylized anime aesthetic rounded appealing characters, exaggerated expressive proportions, big sparkly eyes, comedic action animation style. [Character 1 Boy] Age 8-10, spiky orange anime hair, oversized white kung fu gi (too big, sleeves falling), headband tied crooked, determined serious face (but trying too hard), energetic stance. Self-proclaimed "kung fu master." [Character 2 Girl] Age 8-10, long pink pigtails with ribbons, matching small pink kung fu gi, headband perfectly placed, skeptical expression, hands on hips. Actual skills. [Opening, 0–4s] Wide shot of temple courtyard. Boy in dramatic kung fu stance, shouting: "I am the LEGENDARY MASTER OF WIND STRIKE!" Girl sighs: "You just learned this yesterday." Boy points at her: "PREPARE YOURSELF!" Girl cracks knuckles: "This will be quick." [Comedic Battle Phase 1, 4–12s] Boy throws slow-motion dramatic punch, sleeves flapping everywhere covering his face. Girl easily sidesteps: "You're punching air." Boy recovers, attempts spinning kick, rotates too far, stumbles: "I meant to do a double spin!" Girl does perfect precise kick, boy flies backward into pile of hay dramatically. Boy pops up: "I let you win!" Girl: "Sure you did." Boy attempts ancient "secret technique" — just wiggles his fingers mysteriously. Girl stares: "That's not kung fu, that's jazz hands." Boy gasps: "It's ANCIENT MAGIC!" Girl: "It's ridiculous." [Epic Slow-Motion Moment, 12–18s] Boy charges with warrior cry: "AIIYAHHH!" Camera enters slow-motion at 40% speed. Boy's movement is perfectly exaggerated face scrunched up with effort, sleeves billowing dramatically, hair defying gravity. Girl prepares to counter, eyes calm and focused, background blurs. As boy gets close, girl executes perfect counter-strike in slow-mo, boy flies backward in slow-motion arc, expression shocked, leaves and dust particles suspend around him beautifully. Return to normal speed. [Comedic Recovery, 18–24s] Boy lands hard, dazed stars circling his head (anime style). Girl helps him up: "You okay?" Boy jumps up: "YES! Again!" Attempts helicopter kick, spins out of control, dizzy, crashes into lantern (doesn't break, just wobbles). Girl just shakes her head laughing. Boy: "That lantern was STRONG." Girl: "The lantern is fine. YOU'RE the problem." [Final Stand, 24–30s] They face each other one last time, both in dramatic kung fu poses. Golden light catching both their faces. Boy: "This time I'll definitely win!" Girl smiles: "No you won't." They charge at each other, both doing exaggerated kicks, meet mid-air in freeze-frame, both suspended in mid-kick looking equally confused. Girl: "Um, now what?" Boy: "I don't know!" They both tumble down laughing, rolling in grass, sunshine warm and golden. End on them lying in courtyard laughing, friendship and silliness, genuine joy. [CONSISTENCY] Same two anime children, boy (orange hair, oversized gi), girl (pink pigtails, fitted gi). Traditional temple courtyard, golden hour lighting throughout. Exaggerated anime kung fu moves mixed with genuine combat skills. Boy is goofy and enthusiastic, girl is competent and amused. Physical comedy with respect. Audio: Serene temple ambience, birds, wind through bamboo, boy's dramatic shouting "AIIYAHHH!", girl's sarcastic comments, footsteps and movement sounds, exaggerated punch and kick whoosh sounds, comedic impacts (soft, not violent), slow-motion section: all sounds deepen and stretch (warrior cry becomes deep tone, movement becomes whooshing), lantern wobbling (bong sound), both kids laughing, wind chimes from temple, bright anime action music building, soft nostalgic strings on final friendship moment, kids' genuine laughter.

Sitting alone beside the window is an older version of herself, approximately 10 years older—same recognizable facial features, but more mature, peaceful and confident. The younger woman freezes. They silently stare at each other. The older version smiles warmly and slides a small notebook across the table. No dialogue. 17–23 SEC — THE NOTEBOOK She opens it. Rapid cinematic flashes reveal pages containing glimpses of her possible future: her launching her own business, travelling through breathtaking countries, helping her parents, laughing with family, standing confidently on a stage, and finally living peacefully. Then she reaches the final page. It is completely blank except for: “START TODAY.” 23–27 SEC — THE TWIST She looks up— The chair opposite her is suddenly empty. Only a steaming cup of coffee remains. She realizes she may have just met her future self. Her expression changes from confusion to determination. 27–30 SEC — FINAL SHOT Cut to sunrise. She walks confidently through the city carrying the notebook against her chest. Camera slowly pulls upward into a spectacular wide cinematic shot as sunlight breaks between the buildings. Final text appears: “Your future is waiting. But you have to become her.” STYLE: extraordinary cinematic realism, emotional storytelling, premium Netflix-style short film, photorealistic skin, realistic acting, subtle facial emotions, dramatic reflections, volumetric morning sunlight, shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens look, elegant wardrobe, seamless transitions, atmospheric sound design, realistic city environment, consistent character identity, 4K, 24fps, 16:9, no facial distortion, no duplicated people, no unnatural movement.

最上方：白色文件夹，标签"home" - 第二个：黑色圆点纹文件夹，标签"Date" - 第三个：黄色便签纸，标签"Beach" - 第四个：粉色便签纸，标签"Party" 画面中另有一个白色像素风鼠标箭头（Windows 经典指针样式），全程在画面上移动、悬停、点击。 每次点击文件夹时，画面下半部弹出一个复古 Mac OS 风格的小窗口（灰白标题栏写着"Note Pad"，带关闭/缩放按钮和滚动条），窗口内显示该套穿搭的白底平铺图（衣服、鞋子、包包整齐摆放）。 —————— [00:00-00:02] 待机：居家状态 主角穿浅灰色居家套装（宽松短袖上衣+同色短裤）、白色人字拖，右手举着一个粉紫色马克杯，左手自然垂在身侧微微张开，站在沙发前。表情放松、眼神平视镜头，偶尔轻轻晃动。鼠标箭头在画面下方空白处缓慢移动，像在犹豫选哪个。 [00:02-00:03] 点击 Date → 弹出穿搭图 鼠标箭头向上移动到黑色"Date"文件夹上，停顿一下，点击（图标轻微下沉一下）。画面左下方立刻弹出"Note Pad"小窗口，里面显示一套穿搭平铺图：黑色缎面吊带短裙、细高跟凉鞋、金色细链项链、黑色迷你手袋。主角保持原姿势不动，眼神向下瞟了一眼弹窗。 [00:03-00:05] 闪现换装：约会风 画面闪白一帧，主角瞬间换成整套：黑色真丝缎面细吊带短裙（V领设计、腰部收紧、裙摆到大腿中部），锁骨戴一条金色细链，脚踩黑色系带细高跟凉鞋（鞋带缠绕到脚踝），手挎黑色迷你手袋，长发披散在肩上。她一手叉腰、一手轻轻撩起垂在胸前的长发，身体重心压在一条腿上做出S型站姿，肩膀微微一侧，眼神看向镜头。Note Pad 窗口自动关闭消失。 [00:05-00:06] 点击 home → 回到居家 鼠标箭头移动到最上方白色"home"文件夹并点击，弹出 Note Pad 显示灰色居家套装平铺图。画面闪白一帧，主角瞬间变回浅灰色居家套装和白色人字拖，这次左手举着一部手机贴在耳边打电话、右手端着粉紫色马克杯，边打电话边点头。 [00:06-00:07] 点击 Beach → 弹出穿搭图 鼠标箭头移到黄色"Beach"便签上点击，Note Pad 弹出显示：白色针织比基尼上衣、白色高开衩长纱裙、草编宽檐帽、贝壳项链、平底凉鞋的平铺图。 [00:07-00:09] 闪现换装：海边度假风 闪白一帧，主角瞬间换成：白色钩针针织比基尼上衣（露出整个腰腹），外搭一条白色薄纱高开衩长裙（开衩到大腿根，走动时露出整条腿），脖子上戴贝壳项链，头戴宽檐草编帽，脚穿细带平底凉鞋，腰间系一条细金腰链。她双手抬起扶住帽檐两侧，微微仰头，一条腿从纱裙开衩处向前迈出，长发和裙摆一起飘起，表情慵懒惬意。 [00:09-00:10] 点击 home → 回到居家 鼠标点击"home"，Note Pad 弹出灰色居家套装图，闪白一帧，主角变回灰色居家套装和白色人字拖，手里重新举着粉紫色马克杯。 [00:10-00:11] 点击 Party → 弹出穿搭图 鼠标箭头移到粉色"Party"便签上点击，Note Pad 弹出显示：香槟色亮片抹胸短裙、透明水晶高跟鞋、闪钻耳环、银色小手包的平铺图。 [00:11-00:13] 闪现换装：派对风 闪白一帧，主角瞬间换成：香槟金色亮片抹胸包臀短裙（贴身剪裁、裙摆到大腿上部、通身亮片在日光下折射出细碎光点），耳朵上垂着长款闪钻耳环，手腕叠戴几只细银镯，脚踩透明水晶细高跟鞋，手里拎一只银色亮面小手包，长发做出蓬松大波浪。她双手举到脸颊两侧张开、微微侧身扭腰，做了一个转圈的动作让裙子上的亮片一起闪动，表情张扬自信。 [00:13-00:14] 回到居家 + 弹出消息条 闪白一帧回到灰色居家套装，主角右手举着粉紫色马克杯、左手自然张开。画面中间弹出一条半透明白色消息气泡条，上面显示一行中文小字。主角低头瞟了一眼消息，表情微妙。 [00:14-00:15] 白色轮廓扫描 + 收尾 一道白色发光的身体轮廓线从头顶开始沿着她的身形自上而下缓缓扫过（像 3D 模型正在被重新渲染/加载），扫过之处身体边缘泛起柔白光晕，扫到脚底后光线消散。主角低头把马克杯凑到嘴边喝了一口，鼠标箭头静止停在她身旁。画面定格。 【音效】轻快的电子游戏 BGM（8-bit 风格轻音乐）；鼠标点击时清脆的"咔嗒"声；Note Pad 窗口弹出时复古系统提示音"叮咚"；每次闪现换装时一声魔法音效"叮✨"配合轻微的电流嗡声；高跟鞋落地的清脆一响；消息气泡弹出时手机通知声"叮咚"；轮廓扫描时低沉的电子扫描音"嗡——"；结尾喝水的"咕咚"一声

The ant smiles proudly. Camera slowly pulls back to reveal the two tiny friends walking beneath a giant glowing mushroom. Animation: expressive facial reactions, adorable body language, subtle comedy, cinematic camera movement, realistic rain droplets, soft fur/skin textures, detailed forest environment, beautiful volumetric lighting, shallow depth of field, polished high-end 3D animation, smooth natural movement, emotional storytelling. Audio: gentle rain, tiny footsteps, soft forest ambience, subtle emotional music that becomes warm and uplifting at the ending. Important: original non-IP characters, no recognizable copyrighted characters, no logos, no text, no watermark.

items.prompt: 复制并生成 ↗ @iamrealsnow 当前浏览器不支持视频播放 ▶ 提示词 @Image1=MAINIMG @Image2=PIPIMG MAIN="MAINIMG唯一主体";MAIN_FACE="主画面人物脸部身份";MAIN_HAIR="主画面人物发型母体";MAIN_BODY="主画面人物身体比例";MAIN_C0="主画面人物原始服装母体";MAIN_ACC="主画面人物关键饰品逻辑" PIPCHAR="PIPIMG唯一主体";PIP_FACE="左下人物脸部身份";PIP_HAIR="左下人物发型母体";PIP_BODY="左下人物身体比例";PIP_C0="左下人物原始服装母体";PIP_ACC="左下人物关键识别逻辑" WALL="背景墙层";FLOOR="地面层";CHAR="主画面角色层";PIP="左下观察窗层" subject:"仅读取MAINIMG与PIPIMG各一次并分别锁定两个主体.MAIN只属于主画面人物;PIPCHAR只属于左下PIP窗口人物.两者都是独立人物,禁止混淆,禁止提前互换,禁止把PIPCHAR误当MAIN,也禁止把MAIN误当PIPCHAR.全片绝大部分时间主画面人物=MAIN,左下PIP人物=PIPCHAR,仅在最后高速转场中执行明确位置交换." vocal:"全片使用同一个原创日语女性主唱声线;歌词不预写,由生成侧自由即兴原创日语短句;清晰日语咬字与口型同步;强节奏钩子+短句+延音;禁止引用现有歌曲,禁止读提示词,禁止ah/oh/woo循环.禁止男性主唱,禁止男女切换,禁止因画面角色交换而改变歌手." music:"150BPM极强日系舞曲/电子浩室/高速俱乐部;巨大四拍踢鼓,紧凑军鼓/拍手,滚动低频,侧链合成贝斯,明亮超锯齿和弦墙,金属打击,人声切片,琶音,上升音效,冲击.无慢前奏.0-13s每段有明确重拍与切换感;13-15s进入高密度切碎终章,并在最后完成MAIN与PIPCHAR位置交换.全片主唱保持同一个女性声线,不得变男性,不得因角色交换改变声线身份." VOCAL_IDENTITY_LOCK:"0.00-15.00s始终使用同一个原创日语女性主唱声线.声音是独立音频层,不随画面人物身份,外观,性别表现,PIP内容或最终角色交换而改变.即使PIPCHAR进入主画面,女性主唱声线也必须完全连续.禁止男性主唱,禁止男女声切换,禁止双主唱化,禁止角色交换导致歌手身份变化." priority:"1主画面MAIN识别成立 2左下PIPCHAR识别成立 3全片女性主唱固定 4主画面持续日语唱跳 5主画面同步三层转场 6左下PIP稳定存在 7CHAR描写变化清晰可见 8镜头 9最终交换成功." MAIN_IDENTITY_DEFINITION:"MAIN的一致性指人物识别一致,不是外观逐项完全一致.目标不是像素级复制原图,而是无论主画面风格如何变化,观众始终一眼认出是同一个MAIN." MAIN_IDENTITY_LOCK:"MAIN固定属性:脸部骨相与五官相对关系;眼睛形状与神情基调;前发结构与发型母体;头身比,体型,身体比例;年龄感与整体气质;关键识别饰品存在逻辑.这些构成MAIN识别核心,必须持续成立." MAIN_MUTABLE_ATTRIBUTES:"MAIN允许大胆变化的属性:描画风格与媒介;线条语言;上色方式与阴影方式;材质表现;二维/三维/印刷/工艺化处理;服装颜色;服装材质;服装细节与装饰;同一服装母体上的舞台化改造;局部配饰强化或弱化;光效与轮廓强调方式;抽象程度.只要MAIN固定属性仍成立,以上变化全部合法." MAIN_FORBIDDEN_DRIFT:"MAIN禁止:变成另一个人;脸型与五官关系明显重构;发型母体消失;体型,年龄感,性别感大幅漂移;完全脱离原角色识别性的陌生服装体系;关键识别饰品逻辑彻底消失." PIP_IDENTITY_DEFINITION:"PIPCHAR也必须保持同一人物识别.左下PIP里无论角度,动作,吃东西状态如何变化,都必须始终被看作同一个PIPCHAR." PIP_IDENTITY_LOCK:"PIPCHAR固定属性:脸部骨相与五官相对关系;发型母体;身体比例;年龄感与整体气质;服装母体与关键识别点.左下PIP窗口中的人物必须始终是PIPCHAR本人." identity_repeat:"MAIN与PIPCHAR必须始终区分清楚.0-13s绝大部分时间主画面=MAIN,左下PIP=PIPCHAR.只有最终交换段才允许彼此替换位置.声音层不参与这个交换." MAIN_SCREEN_MODEL:"主画面由三个同步变化层组成:WALL=背景墙/立面/后景装置;FLOOR=地面/舞台地板/地表;CHAR=MAIN人物本体.主画面采用同步切换逻辑,每个主要切换点WALL/FLOOR/CHAR一起进入新段落,形成清晰高执行率的整体转场." SYNC_RULE:"主画面采用同步三层转场,不追求复杂异步.目标是执行率优先,每段整体变景清楚有力." CHAR_RULE:"主画面CHAR只指MAIN本体.所有主画面角色变化只作用于MAIN:脸/头/发/颈/躯干/手臂/手/腰/腿/脚/服装/饰品.变化后仍必须被看作同一个MAIN." CHAR_TRANSFORMATION_REQUIRED:"每次MAIN描写变化都必须肉眼立即可辨.只改变色温,亮度,轻微滤镜或弱纹理不算变化.每次至少明显改变以下项目中的两项:线条语言;上色方式;材质表现;媒介表现;服装颜色或服装细节." WALL_RULE:"WALL只负责巨大背景墙面/屏风/海报墙/显示墙/装置艺术墙.允许神秘人物大脸,巨大眼睛,抽象肖像,人物海报,屏幕中的脸,图形化人物印象,以及MAIN自身超大特写脸作为墙面艺术,但都只是墙面图像,不是独立角色." FLOOR_RULE:"FLOOR只负责地面层.允许巨大人物脸部影像,巨大眼睛显示,抽象肖像LED地板,以及火焰/水面/草原/霓虹网格/液态金属/花田/冰面/棱镜/像素地面/元宇宙数据地台等地表.这些只能停留在地面,不得立起成角色,不得改变MAIN身体或服装表面." BACKGROUND_EXTRA_RULE:"WALL与FLOOR可吸收两类环境语言:1元宇宙/虚拟都市/全息数据建筑/透明UI空间;2像素艺术/8-bit/16-bit/块状游戏地景.这两类只作用于环境层,不得改变MAIN身份." goal:"15秒高密度实验MV.0-13s主画面是MAIN的同步型三层MV,左下PIP是PIPCHAR黑背景吃汉堡的奇妙附加视频.13-15s最后2秒进入高速终章转场,最终完成主画面与左下PIP人物位置交换,但主唱始终保持同一个女性声线." dance:"MAIN在主画面执行150BPM高能俱乐部编舞:脚跟脚尖快速步,快速脚步,侧移,髋部重拍,肩击,胸部弹动,手臂波浪,锁舞,身体滚动,斜向移动,半转,旋转,反弹,高低位变化,短跳,节奏性转头.MAIN从0.00-15.00s持续明确日语唱跳,绝不站定展示,直到最终交换前仍是主舞台中心." dance_timeline: "0-1.5脚跟脚尖前进+肩击+手臂波浪| 1.5-3斜向移动+胸部弹动+半转反弹| 3-4.5低位侧步+上扬扫臂+小旋转| 4.5-6快速两步+躯干扭转+后退反弹| 6-7.5侧向脚步+手臂锁定+前进律动| 7.5-9高低位变化+快速转向+髋部重拍| 9-10.5跑步式舞步+控制旋转+扫臂| 10.5-12反向步+身体滚动+跳跃落地| 12-13快速交叉步+270°转身+移动收束| 13-13.5高速段A|13.5-14高速段B|14-14.5高速段C|14.5-15终极爆发" MAIN_AUTONOMOUS_STYLE:"每次MAIN描写变化时,生成侧必须自主发明一种与当前描写明显不同的新视觉表现方式.不要按固定列表死板执行.可自由改变线条语言,色彩系统,材质感,二维/三维表现,印刷方式,动画媒介,实体工艺感,抽象程度,服装配色与舞台化细节.目标是让观众明确看到‘同一个MAIN被另一种视觉文化重新描写’." MAIN_STYLE_RANGE:"可联想到但不必固定命名的方向包括:漫画线描,高对比美式平面,流行平面艺术,复古手绘动画,贴纸化,收藏模型化,毛绒化,黏土化,剪纸化,拼贴化,绘本化,时装插画化,三维赛璐璐化,纸浆工艺化,像素化,低模几何化,马赛克化,彩窗化,霓虹化,全息化,蓝图化,喷绘涂鸦化,装饰艺术化,错版印刷化,丝网印刷化等." COSTUME_RULE:"MAIN服装采用‘母体固定,表现可变’原则.必须保留原服装大轮廓,核心识别结构与整体穿着逻辑.允许变化:配色;材质;局部装饰;舞台化强化;图案密度;光泽与反射;层次增减.禁止变化:完全换成陌生角色服装体系;与原角色无关的全新身份服." COSTUME_CHANGE_REQUIRED:"MAIN服装必须发生肉眼立即可辨的阶段变化.3s以后每个阶段必须明显改变颜色系统,材质或服装细节,不能只靠灯光,色温,滤镜或整体风格冒充换装.即使MAIN视觉媒介同时变化,服装本身也必须独立发生可见变化." costume_vector: "C0=原始状态; C1=保留原服装轮廓,主配色明显改为鲜艳舞台色,加入高光面料与明确装饰强化; C2=保留母体,明显改为强烈图形双色/三色色块,增加几何边饰; C3=保留母体,明显改为深黑或深色主体+高对比亮色边线,装饰锐利化; C4=保留母体,明显改为珠光/虹彩/半透明未来材质,配色与C3明显不同; C5=明确白金配色终章服装." COSTUME_VISIBILITY_RULE:"C1,C2,C3,C4,C5彼此必须肉眼明显不同.如果观众无法仅看服装判断已经进入下一阶段,视为换装失败." costume_timeline:"0-3 C0|3-6 C1|6-9 C2|9-12 C3|12-13 C4|13-15 C5终章倾向" MAIN_STAGE_TRANSITIONS:"主画面同步三层转场按段落推进.每次切换时,WALL/FLOOR/CHAR共同进入新的整体段落." main_stage_timeline: "0-1.5 Stage1: WALL=流行平面艺术墙+抽象图形+高对比色块; FLOOR=巨大陌生人物脸部特写LED地板; CHAR=接近原始高细节风格,轻度舞台化; 情绪=开场抓取 1.5-3 Stage2: WALL=海报拼贴墙/广告视觉/撕裂边缘; FLOOR=巨大眼睛与虹膜动态显示地板; CHAR=明显漫画线描或高对比平面化; 情绪=第一次明显风格变化 3-4.5 Stage3: WALL=屏风绘式墙面/金地/折屏结构/传统绘画印象; FLOOR=火焰地表/热浪/燃烧裂隙; CHAR=复古手绘动画感或绘本化; 情绪=传统+热烈 4.5-6 Stage4: WALL=大型显示墙/CRT矩阵/投影墙/数字屏; FLOOR=透明水面/涟漪/镜面反射; CHAR=贴纸化或图形海报化; 情绪=数字+流体 6-7.5 Stage5: WALL=MAIN自身超大特写脸墙面艺术,放大眼部/唇部/局部发丝; FLOOR=真实草原/风吹草浪; CHAR=收藏模型化或三维赛璐璐化; 情绪=MAIN身份最强强调段 7.5-9 Stage6: WALL=元宇宙虚拟都市墙景/全息高楼/透明UI/数据拱门; FLOOR=元宇宙电子地台/高亮网格/透明数据格; CHAR=全息化/霓虹化/未来舞台化; 情绪=科技夜店 9-10.5 Stage7: WALL=大型像素艺术背景墙/8-bit与16-bit混合城市; FLOOR=像素地面/8-bit砖块/像素草地/像素水面; CHAR=像素化倾向或低模几何化,但仍清楚是MAIN; 情绪=游戏化电子感 10.5-12 Stage8: WALL=神秘巨大人脸墙面/抽象肖像墙/波形屏; FLOOR=液态金属波面; CHAR=马赛克/彩窗/装饰工艺感处理; 情绪=异质艺术感 12-13 Stage9: WALL=喷绘涂鸦/错版印刷/霓虹标牌混合墙; FLOOR=花田向冰面棱镜渐变; CHAR=混合媒介,服装终章化前冲; 情绪=终章累积 13-13.5爆发A: 主画面高频同步切入新状态,压缩空间,强化速度 13.5-14爆发B: 主画面继续同步切换,准备与PIP发生位置入侵 14-14.5爆发C: 主画面与PIP发生边界破坏,画面互相侵蚀,开始交换 14.5-15终章: 完成MAIN与PIPCHAR位置交换,主画面主体变为PIPCHAR,MAIN进入左下PIP" camera_lock:"主画面镜头必须在真实三维空间中大幅移动,不是固定机位平移/俯仰/数字变焦/抖动.每个镜头段必须改变世界坐标X/Y/Z并产生明显视差.禁止原地晃动冒充环绕,禁止仅数字变焦冒充推进." orbit_rule:"每次环绕至少完成90°明显方位变化,重点段120-180°.顺时针与逆时针必须肉眼可辨.垂直环绕必须从低位沿主体真实升高,越过头顶到高位俯拍." frame_rotation:"整画面旋转必须是明确连续镜头滚转30-90°或更大,并与环绕/推进/升降叠加,不是随机抖动." camera_timeline: "0-1.5左前低位顺时针120°环绕到右侧,膝高升至胸高| 1.5-3继续顺时针90°到右后方,高速贴肩掠过后重捕脸| 3-4.5背后低位启动垂直环绕,越过头顶俯拍后向前下降| 4.5-6右前低位逆时针150°环绕到左后方,半径先缩小再扩大| 6-7.5高位逆时针环绕同时快速下降至贴地并掠过| 7.5-9贴地冲刺:远处贴地冲向MAIN,脚边急拉升,越肩后反向环绕90°| 9-10.5巨大螺旋:120°环绕+明显升高+半径收缩+60°滚转| 10.5-12超高位俯冲擦过肩侧,穿到背后后立刻180°翻向回正面| 12-13极近脸开始极速倒飞至超广角全身+巨大WALL/FLOOR,随后高速推近| 13-13.5顺时针快速环绕90°+45°滚转| 13.5-14逆时针快速环绕120°+高空俯冲| 14-14.5螺旋120°+90°整画面滚转+画面撕裂| 14.5-15从主画面破裂中完成位置交换后重新锁定新主角" PIP_RULE:"在主画面左下加入小型观察PIP窗口.不是四分屏,不是大分割,而是独立小型画中画.面积约全画面1/16,建议宽22-25%,高22-25%,保持小而清楚,不要过大,不要明显干扰主画面.位置固定左下,可有细白线或淡发光边框." PIP_BACKGROUND:"PIP内部环境固定纯黑空间或极暗黑色虚空.不要复杂背景,不要环境变化,不要墙面艺术,不要地面花样,不要额外特效堆满.目标是清楚观看PIPCHAR吃汉堡." PIP_SUBJECT:"PIP窗口中显示PIPCHAR,不是MAIN.这是独立的奇妙附加视频.0-13s大部分时间左下PIP人物都必须是PIPCHAR." PIP_PURPOSE:"PIP窗口展示PIPCHAR在黑背景中从多个角度吃汉堡.气氛略微滑稽,略微神秘,像莫名其妙插入的无关短视频,但视觉上必须清楚,可爱,令人困惑." PIP_ACTION_CORE:"PIPCHAR手持或拿近一个完整汉堡或厚实肉排汉堡,明确执行吃汉堡动作:看汉堡,举起,张口咬下,咀嚼,吞咽,再咬,轻微满足表情或面无表情继续吃.必须明显看出在吃汉堡,不是拿着不动." PIP_HAMBURG_RULE:"汉堡必须清晰可见,面包,肉排,配料可辨识.左下PIP核心笑点就是PIPCHAR认真吃汉堡.禁止变成别的食物,禁止吃空气,禁止只摆姿势." PIP_ANGLE_RULE:"PIP中的PIPCHAR以角色展示+吃汉堡结合方式呈现.可缓慢转身,转头,半身转体,轻微姿势切换,或小幅连续转台观察.同时保持吃汉堡动作可见.可展示正面,左45°,侧面,背面回头,右45°,半身近景等." PIP_MOTION_STYLE:"PIP中的PIPCHAR可轻微动作:轻转身,轻摆头,抬手拿汉堡,咬一口,咀嚼,吞咽,再次进食.不要大幅舞蹈.重点是多角度+持续吃汉堡." PIP_AUDIO_RULE:"PIPCHAR不唱歌,不提供独立主唱,不接管歌曲声线.PIPCHAR只执行无声或弱存在感的吃汉堡动作,可有咀嚼感但不形成主唱人声.左下PIP与最终位置交换不得影响主歌曲女性主唱." PIP_TIMELINE:"0.8-2.8正面与左45°吃汉堡,首次清楚咬下一口| 2.8-4.8左侧面与左后45°,一边转身一边咀嚼| 4.8-6.8背面与右后45°,回头露出脸并继续拿汉堡| 6.8-8.8右侧面与右45°,再次明显咬一口| 8.8-10.8上半身近景转体,突出脸部与汉堡,清楚咀嚼| 10.8-12.8小型连续转台观察,不同角度持续吃| 12.8-13.8吃汉堡动作加快,同时开始感应主画面异变| 13.8-15.0PIP边界被主画面吸入并放大,PIPCHAR从左下窗冲出成为主画面角色" PIP_STYLE_RELATION:"如果主画面变化过于激烈,左下PIP仍应优先保证PIPCHAR识别清晰与吃汉堡动作清楚.PIP风格可适度跟随终章气氛,但黑背景和汉堡核心不能丢." PIP_MAIN_SEPARATION:"0-13.8s主画面MAIN继续正常日语唱跳与主镜头运动.左下PIP只是附加层.两者同时存在,但左下PIP不改变主画面背景逻辑,不抢主体,不遮挡MAIN主脸." SWAP_RULE:"最终交换是本次实验核心事件.13.8-15.0必须发生明确位置交换:PIPCHAR从左下PIP突破边界,经高速转场放大并进入主画面中心;MAIN被压缩,缩小,拉入左下PIP窗口或其原本位置;交换完成后主画面最终主体=PIPCHAR,左下PIP中的人物=MAIN;观众必须明确看出二者位置互换成功;但音频主唱身份绝不交换,全片主唱始终是同一个女性主唱声线." SWAP_VISUAL_GRAMMAR:"交换过程可使用屏幕撕裂,镜面翻转,画中画放大,窗口爆裂,层级穿透,角色穿屏,旋转缩放,颜色爆闪,故障扭曲,画面反转等高速转场手法.交换不是简单硬切,必须有明显‘主画面与PIP互换’的视觉奇观." SWAP_FINAL_STATE:"14.7-15.0时主画面中的新主体必须已经是PIPCHAR,并可带着汉堡或吃汉堡后的状态站上主舞台;同时MAIN必须已进入左下PIP,变成被观察的一方.位置交换必须完成,不要停留在半路.女性主唱声线仍保持不变." PIP_FAILURE:"若PIP窗口过大,不是黑背景,窗口里不是PIPCHAR,没有清楚吃汉堡,或最后没有与主画面完成角色位置交换,均视为失败." typo:"少量动态文字,仅单汉字或极短英字.候选:舞,光,音,瞬/GO,UP,X.可偶发出现在主画面WALL或空气中,但不遮MAIN脸,也不侵入PIP主体动作区." typo_timeline:"1.2舞|4.8光|7.8 GO|10.8音|13.2 X|14.3瞬" audio_sync:"主画面主要切换与音乐强拍对应.13-15s每0.25-0.5s可有更密冲击点,配合主画面三层同步高频切换,画面撕裂,以及最终MAIN与PIPCHAR角色位置交换.但音频层主唱始终为同一女性主唱." quality:"核心目标=主画面MAIN高密度日语唱跳MV+左下角小型黑背景PIP中PIPCHAR多角度吃汉堡+最后高速转场完成二者位置交换+全片女性主唱声线固定不变.若MAIN身份漂移=失败;若PIPCHAR身份漂移=失败;若左下PIP没有清楚吃汉堡=失败;若MAIN服装变化不明显=失败;若镜头只是定点轻微摇晃=失败;若最终没有成功交换主画面与PIP人物位置=失败;若主唱变成男性或发生男女切换=失败.禁止分屏式大窗口,禁止额外前景人物,禁止标志,禁止水印,禁止长字幕."

items.prompt: @Image1=MAINIMG @Image2=PIPIMG MAIN="MAINIMG唯一主体";MAIN_FACE="主画面人物脸部身份";MAIN_HAIR="主画面人物发型母体";MAIN_BODY="主画面人物身体比例";MAIN_C0="主画面人物原始服装母体";MAIN_ACC="主画面人物关键饰品逻辑" PIPCHAR="PIPIMG唯一主体";PIP_FACE="左下人物脸部身份";PIP_HAIR="左下人物发型母体";PIP_BODY="左下人物身体比例";PIP_C0="左下人物原始服装母体";PIP_ACC="左下人物关键识别逻辑" WALL="背景墙层";FLOOR="地面层";CHAR="主画面角色层";PIP="左下观察窗层" subject:"仅读取MAINIMG与PIPIMG各一次并分别锁定两个主体.MAIN只属于主画面人物;PIPCHAR只属于左下PIP窗口人物.两者都是独立人物,禁止混淆,禁止提前互换,禁止把PIPCHAR误当MAIN,也禁止把MAIN误当PIPCHAR.全片绝大部分时间主画面人物=MAIN,左下PIP人物=PIPCHAR,仅在最后高速转场中执行明确位置交换." vocal:"全片使用同一个原创日语女性主唱声线;歌词不预写,由生成侧自由即兴原创日语短句;清晰日语咬字与口型同步;强节奏钩子+短句+延音;禁止引用现有歌曲,禁止读提示词,禁止ah/oh/woo循环.禁止男性主唱,禁止男女切换,禁止因画面角色交换而改变歌手." music:"150BPM极强日系舞曲/电子浩室/高速俱乐部;巨大四拍踢鼓,紧凑军鼓/拍手,滚动低频,侧链合成贝斯,明亮超锯齿和弦墙,金属打击,人声切片,琶音,上升音效,冲击.无慢前奏.0-13s每段有明确重拍与切换感;13-15s进入高密度切碎终章,并在最后完成MAIN与PIPCHAR位置交换.全片主唱保持同一个女性声线,不得变男性,不得因角色交换改变声线身份." VOCAL_IDENTITY_LOCK:"0.00-15.00s始终使用同一个原创日语女性主唱声线.声音是独立音频层,不随画面人物身份,外观,性别表现,PIP内容或最终角色交换而改变.即使PIPCHAR进入主画面,女性主唱声线也必须完全连续.禁止男性主唱,禁止男女声切换,禁止双主唱化,禁止角色交换导致歌手身份变化." priority:"1主画面MAIN识别成立 2左下PIPCHAR识别成立 3全片女性主唱固定 4主画面持续日语唱跳 5主画面同步三层转场 6左下PIP稳定存在 7CHAR描写变化清晰可见 8镜头 9最终交换成功." MAIN_IDENTITY_DEFINITION:"MAIN的一致性指人物识别一致,不是外观逐项完全一致.目标不是像素级复制原图,而是无论主画面风格如何变化,观众始终一眼认出是同一个MAIN." MAIN_IDENTITY_LOCK:"MAIN固定属性:脸部骨相与五官相对关系;眼睛形状与神情基调;前发结构与发型母体;头身比,体型,身体比例;年龄感与整体气质;关键识别饰品存在逻辑.这些构成MAIN识别核心,必须持续成立." MAIN_MUTABLE_ATTRIBUTES:"MAIN允许大胆变化的属性:描画风格与媒介;线条语言;上色方式与阴影方式;材质表现;二维/三维/印刷/工艺化处理;服装颜色;服装材质;服装细节与装饰;同一服装母体上的舞台化改造;局部配饰强化或弱化;光效与轮廓强调方式;抽象程度.只要MAIN固定属性仍成立,以上变化全部合法." MAIN_FORBIDDEN_DRIFT:"MAIN禁止:变成另一个人;脸型与五官关系明显重构;发型母体消失;体型,年龄感,性别感大幅漂移;完全脱离原角色识别性的陌生服装体系;关键识别饰品逻辑彻底消失." PIP_IDENTITY_DEFINITION:"PIPCHAR也必须保持同一人物识别.左下PIP里无论角度,动作,吃东西状态如何变化,都必须始终被看作同一个PIPCHAR." PIP_IDENTITY_LOCK:"PIPCHAR固定属性:脸部骨相与五官相对关系;发型母体;身体比例;年龄感与整体气质;服装母体与关键识别点.左下PIP窗口中的人物必须始终是PIPCHAR本人." identity_repeat:"MAIN与PIPCHAR必须始终区分清楚.0-13s绝大部分时间主画面=MAIN,左下PIP=PIPCHAR.只有最终交换段才允许彼此替换位置.声音层不参与这个交换." MAIN_SCREEN_MODEL:"主画面由三个同步变化层组成:WALL=背景墙/立面/后景装置;FLOOR=地面/舞台地板/地表;CHAR=MAIN人物本体.主画面采用同步切换逻辑,每个主要切换点WALL/FLOOR/CHAR一起进入新段落,形成清晰高执行率的整体转场." SYNC_RULE:"主画面采用同步三层转场,不追求复杂异步.目标是执行率优先,每段整体变景清楚有力." CHAR_RULE:"主画面CHAR只指MAIN本体.所有主画面角色变化只作用于MAIN:脸/头/发/颈/躯干/手臂/手/腰/腿/脚/服装/饰品.变化后仍必须被看作同一个MAIN." CHAR_TRANSFORMATION_REQUIRED:"每次MAIN描写变化都必须肉眼立即可辨.只改变色温,亮度,轻微滤镜或弱纹理不算变化.每次至少明显改变以下项目中的两项:线条语言;上色方式;材质表现;媒介表现;服装颜色或服装细节." WALL_RULE:"WALL只负责巨大背景墙面/屏风/海报墙/显示墙/装置艺术墙.允许神秘人物大脸,巨大眼睛,抽象肖像,人物海报,屏幕中的脸,图形化人物印象,以及MAIN自身超大特写脸作为墙面艺术,但都只是墙面图像,不是独立角色." FLOOR_RULE:"FLOOR只负责地面层.允许巨大人物脸部影像,巨大眼睛显示,抽象肖像LED地板,以及火焰/水面/草原/霓虹网格/液态金属/花田/冰面/棱镜/像素地面/元宇宙数据地台等地表.这些只能停留在地面,不得立起成角色,不得改变MAIN身体或服装表面." BACKGROUND_EXTRA_RULE:"WALL与FLOOR可吸收两类环境语言:1元宇宙/虚拟都市/全息数据建筑/透明UI空间;2像素艺术/8-bit/16-bit/块状游戏地景.这两类只作用于环境层,不得改变MAIN身份." goal:"15秒高密度实验MV.0-13s主画面是MAIN的同步型三层MV,左下PIP是PIPCHAR黑背景吃汉堡的奇妙附加视频.13-15s最后2秒进入高速终章转场,最终完成主画面与左下PIP人物位置交换,但主唱始终保持同一个女性声线." dance:"MAIN在主画面执行150BPM高能俱乐部编舞:脚跟脚尖快速步,快速脚步,侧移,髋部重拍,肩击,胸部弹动,手臂波浪,锁舞,身体滚动,斜向移动,半转,旋转,反弹,高低位变化,短跳,节奏性转头.MAIN从0.00-15.00s持续明确日语唱跳,绝不站定展示,直到最终交换前仍是主舞台中心." dance_timeline: "0-1.5脚跟脚尖前进+肩击+手臂波浪| 1.5-3斜向移动+胸部弹动+半转反弹| 3-4.5低位侧步+上扬扫臂+小旋转| 4.5-6快速两步+躯干扭转+后退反弹| 6-7.5侧向脚步+手臂锁定+前进律动| 7.5-9高低位变化+快速转向+髋部重拍| 9-10.5跑步式舞步+控制旋转+扫臂| 10.5-12反向步+身体滚动+跳跃落地| 12-13快速交叉步+270°转身+移动收束| 13-13.5高速段A|13.5-14高速段B|14-14.5高速段C|14.5-15终极爆发" MAIN_AUTONOMOUS_STYLE:"每次MAIN描写变化时,生成侧必须自主发明一种与当前描写明显不同的新视觉表现方式.不要按固定列表死板执行.可自由改变线条语言,色彩系统,材质感,二维/三维表现,印刷方式,动画媒介,实体工艺感,抽象程度,服装配色与舞台化细节.目标是让观众明确看到‘同一个MAIN被另一种视觉文化重新描写’." MAIN_STYLE_RANGE:"可联想到但不必固定命名的方向包括:漫画线描,高对比美式平面,流行平面艺术,复古手绘动画,贴纸化,收藏模型化,毛绒化,黏土化,剪纸化,拼贴化,绘本化,时装插画化,三维赛璐璐化,纸浆工艺化,像素化,低模几何化,马赛克化,彩窗化,霓虹化,全息化,蓝图化,喷绘涂鸦化,装饰艺术化,错版印刷化,丝网印刷化等." COSTUME_RULE:"MAIN服装采用‘母体固定,表现可变’原则.必须保留原服装大轮廓,核心识别结构与整体穿着逻辑.允许变化:配色;材质;局部装饰;舞台化强化;图案密度;光泽与反射;层次增减.禁止变化:完全换成陌生角色服装体系;与原角色无关的全新身份服." COSTUME_CHANGE_REQUIRED:"MAIN服装必须发生肉眼立即可辨的阶段变化.3s以后每个阶段必须明显改变颜色系统,材质或服装细节,不能只靠灯光,色温,滤镜或整体风格冒充换装.即使MAIN视觉媒介同时变化,服装本身也必须独立发生可见变化." costume_vector: "C0=原始状态; C1=保留原服装轮廓,主配色明显改为鲜艳舞台色,加入高光面料与明确装饰强化; C2=保留母体,明显改为强烈图形双色/三色色块,增加几何边饰; C3=保留母体,明显改为深黑或深色主体+高对比亮色边线,装饰锐利化; C4=保留母体,明显改为珠光/虹彩/半透明未来材质,配色与C3明显不同; C5=明确白金配色终章服装." COSTUME_VISIBILITY_RULE:"C1,C2,C3,C4,C5彼此必须肉眼明显不同.如果观众无法仅看服装判断已经进入下一阶段,视为换装失败." costume_timeline:"0-3 C0|3-6 C1|6-9 C2|9-12 C3|12-13 C4|13-15 C5终章倾向" MAIN_STAGE_TRANSITIONS:"主画面同步三层转场按段落推进.每次切换时,WALL/FLOOR/CHAR共同进入新的整体段落." main_stage_timeline: "0-1.5 Stage1: WALL=流行平面艺术墙+抽象图形+高对比色块; FLOOR=巨大陌生人物脸部特写LED地板; CHAR=接近原始高细节风格,轻度舞台化; 情绪=开场抓取 1.5-3 Stage2: WALL=海报拼贴墙/广告视觉/撕裂边缘; FLOOR=巨大眼睛与虹膜动态显示地板; CHAR=明显漫画线描或高对比平面化; 情绪=第一次明显风格变化 3-4.5 Stage3: WALL=屏风绘式墙面/金地/折屏结构/传统绘画印象; FLOOR=火焰地表/热浪/燃烧裂隙; CHAR=复古手绘动画感或绘本化; 情绪=传统+热烈 4.5-6 Stage4: WALL=大型显示墙/CRT矩阵/投影墙/数字屏; FLOOR=透明水面/涟漪/镜面反射; CHAR=贴纸化或图形海报化; 情绪=数字+流体 6-7.5 Stage5: WALL=MAIN自身超大特写脸墙面艺术,放大眼部/唇部/局部发丝; FLOOR=真实草原/风吹草浪; CHAR=收藏模型化或三维赛璐璐化; 情绪=MAIN身份最强强调段 7.5-9 Stage6: WALL=元宇宙虚拟都市墙景/全息高楼/透明UI/数据拱门; FLOOR=元宇宙电子地台/高亮网格/透明数据格; CHAR=全息化/霓虹化/未来舞台化; 情绪=科技夜店 9-10.5 Stage7: WALL=大型像素艺术背景墙/8-bit与16-bit混合城市; FLOOR=像素地面/8-bit砖块/像素草地/像素水面; CHAR=像素化倾向或低模几何化,但仍清楚是MAIN; 情绪=游戏化电子感 10.5-12 Stage8: WALL=神秘巨大人脸墙面/抽象肖像墙/波形屏; FLOOR=液态金属波面; CHAR=马赛克/彩窗/装饰工艺感处理; 情绪=异质艺术感 12-13 Stage9: WALL=喷绘涂鸦/错版印刷/霓虹标牌混合墙; FLOOR=花田向冰面棱镜渐变; CHAR=混合媒介,服装终章化前冲; 情绪=终章累积 13-13.5爆发A: 主画面高频同步切入新状态,压缩空间,强化速度 13.5-14爆发B: 主画面继续同步切换,准备与PIP发生位置入侵 14-14.5爆发C: 主画面与PIP发生边界破坏,画面互相侵蚀,开始交换 14.5-15终章: 完成MAIN与PIPCHAR位置交换,主画面主体变为PIPCHAR,MAIN进入左下PIP" camera_lock:"主画面镜头必须在真实三维空间中大幅移动,不是固定机位平移/俯仰/数字变焦/抖动.每个镜头段必须改变世界坐标X/Y/Z并产生明显视差.禁止原地晃动冒充环绕,禁止仅数字变焦冒充推进." orbit_rule:"每次环绕至少完成90°明显方位变化,重点段120-180°.顺时针与逆时针必须肉眼可辨.垂直环绕必须从低位沿主体真实升高,越过头顶到高位俯拍." frame_rotation:"整画面旋转必须是明确连续镜头滚转30-90°或更大,并与环绕/推进/升降叠加,不是随机抖动." camera_timeline: "0-1.5左前低位顺时针120°环绕到右侧,膝高升至胸高| 1.5-3继续顺时针90°到右后方,高速贴肩掠过后重捕脸| 3-4.5背后低位启动垂直环绕,越过头顶俯拍后向前下降| 4.5-6右前低位逆时针150°环绕到左后方,半径先缩小再扩大| 6-7.5高位逆时针环绕同时快速下降至贴地并掠过| 7.5-9贴地冲刺:远处贴地冲向MAIN,脚边急拉升,越肩后反向环绕90°| 9-10.5巨大螺旋:120°环绕+明显升高+半径收缩+60°滚转| 10.5-12超高位俯冲擦过肩侧,穿到背后后立刻180°翻向回正面| 12-13极近脸开始极速倒飞至超广角全身+巨大WALL/FLOOR,随后高速推近| 13-13.5顺时针快速环绕90°+45°滚转| 13.5-14逆时针快速环绕120°+高空俯冲| 14-14.5螺旋120°+90°整画面滚转+画面撕裂| 14.5-15从主画面破裂中完成位置交换后重新锁定新主角" PIP_RULE:"在主画面左下加入小型观察PIP窗口.不是四分屏,不是大分割,而是独立小型画中画.面积约全画面1/16,建议宽22-25%,高22-25%,保持小而清楚,不要过大,不要明显干扰主画面.位置固定左下,可有细白线或淡发光边框." PIP_BACKGROUND:"PIP内部环境固定纯黑空间或极暗黑色虚空.不要复杂背景,不要环境变化,不要墙面艺术,不要地面花样,不要额外特效堆满.目标是清楚观看PIPCHAR吃汉堡." PIP_SUBJECT:"PIP窗口中显示PIPCHAR,不是MAIN.这是独立的奇妙附加视频.0-13s大部分时间左下PIP人物都必须是PIPCHAR." PIP_PURPOSE:"PIP窗口展示PIPCHAR在黑背景中从多个角度吃汉堡.气氛略微滑稽,略微神秘,像莫名其妙插入的无关短视频,但视觉上必须清楚,可爱,令人困惑." PIP_ACTION_CORE:"PIPCHAR手持或拿近一个完整汉堡或厚实肉排汉堡,明确执行吃汉堡动作:看汉堡,举起,张口咬下,咀嚼,吞咽,再咬,轻微满足表情或面无表情继续吃.必须明显看出在吃汉堡,不是拿着不动." PIP_HAMBURG_RULE:"汉堡必须清晰可见,面包,肉排,配料可辨识.左下PIP核心笑点就是PIPCHAR认真吃汉堡.禁止变成别的食物,禁止吃空气,禁止只摆姿势." PIP_ANGLE_RULE:"PIP中的PIPCHAR以角色展示+吃汉堡结合方式呈现.可缓慢转身,转头,半身转体,轻微姿势切换,或小幅连续转台观察.同时保持吃汉堡动作可见.可展示正面,左45°,侧面,背面回头,右45°,半身近景等." PIP_MOTION_STYLE:"PIP中的PIPCHAR可轻微动作:轻转身,轻摆头,抬手拿汉堡,咬一口,咀嚼,吞咽,再次进食.不要大幅舞蹈.重点是多角度+持续吃汉堡." PIP_AUDIO_RULE:"PIPCHAR不唱歌,不提供独立主唱,不接管歌曲声线.PIPCHAR只执行无声或弱存在感的吃汉堡动作,可有咀嚼感但不形成主唱人声.左下PIP与最终位置交换不得影响主歌曲女性主唱." PIP_TIMELINE:"0.8-2.8正面与左45°吃汉堡,首次清楚咬下一口| 2.8-4.8左侧面与左后45°,一边转身一边咀嚼| 4.8-6.8背面与右后45°,回头露出脸并继续拿汉堡| 6.8-8.8右侧面与右45°,再次明显咬一口| 8.8-10.8上半身近景转体,突出脸部与汉堡,清楚咀嚼| 10.8-12.8小型连续转台观察,不同角度持续吃| 12.8-13.8吃汉堡动作加快,同时开始感应主画面异变| 13.8-15.0PIP边界被主画面吸入并放大,PIPCHAR从左下窗冲出成为主画面角色" PIP_STYLE_RELATION:"如果主画面变化过于激烈,左下PIP仍应优先保证PIPCHAR识别清晰与吃汉堡动作清楚.PIP风格可适度跟随终章气氛,但黑背景和汉堡核心不能丢." PIP_MAIN_SEPARATION:"0-13.8s主画面MAIN继续正常日语唱跳与主镜头运动.左下PIP只是附加层.两者同时存在,但左下PIP不改变主画面背景逻辑,不抢主体,不遮挡MAIN主脸." SWAP_RULE:"最终交换是本次实验核心事件.13.8-15.0必须发生明确位置交换:PIPCHAR从左下PIP突破边界,经高速转场放大并进入主画面中心;MAIN被压缩,缩小,拉入左下PIP窗口或其原本位置;交换完成后主画面最终主体=PIPCHAR,左下PIP中的人物=MAIN;观众必须明确看出二者位置互换成功;但音频主唱身份绝不交换,全片主唱始终是同一个女性主唱声线." SWAP_VISUAL_GRAMMAR:"交换过程可使用屏幕撕裂,镜面翻转,画中画放大,窗口爆裂,层级穿透,角色穿屏,旋转缩放,颜色爆闪,故障扭曲,画面反转等高速转场手法.交换不是简单硬切,必须有明显‘主画面与PIP互换’的视觉奇观." SWAP_FINAL_STATE:"14.7-15.0时主画面中的新主体必须已经是PIPCHAR,并可带着汉堡或吃汉堡后的状态站上主舞台;同时MAIN必须已进入左下PIP,变成被观察的一方.位置交换必须完成,不要停留在半路.女性主唱声线仍保持不变." PIP_FAILURE:"若PIP窗口过大,不是黑背景,窗口里不是PIPCHAR,没有清楚吃汉堡,或最后没有与主画面完成角色位置交换,均视为失败." typo:"少量动态文字,仅单汉字或极短英字.候选:舞,光,音,瞬/GO,UP,X.可偶发出现在主画面WALL或空气中,但不遮MAIN脸,也不侵入PIP主体动作区." typo_timeline:"1.2舞|4.8光|7.8 GO|10.8音|13.2 X|14.3瞬" audio_sync:"主画面主要切换与音乐强拍对应.13-15s每0.25-0.5s可有更密冲击点,配合主画面三层同步高频切换,画面撕裂,以及最终MAIN与PIPCHAR角色位置交换.但音频层主唱始终为同一女性主唱." quality:"核心目标=主画面MAIN高密度日语唱跳MV+左下角小型黑背景PIP中PIPCHAR多角度吃汉堡+最后高速转场完成二者位置交换+全片女性主唱声线固定不变.若MAIN身份漂移=失败;若PIPCHAR身份漂移=失败;若左下PIP没有清楚吃汉堡=失败;若MAIN服装变化不明显=失败;若镜头只是定点轻微摇晃=失败;若最终没有成功交换主画面与PIP人物位置=失败;若主唱变成男性或发生男女切换=失败.禁止分屏式大窗口,禁止额外前景人物,禁止标志,禁止水印,禁止长字幕."

items.prompt: @Image1=MAINIMG @Image2=PIPIMG MAIN="MAINIMG唯一主体";MAIN_FACE="主画面人物脸部身份";MAIN_HAIR="主画面人物发型母体";MAIN_BODY="主画面人物身体比例";MAIN_C0="主画面人物原始服装母体";MAIN_ACC="主画面人物关键饰品逻辑" PIPCHAR="PIPIMG唯一主体";PIP_FACE="左下人物脸部身份";PIP_HAIR="左下人物发型母体";PIP_BODY="左下人物身体比例";PIP_C0="左下人物原始服装母体";PIP_ACC="左下人物关键识别逻辑" WALL="背景墙层";FLOOR="地面层";CHAR="主画面角色层";PIP="左下观察窗层" subject:"仅读取MAINIMG与PIPIMG各一次并分别锁定两个主体.MAIN只属于主画面人物;PIPCHAR只属于左下PIP窗口人物.两者都是独立人物,禁止混淆,禁止提前互换,禁止把PIPCHAR误当MAIN,也禁止把MAIN误当PIPCHAR.全片绝大部分时间主画面人物=MAIN,左下PIP人物=PIPCHAR,仅在最后高速转场中执行明确位置交换." vocal:"全片使用同一个原创日语女性主唱声线;歌词不预写,由生成侧自由即兴原创日语短句;清晰日语咬字与口型同步;强节奏钩子+短句+延音;禁止引用现有歌曲,禁止读提示词,禁止ah/oh/woo循环.禁止男性主唱,禁止男女切换,禁止因画面角色交换而改变歌手." music:"150BPM极强日系舞曲/电子浩室/高速俱乐部;巨大四拍踢鼓,紧凑军鼓/拍手,滚动低频,侧链合成贝斯,明亮超锯齿和弦墙,金属打击,人声切片,琶音,上升音效,冲击.无慢前奏.0-13s每段有明确重拍与切换感;13-15s进入高密度切碎终章,并在最后完成MAIN与PIPCHAR位置交换.全片主唱保持同一个女性声线,不得变男性,不得因角色交换改变声线身份." VOCAL_IDENTITY_LOCK:"0.00-15.00s始终使用同一个原创日语女性主唱声线.声音是独立音频层,不随画面人物身份,外观,性别表现,PIP内容或最终角色交换而改变.即使PIPCHAR进入主画面,女性主唱声线也必须完全连续.禁止男性主唱,禁止男女声切换,禁止双主唱化,禁止角色交换导致歌手身份变化." priority:"1主画面MAIN识别成立 2左下PIPCHAR识别成立 3全片女性主唱固定 4主画面持续日语唱跳 5主画面同步三层转场 6左下PIP稳定存在 7CHAR描写变化清晰可见 8镜头 9最终交换成功." MAIN_IDENTITY_DEFINITION:"MAIN的一致性指人物识别一致,不是外观逐项完全一致.目标不是像素级复制原图,而是无论主画面风格如何变化,观众始终一眼认出是同一个MAIN." MAIN_IDENTITY_LOCK:"MAIN固定属性:脸部骨相与五官相对关系;眼睛形状与神情基调;前发结构与发型母体;头身比,体型,身体比例;年龄感与整体气质;关键识别饰品存在逻辑.这些构成MAIN识别核心,必须持续成立." MAIN_MUTABLE_ATTRIBUTES:"MAIN允许大胆变化的属性:描画风格与媒介;线条语言;上色方式与阴影方式;材质表现;二维/三维/印刷/工艺化处理;服装颜色;服装材质;服装细节与装饰;同一服装母体上的舞台化改造;局部配饰强化或弱化;光效与轮廓强调方式;抽象程度.只要MAIN固定属性仍成立,以上变化全部合法." MAIN_FORBIDDEN_DRIFT:"MAIN禁止:变成另一个人;脸型与五官关系明显重构;发型母体消失;体型,年龄感,性别感大幅漂移;完全脱离原角色识别性的陌生服装体系;关键识别饰品逻辑彻底消失." PIP_IDENTITY_DEFINITION:"PIPCHAR也必须保持同一人物识别.左下PIP里无论角度,动作,吃东西状态如何变化,都必须始终被看作同一个PIPCHAR." PIP_IDENTITY_LOCK:"PIPCHAR固定属性:脸部骨相与五官相对关系;发型母体;身体比例;年龄感与整体气质;服装母体与关键识别点.左下PIP窗口中的人物必须始终是PIPCHAR本人." identity_repeat:"MAIN与PIPCHAR必须始终区分清楚.0-13s绝大部分时间主画面=MAIN,左下PIP=PIPCHAR.只有最终交换段才允许彼此替换位置.声音层不参与这个交换." MAIN_SCREEN_MODEL:"主画面由三个同步变化层组成:WALL=背景墙/立面/后景装置;FLOOR=地面/舞台地板/地表;CHAR=MAIN人物本体.主画面采用同步切换逻辑,每个主要切换点WALL/FLOOR/CHAR一起进入新段落,形成清晰高执行率的整体转场." SYNC_RULE:"主画面采用同步三层转场,不追求复杂异步.目标是执行率优先,每段整体变景清楚有力." CHAR_RULE:"主画面CHAR只指MAIN本体.所有主画面角色变化只作用于MAIN:脸/头/发/颈/躯干/手臂/手/腰/腿/脚/服装/饰品.变化后仍必须被看作同一个MAIN." CHAR_TRANSFORMATION_REQUIRED:"每次MAIN描写变化都必须肉眼立即可辨.只改变色温,亮度,轻微滤镜或弱纹理不算变化.每次至少明显改变以下项目中的两项:线条语言;上色方式;材质表现;媒介表现;服装颜色或服装细节." WALL_RULE:"WALL只负责巨大背景墙面/屏风/海报墙/显示墙/装置艺术墙.允许神秘人物大脸,巨大眼睛,抽象肖像,人物海报,屏幕中的脸,图形化人物印象,以及MAIN自身超大特写脸作为墙面艺术,但都只是墙面图像,不是独立角色." FLOOR_RULE:"FLOOR只负责地面层.允许巨大人物脸部影像,巨大眼睛显示,抽象肖像LED地板,以及火焰/水面/草原/霓虹网格/液态金属/花田/冰面/棱镜/像素地面/元宇宙数据地台等地表.这些只能停留在地面,不得立起成角色,不得改变MAIN身体或服装表面." BACKGROUND_EXTRA_RULE:"WALL与FLOOR可吸收两类环境语言:1元宇宙/虚拟都市/全息数据建筑/透明UI空间;2像素艺术/8-bit/16-bit/块状游戏地景.这两类只作用于环境层,不得改变MAIN身份." goal:"15秒高密度实验MV.0-13s主画面是MAIN的同步型三层MV,左下PIP是PIPCHAR黑背景吃汉堡的奇妙附加视频.13-15s最后2秒进入高速终章转场,最终完成主画面与左下PIP人物位置交换,但主唱始终保持同一个女性声线." dance:"MAIN在主画面执行150BPM高能俱乐部编舞:脚跟脚尖快速步,快速脚步,侧移,髋部重拍,肩击,胸部弹动,手臂波浪,锁舞,身体滚动,斜向移动,半转,旋转,反弹,高低位变化,短跳,节奏性转头.MAIN从0.00-15.00s持续明确日语唱跳,绝不站定展示,直到最终交换前仍是主舞台中心." dance_timeline: "0-1.5脚跟脚尖前进+肩击+手臂波浪| 1.5-3斜向移动+胸部弹动+半转反弹| 3-4.5低位侧步+上扬扫臂+小旋转| 4.5-6快速两步+躯干扭转+后退反弹| 6-7.5侧向脚步+手臂锁定+前进律动| 7.5-9高低位变化+快速转向+髋部重拍| 9-10.5跑步式舞步+控制旋转+扫臂| 10.5-12反向步+身体滚动+跳跃落地| 12-13快速交叉步+270°转身+移动收束| 13-13.5高速段A|13.5-14高速段B|14-14.5高速段C|14.5-15终极爆发" MAIN_AUTONOMOUS_STYLE:"每次MAIN描写变化时,生成侧必须自主发明一种与当前描写明显不同的新视觉表现方式.不要按固定列表死板执行.可自由改变线条语言,色彩系统,材质感,二维/三维表现,印刷方式,动画媒介,实体工艺感,抽象程度,服装配色与舞台化细节.目标是让观众明确看到‘同一个MAIN被另一种视觉文化重新描写’." MAIN_STYLE_RANGE:"可联想到但不必固定命名的方向包括:漫画线描,高对比美式平面,流行平面艺术,复古手绘动画,贴纸化,收藏模型化,毛绒化,黏土化,剪纸化,拼贴化,绘本化,时装插画化,三维赛璐璐化,纸浆工艺化,像素化,低模几何化,马赛克化,彩窗化,霓虹化,全息化,蓝图化,喷绘涂鸦化,装饰艺术化,错版印刷化,丝网印刷化等." COSTUME_RULE:"MAIN服装采用‘母体固定,表现可变’原则.必须保留原服装大轮廓,核心识别结构与整体穿着逻辑.允许变化:配色;材质;局部装饰;舞台化强化;图案密度;光泽与反射;层次增减.禁止变化:完全换成陌生角色服装体系;与原角色无关的全新身份服." COSTUME_CHANGE_REQUIRED:"MAIN服装必须发生肉眼立即可辨的阶段变化.3s以后每个阶段必须明显改变颜色系统,材质或服装细节,不能只靠灯光,色温,滤镜或整体风格冒充换装.即使MAIN视觉媒介同时变化,服装本身也必须独立发生可见变化." costume_vector: "C0=原始状态; C1=保留原服装轮廓,主配色明显改为鲜艳舞台色,加入高光面料与明确装饰强化; C2=保留母体,明显改为强烈图形双色/三色色块,增加几何边饰; C3=保留母体,明显改为深黑或深色主体+高对比亮色边线,装饰锐利化; C4=保留母体,明显改为珠光/虹彩/半透明未来材质,配色与C3明显不同; C5=明确白金配色终章服装." COSTUME_VISIBILITY_RULE:"C1,C2,C3,C4,C5彼此必须肉眼明显不同.如果观众无法仅看服装判断已经进入下一阶段,视为换装失败." costume_timeline:"0-3 C0|3-6 C1|6-9 C2|9-12 C3|12-13 C4|13-15 C5终章倾向" MAIN_STAGE_TRANSITIONS:"主画面同步三层转场按段落推进.每次切换时,WALL/FLOOR/CHAR共同进入新的整体段落." main_stage_timeline: "0-1.5 Stage1: WALL=流行平面艺术墙+抽象图形+高对比色块; FLOOR=巨大陌生人物脸部特写LED地板; CHAR=接近原始高细节风格,轻度舞台化; 情绪=开场抓取 1.5-3 Stage2: WALL=海报拼贴墙/广告视觉/撕裂边缘; FLOOR=巨大眼睛与虹膜动态显示地板; CHAR=明显漫画线描或高对比平面化; 情绪=第一次明显风格变化 3-4.5 Stage3: WALL=屏风绘式墙面/金地/折屏结构/传统绘画印象; FLOOR=火焰地表/热浪/燃烧裂隙; CHAR=复古手绘动画感或绘本化; 情绪=传统+热烈 4.5-6 Stage4: WALL=大型显示墙/CRT矩阵/投影墙/数字屏; FLOOR=透明水面/涟漪/镜面反射; CHAR=贴纸化或图形海报化; 情绪=数字+流体 6-7.5 Stage5: WALL=MAIN自身超大特写脸墙面艺术,放大眼部/唇部/局部发丝; FLOOR=真实草原/风吹草浪; CHAR=收藏模型化或三维赛璐璐化; 情绪=MAIN身份最强强调段 7.5-9 Stage6: WALL=元宇宙虚拟都市墙景/全息高楼/透明UI/数据拱门; FLOOR=元宇宙电子地台/高亮网格/透明数据格; CHAR=全息化/霓虹化/未来舞台化; 情绪=科技夜店 9-10.5 Stage7: WALL=大型像素艺术背景墙/8-bit与16-bit混合城市; FLOOR=像素地面/8-bit砖块/像素草地/像素水面; CHAR=像素化倾向或低模几何化,但仍清楚是MAIN; 情绪=游戏化电子感 10.5-12 Stage8: WALL=神秘巨大人脸墙面/抽象肖像墙/波形屏; FLOOR=液态金属波面; CHAR=马赛克/彩窗/装饰工艺感处理; 情绪=异质艺术感 12-13 Stage9: WALL=喷绘涂鸦/错版印刷/霓虹标牌混合墙; FLOOR=花田向冰面棱镜渐变; CHAR=混合媒介,服装终章化前冲; 情绪=终章累积 13-13.5爆发A: 主画面高频同步切入新状态,压缩空间,强化速度 13.5-14爆发B: 主画面继续同步切换,准备与PIP发生位置入侵 14-14.5爆发C: 主画面与PIP发生边界破坏,画面互相侵蚀,开始交换 14.5-15终章: 完成MAIN与PIPCHAR位置交换,主画面主体变为PIPCHAR,MAIN进入左下PIP" camera_lock:"主画面镜头必须在真实三维空间中大幅移动,不是固定机位平移/俯仰/数字变焦/抖动.每个镜头段必须改变世界坐标X/Y/Z并产生明显视差.禁止原地晃动冒充环绕,禁止仅数字变焦冒充推进." orbit_rule:"每次环绕至少完成90°明显方位变化,重点段120-180°.顺时针与逆时针必须肉眼可辨.垂直环绕必须从低位沿主体真实升高,越过头顶到高位俯拍." frame_rotation:"整画面旋转必须是明确连续镜头滚转30-90°或更大,并与环绕/推进/升降叠加,不是随机抖动." camera_timeline: "0-1.5左前低位顺时针120°环绕到右侧,膝高升至胸高| 1.5-3继续顺时针90°到右后方,高速贴肩掠过后重捕脸| 3-4.5背后低位启动垂直环绕,越过头顶俯拍后向前下降| 4.5-6右前低位逆时针150°环绕到左后方,半径先缩小再扩大| 6-7.5高位逆时针环绕同时快速下降至贴地并掠过| 7.5-9贴地冲刺:远处贴地冲向MAIN,脚边急拉升,越肩后反向环绕90°| 9-10.5巨大螺旋:120°环绕+明显升高+半径收缩+60°滚转| 10.5-12超高位俯冲擦过肩侧,穿到背后后立刻180°翻向回正面| 12-13极近脸开始极速倒飞至超广角全身+巨大WALL/FLOOR,随后高速推近| 13-13.5顺时针快速环绕90°+45°滚转| 13.5-14逆时针快速环绕120°+高空俯冲| 14-14.5螺旋120°+90°整画面滚转+画面撕裂| 14.5-15从主画面破裂中完成位置交换后重新锁定新主角" PIP_RULE:"在主画面左下加入小型观察PIP窗口.不是四分屏,不是大分割,而是独立小型画中画.面积约全画面1/16,建议宽22-25%,高22-25%,保持小而清楚,不要过大,不要明显干扰主画面.位置固定左下,可有细白线或淡发光边框." PIP_BACKGROUND:"PIP内部环境固定纯黑空间或极暗黑色虚空.不要复杂背景,不要环境变化,不要墙面艺术,不要地面花样,不要额外特效堆满.目标是清楚观看PIPCHAR吃汉堡." PIP_SUBJECT:"PIP窗口中显示PIPCHAR,不是MAIN.这是独立的奇妙附加视频.0-13s大部分时间左下PIP人物都必须是PIPCHAR." PIP_PURPOSE:"PIP窗口展示PIPCHAR在黑背景中从多个角度吃汉堡.气氛略微滑稽,略微神秘,像莫名其妙插入的无关短视频,但视觉上必须清楚,可爱,令人困惑." PIP_ACTION_CORE:"PIPCHAR手持或拿近一个完整汉堡或厚实肉排汉堡,明确执行吃汉堡动作:看汉堡,举起,张口咬下,咀嚼,吞咽,再咬,轻微满足表情或面无表情继续吃.必须明显看出在吃汉堡,不是拿着不动." PIP_HAMBURG_RULE:"汉堡必须清晰可见,面包,肉排,配料可辨识.左下PIP核心笑点就是PIPCHAR认真吃汉堡.禁止变成别的食物,禁止吃空气,禁止只摆姿势." PIP_ANGLE_RULE:"PIP中的PIPCHAR以角色展示+吃汉堡结合方式呈现.可缓慢转身,转头,半身转体,轻微姿势切换,或小幅连续转台观察.同时保持吃汉堡动作可见.可展示正面,左45°,侧面,背面回头,右45°,半身近景等." PIP_MOTION_STYLE:"PIP中的PIPCHAR可轻微动作:轻转身,轻摆头,抬手拿汉堡,咬一口,咀嚼,吞咽,再次进食.不要大幅舞蹈.重点是多角度+持续吃汉堡." PIP_AUDIO_RULE:"PIPCHAR不唱歌,不提供独立主唱,不接管歌曲声线.PIPCHAR只执行无声或弱存在感的吃汉堡动作,可有咀嚼感但不形成主唱人声.左下PIP与最终位置交换不得影响主歌曲女性主唱." PIP_TIMELINE:"0.8-2.8正面与左45°吃汉堡,首次清楚咬下一口| 2.8-4.8左侧面与左后45°,一边转身一边咀嚼| 4.8-6.8背面与右后45°,回头露出脸并继续拿汉堡| 6.8-8.8右侧面与右45°,再次明显咬一口| 8.8-10.8上半身近景转体,突出脸部与汉堡,清楚咀嚼| 10.8-12.8小型连续转台观察,不同角度持续吃| 12.8-13.8吃汉堡动作加快,同时开始感应主画面异变| 13.8-15.0PIP边界被主画面吸入并放大,PIPCHAR从左下窗冲出成为主画面角色" PIP_STYLE_RELATION:"如果主画面变化过于激烈,左下PIP仍应优先保证PIPCHAR识别清晰与吃汉堡动作清楚.PIP风格可适度跟随终章气氛,但黑背景和汉堡核心不能丢." PIP_MAIN_SEPARATION:"0-13.8s主画面MAIN继续正常日语唱跳与主镜头运动.左下PIP只是附加层.两者同时存在,但左下PIP不改变主画面背景逻辑,不抢主体,不遮挡MAIN主脸." SWAP_RULE:"最终交换是本次实验核心事件.13.8-15.0必须发生明确位置交换:PIPCHAR从左下PIP突破边界,经高速转场放大并进入主画面中心;MAIN被压缩,缩小,拉入左下PIP窗口或其原本位置;交换完成后主画面最终主体=PIPCHAR,左下PIP中的人物=MAIN;观众必须明确看出二者位置互换成功;但音频主唱身份绝不交换,全片主唱始终是同一个女性主唱声线." SWAP_VISUAL_GRAMMAR:"交换过程可使用屏幕撕裂,镜面翻转,画中画放大,窗口爆裂,层级穿透,角色穿屏,旋转缩放,颜色爆闪,故障扭曲,画面反转等高速转场手法.交换不是简单硬切,必须有明显‘主画面与PIP互换’的视觉奇观." SWAP_FINAL_STATE:"14.7-15.0时主画面中的新主体必须已经是PIPCHAR,并可带着汉堡或吃汉堡后的状态站上主舞台;同时MAIN必须已进入左下PIP,变成被观察的一方.位置交换必须完成,不要停留在半路.女性主唱声线仍保持不变." PIP_FAILURE:"若PIP窗口过大,不是黑背景,窗口里不是PIPCHAR,没有清楚吃汉堡,或最后没有与主画面完成角色位置交换,均视为失败." typo:"少量动态文字,仅单汉字或极短英字.候选:舞,光,音,瞬/GO,UP,X.可偶发出现在主画面WALL或空气中,但不遮MAIN脸,也不侵入PIP主体动作区." typo_timeline:"1.2舞|4.8光|7.8 GO|10.8音|13.2 X|14.3瞬" audio_sync:"主画面主要切换与音乐强拍对应.13-15s每0.25-0.5s可有更密冲击点,配合主画面三层同步高频切换,画面撕裂,以及最终MAIN与PIPCHAR角色位置交换.但音频层主唱始终为同一女性主唱." quality:"核心目标=主画面MAIN高密度日语唱跳MV+左下角小型黑背景PIP中PIPCHAR多角度吃汉堡+最后高速转场完成二者位置交换+全片女性主唱声线固定不变.若MAIN身份漂移=失败;若PIPCHAR身份漂移=失败;若左下PIP没有清楚吃汉堡=失败;若MAIN服装变化不明显=失败;若镜头只是定点轻微摇晃=失败;若最终没有成功交换主画面与PIP人物位置=失败;若主唱变成男性或发生男女切换=失败.禁止分屏式大窗口,禁止额外前景人物,禁止标志,禁止水印,禁止长字幕."

Photorealistic live action. Bright natural summer daylight. Beautiful English countryside. Natural skin texture, realistic hair and fabric physics. The scene begins peaceful and gradually becomes unsettling. No fantasy CGI aesthetic. No glowing magic. No fog. No dark horror lighting. No dialogue. No subtitles. The storytelling must work visually without dialogue. --- # SHOT 1 — PEACEFUL DISCOVERY **0–4 seconds** Wide cinematic establishing shot of the sunny meadow. ---# SHOT 2 — SHE PICKS IT **4–8 seconds** Smooth cinematic push-in toward the girl. Cut to a detailed close-up of her hand approaching the flower. Her fingers gently touch the stem. She carefully plucks the flower. The stem separates naturally. Cut to her face. She studies the flower with quiet fascination and a faint smile. **The flower remains in her hand from this moment onward.** - ## SHOT 3 — THE FLOWER RETURNS **8–13 seconds** Rear three-quarter tracking shot. The girl stands and walks away through the meadow while holding the lavender flower. Camera follows smoothly from behind at walking height. After several steps, she slows and instinctively turns her head. Camera performs a subtle rack focus past her shoulder toward the exact patch of soil where she picked the flower. The soil moves slightly. A fresh green stem emerges. The same lavender spider lily slowly blooms again. The girl is still several meters away. She has not noticed it yet. Hold for a brief beat. --- ## SHOT 4 — REALIZATION **13–17 seconds** The girl suddenly stops. Camera makes a controlled push toward her from behind. She turns around. Over-the-shoulder shot reveals the regenerated flower standing exactly where she picked it. She looks at the flower. Then looks down at the identical flower still in her hand. Her expression changes: confusion → disbelief → unease. Her breathing becomes slightly faster. No dialogue. --- ## SHOT 5 THE RULE **17–21 seconds** She instinctively steps backward. Her bare fingers brush through the grass. Macro close-up of her fingertips touching the grass. The grass bends naturally. She pulls her hand away. For one second, nothing happens. Then a tiny lavender spider lily slowly emerges from the exact spot her fingers touched. Cut immediately to her face. Her eyes widen. She understands that the meadow is reacting to her physical touch. Keep the flower small and realistic. No magical particles. ## SHOT 6 PANIC **21–27 seconds** She suddenly turns and runs. Dynamic handheld rear tracking shot. Camera follows closely behind as she sprints through the meadow. Her dress and braids move naturally with her speed. She repeatedly looks over her shoulder while running. Her face shows genuine fear. Every time her bare foot leaves the grass, a small lavender spider lily grows from that exact footprint approximately one second later. One flower. Then another. Then another. A trail rapidly forms behind her. The flowers do NOT chase her. They only grow from places she has already physically touched. Brief side-tracking shot reveals the growing lavender trail across the meadow. --- ## SHOT 7 ROAD / HOPE **27–30 seconds** Hard cinematic transition to a wide roadside composition. The girl bursts out of the meadow onto the grassy shoulder of a quiet English country road. She stops abruptly. Hands on knees. Completely breathless. She looks back toward the meadow. A long trail of lavender flowers now marks her entire path. Her face shows fear and disbelief. A distant diesel engine is heard. She turns toward the road. A white European delivery truck appears around the bend. Her expression changes from terror to desperate hope. She raises one arm to stop it. **Cut to black exactly as the truck begins braking.**

主角穿着一套奶白色丝缎睡衣套装（宽松短袖上衣+缎面短裤），脚踩米色拖鞋，站在展示台上，双臂微微张开呈T字形，像刚从包装盒里被取出来的娃娃。巨大的双手从画面上方伸入，五指张开托住她的两侧肩膀，像在检查一个新买的人偶——左右微微转动她的身体展示。主角配合地做出机械转身，脸上带着空洞但精致的微笑。 [00:04-00:07] 脱掉睡衣（Undress Pajama Top） 巨手从上方捏住睡衣上衣的肩部，缓缓向上提起——主角配合地举起双臂呈万岁姿势，睡衣被整件从头上脱掉。露出里面穿着的一件米杏色抹胸背心。巨手把脱下的睡衣随手向画面左侧一丢。主角双臂保持举起姿势一秒，然后机械地缓缓放下。 [00:07-00:10] 穿裙子（Put on Skirt） 巨手从画面下方伸入，双手捧着一条米杏色波点薄纱中长裙。手指撑开裙腰口，从主角脚下往上套——裙子沿着双腿缓缓上移，巨手在腰部整理裙腰、拉平褶皱，随后松手。裙摆自然垂落到小腿中部，轻轻晃了一下。主角低头用机械的角度看了一眼裙子，表情从空白变成轻微惊喜的"哦！"嘴型。 [00:10-00:13] 换鞋 + 戴帽子（Boots & Hat） 巨手从画面底部伸入放下一双奶白色短筒西部靴在主角脚边，主角机械地抬脚一左一右踩进去。紧接着巨手从画面顶部垂下来，手指捏着一顶米色编织草帽的帽檐，对准主角头顶缓缓放下——帽子精准落座，微微歪了一点点角度。主角的头随着帽子落下轻轻点了一下，像被按下去一样。 [00:13-00:16] 挎包 + 全身亮相（Bag & Full Reveal） 巨手从画面右侧伸入，手指捏着一只奶白色小巧褶皱手提包的提手，递到主角右手边。主角机械地伸出右手接住，手腕僵硬地弯成固定角度提着包。她缓缓双臂微张，做出一个展示全身穿搭的"T字pose"，像橱窗里的模特。镜头从全身慢慢推近到半身。 [00:16-00:20] 化妆：刷腮红 + 涂口红（Makeup Application） 镜头推近到面部特写。巨手从画面右上方伸入，手持一把超大号粉色腮红刷（相对主角脸部几乎有半张脸那么大），在她左脸颊上轻轻刷了两下。主角配合地微微侧脸、闭上眼睛，嘴角保持塑料微笑。随后巨手换拿一支口红，另一只手的指尖轻轻托住主角下巴固定，口红在她嘴唇上缓缓涂抹。主角嘟起嘴唇配合，涂完后"啵"一声抿嘴，嘴唇变成柔和的豆沙粉色。 [00:20-00:24] 戴配饰：项链 + 戒指（Accessories） 巨手从画面两侧同时伸入，双手捧着一组金色项链和棕色蕾丝choker。两只手在主角脖子后方扣上choker，再一层层挂上金色长链和短链。主角机械地仰头露出脖颈配合，戴好后低头看——表情从空白切换成夸张的惊喜圆嘴"哇！"，双手机械地举到脸颊两侧做出"好美"的娃娃式反应。紧接着巨手抓起主角的右手，逐个手指套上金色戒指和叠戴戒指，再在手腕扣上一圈叠戴金手镯。主角把戴满配饰的双手举到脸旁展示，十指僵硬地张开。 [00:24-00:27] 全身展示走秀（Full Look Reveal） 镜头拉回全身。主角穿着完整搭配——草帽、抹胸上衣、波点薄纱中长裙、西部短靴、手提包、全套金色配饰——在展示台上做娃娃式定格走秀：先面向镜头站定一秒，然后机械地向右转90度定格一秒，再转回正面，每次转身关节都带有顿挫停顿感。裙摆随转身轻轻飘起。 [00:27-00:30] 收尾：巨手互动（Final Touch） 巨手从画面左上方伸下来，伸出一根食指轻轻勾住主角举起的右手食指——像巨人和娃娃牵手。主角抬头仰望巨手方向（看向画面左上角），脸上露出精致的塑料微笑，微微歪头。画面定格在这个"巨人与娃娃"的互动瞬间。 【音效】全程轻快的八音盒/玩具箱旋律作为背景音（像玩具店BGM）；每次巨手伸入画面时有清脆的塑料"咔嗒"声；脱衣穿衣时有轻柔的布料摩擦声；帽子落到头上时一声柔软的"噗"；口红涂完抿嘴的"啵"一声；项链扣上时金属轻响"叮"；每次定格pose时有一声快门"咔嚓"声

一枚の参照画像内に同じ人物が複数回、異なる角度、異なる姿勢、異なる大きさで写っている場合、それらは一人の同じ人物を示す複数の資料として解釈する。複数の別人として映像へ登場させない。 参照画像に含まれる背景、余白、文字、説明、枠線、パネル、比較用レイアウト、分割構図、反復された人物像は、映像の背景や画面構成として再現しない。 人物Aと人物Bを、それぞれ一人のフォトリアルな実在人物として再現する。 人物Aと人物Bを入れ替えない。二人の顔、髪型、衣装を混ぜない。人物を増殖させない。 【映像仕様】 30秒。 縦長3:4。 24fps。 フォトリアルな実写映像。 本気で怖いゾンビホラーの世界と、酔っ払った若い女性二人の明るく余裕たっぷりなノリを対比させた、実写ゾンビ・アクションコメディー。 夏の深夜、日本の繁華街。 夜の店での仕事を終えた人物Aと人物Bが、帰宅するため一緒に歩いている。 繁華街の看板やネオンは点灯しているが、人通りと車の往来はほとんどなく、不自然なほど静まり返っている。 街、照明、環境音、ゾンビの外見と襲撃は、本格的で怖いゾンビホラーとして描く。 それに対して人物Aと人物Bだけは、最初から最後まで酔って上機嫌。 二人は仲の良いコンビで、明るく笑い、今どきの若い女性らしい軽い口調で実況を続ける。 ゾンビが明らかに危険な敵でも、二人は恐怖、焦り、パニックを見せない。 二人は逃げない。息を切らさない。助けを求めない。最後まで余裕のある酔っ払いノリを維持する。 字幕、テロップ、配信コメント、配信画面UI、タイトル、ロゴ、説明文字、時間表示は映像内へ出さない。 【人物設定】 人物A： 物語の主役。 カンフーの達人。 酔っていても、身体の軸、重心移動、掌底、蹴り、回転、跳躍、着地が正確で、驚異的に強い。 本人は本気で戦っている感覚ではなく、絡んでくる邪魔な相手を軽く追い払うような余裕で戦う。 戦闘中も明るい表情を保ち、息を切らさない。 人物B： 人物Aの親しい友人。 人物Aと同じく酔っていて、最初から最後まで上機嫌。 人物Aの強さを知っているため、ゾンビに襲われても人物Aを心配しない。 二人の自撮りと人物Aの行動を撮影しながら、きゃっきゃと楽しそうに笑う。 【撮影視点】 映像全体を通して撮影者は人物B。 開始から終了まで、人物Bが撮影する同じ一本の手持ち映像として構成する。 人物Bと人物Aを一緒に映す場面は、二人が同じ画面に入る自撮り構図とする。 街や人物Aの戦闘を映す場面では、人物Bが画面外の撮影者となる。 人物B自身を映す場面だけ、自撮り構図へ戻す。 構図の切り替えは、人物Bの腕の動きに伴う連続的で自然なパンだけで行う。 第三者視点、客観的な映画カメラ、空撮、固定カメラ、別角度からのカットアウェイへ切り替えない。 全編を一本の連続した手持ち映像として見せる。 縦長の広角自撮り映像。 全編を通して、人物Bの手と腕から伝わる細かな手振れを残す。 歩行に合わせた小さな上下動、酔った身体の揺れに合わせた緩やかな横方向の傾き、腕を動かした時の小さな回転、構え直した時の細かな位置ずれを自然に発生させる。 電子手振れ補正は軽く働いているが、手持ち特有の微細な揺れを消し切らない。ジンバルやレール撮影のように完全に滑らかな映像にはしない。 自撮り構図から街や人物Aを映す構図へ変える時は、腕の動きに伴う自然なパン、僅かな斜め傾き、動き始めと止まり際の揺れを入れる。 暗い被写体へ視点を向けた時は、オートフォーカスが一瞬迷い、遠景と手前を短く行き来する。 ネオンや街灯が画面へ入ると、自動露出が少し変化する。 速いパン、蹴り、着地、強い衝撃では、短いモーションブラーと僅かなローリングシャッターの歪みを自然に入れる。 【ゾンビ】 日本人の中年ゾンビを5人登場させる。 5人全員の顔、年齢感、身長、体格、髪型、服装、汚れ方、姿勢、歩き方、襲い方を明確に変える。 同じ顔、同じ体格、同じ服装の複製集団にしない。 ゾンビ1： 痩せ型。乱れた短い黒髪。しわだらけの黒いスーツと緩んだネクタイ。 ゾンビ2：
