体周辺など、キャラクターの身体構造に適した位置を映す。カメラは砂の上または身体周辺の生成地点へゆっくり寄る。赤い一本の線画が一筆ずつ明確に描かれ、空中へ立ち上がり、反りのある片刃の刀の輪郭を形成する。同じ工程でもう一本が形成され、輪郭の内側が赤い光で満たされて二本の刀剣になる。二本は同じ長さと形状を持ち、赤い光が刃の峰を走る。線画は途中を省略せず、一筆ずつ段階的に形成され、完成後は補助線だけが消えて刀剣本体が残る。刀剣の本数を一本や三本以上に変えない。⑥12.5〜15秒：最初の斬撃。地面すれすれのローアングルで主人公を見上げる。主人公が二本の刀剣を身体構造に合った方法で左右へ構え、カメラは前方へ短くドリーインする。主人公が砂を蹴って一歩または一跳びで踏み込み、手前の黒い敵を斜めに斬る。刀剣が敵に触れる瞬間だけカメラを接触点へ寄せる。黒い敵は血や肉を出さず、厚みのない黒い平面の破片へ砕ける。主人公の腕、脚、触手、翼などを増殖させず、刀剣の左右と斬撃方向を維持する。⑦15〜17.5秒：黒敵群の連続撃破。カメラは主人公と横並走し、手前を黒い敵の大きくぼけたシルエットが次々に横切る。主人公は低い姿勢で左右の刀剣を交互に振り、敵を一体ずつ斬る。人型以外の場合も参照画像の移動方法と身体構造に従い、地面を走る、跳ぶ、滑る、飛ぶなど自然な方法で前進する。カメラは横移動から短い前方追従へ変わり、斬撃のたびに主人公の特徴的な頭部、顔、腕、脚、首、尾、翼、衣装などが広角パースで大きく強調される。身体を不自然に溶かしたり、別形状へ変形させたりしない。黒い敵は黒い平面破片となり、砂煙とともに散る。⑧17.5〜20秒：青い巨大恐竜の出現。黒い敵群が倒れた直後、カメラは主人公の背後からゆっくり引き、砂漠の一時的な静けさを見せる。背後の地平線が暗くなり、巨大な青い影が立ち上がる。カメラは主人公の肩越し、頭越し、背中越しなど、その身体構造に適した位置から上へティルトし、空を覆うほど巨大な恐竜型の敵を見せる。恐竜は主人公とは異なる外見を持ち、青い外皮、濃紺の影、巨大な顎、鈍い黄色の目、重い脚を持つ。恐竜は一歩踏み出すだけで砂丘を揺らす。主人公の全身が恐竜の足先よりもはるかに小さく見える明確なスケール差を作り、恐竜を小型化しない。⑨20〜22.5秒：青い恐竜に食べられる。カメラは恐竜の足元から頭部へ見上げる強い煽り。恐竜が巨大な口を開き、主人公を正面から飲み込もうと前進する。カメラは主人公の正面へ後退しながら追従する。主人公は二本の刀剣を構えて抵抗しようとするが間に合わず、砂ごと巨大な口の暗闇へ吸い込まれる。主人公の身体や衣装を恐竜の歯で切断しない。恐竜の顎が閉じる瞬間、画面が完全な黒へ落ちる。血、負傷、肉片、咀嚼、体液を描かない。⑩22.5〜25秒：暗闇の中の瞳。完全な暗闇。環境音が消え、主人公の呼吸音または小さな作動音だけが聞こえる。画面中央に主人公の瞳、複眼、発光部、ディスプレイなど、参照画像に存在する視覚的特徴が浮かび上がる。色、形、個数、配置を参照画像どおりに維持する。カメラはその光へ非常にゆっくりドリーインする。主人公の特徴的な頭部形状、顔の輪郭、髪、角、耳、首などが暗闇の中から少しずつ見える。身体は見せすぎず、瞳または発光部と頭部の輪郭だけで主人公の存在を示す。参照画像の瞳や発光部を黄色へ変更しない。⑪25〜28秒：恐竜の内部から赤い刀光。主人公が二本の刀剣を構える。赤い線画の光が二本の刀身から伸び、暗闇の中で恐竜の内部を大きな弧として描く。カメラは主人公の周囲を小さく回り込み、赤い刀光が身体の周囲を一周する様子を見せる。主人公の身体的特徴、衣装、装飾品の輪郭が赤い光で一瞬だけ照らされる。次の一コマで、複数の赤い斬撃線が恐竜の青い外皮へ内部から到達し、外側へ向かって赤い裂け目が走る。恐竜の内部を肉体的、解剖学的、写実的に描写しない。背景は抽象的な暗闇のみとし、赤い線、主人公の輪郭、青い外皮の亀裂だけで表現する。⑫28〜30秒：内部からの脱出。恐竜の青い外皮が、内部から走った赤い刀光によって大きく左右へ割れる。血、肉、骨、内臓を描かず、青い外皮を厚みの少ない巨大なセル画状の破片として表現する。カメラは恐竜の外側へ急速に後退し、赤い光の裂け目から主人公が飛び出す姿を正面のローアングルで捉える。主人公は二本の刀剣を左右へ振り抜き、青い破片と赤い光が砂漠へ散る。主人公は身体構造に適した姿勢で砂地へ着地する。着地後、参照画像で最も特徴的な瞳、顔の発光部、頭部、表情のいずれかが画面中央で強調される。主人公の本人性が分かる最終ポーズを約0.5秒維持する。最後は強いハレーションで白く焼け、音と映像を同時にハードカットする。音響：BGMなし。風、砂、落下音、衝撃音、衣擦れまたは身体の小さな作動音、刀剣の線画生成音、斬撃音、恐竜の低い咆哮、飲み込まれる瞬間の無音、暗闇での主人公の呼吸音または微かな作動音、内部の赤い刀光が発する高い金属音のみ。台詞、掛け声、ナレーションなし。NG：画面分割、マルチ画面、設定資料の転写、参照画像の背景や文字の転写、三面図の並列表示、寸法線、注釈、血、肉片、骨、写実的な内臓、咀嚼表現、フォトリアル、実写、3D、CGレンダリング調、ゲーム画面調、過剰なカメラ揺れ、常時手ブレ、無意味な回転、黒い敵の赤化や青化、黒い敵の主人公化、青い恐竜の小型化、恐竜と主人公の融合、主人公の瞳や固有の発光部の消失または色変更、主人公の別人化、顔の変更、衣装変更、種族変更、年齢変更、性別変更、身体部位の増減、余分な指、余分な腕、余分な脚、角・耳・翼・尾・髪・装飾品の勝手な追加、参照画像にある特徴的な身体部位の消失、刀剣の本数変更、刀剣の形状変化、刀剣と既存装飾品の融合、斬撃方向の不連続、カット間の左右反転、補間された滑らかすぎる動き、モーションブラーによる輪郭消失、字幕、文字、ロゴ、透かし、BGM。

items.prompt: 复制并生成 ↗ @roco_kn_roco 当前浏览器不支持视频播放 ▶ 提示词 Execute immediately. Do not restate the prompt, preface the output with a capabilities statement, or offer alternative concepts. Create an original, Chinese-inspired dark-fantasy combat short in a AAA game style titled “Breaking the Formation on a Rainy Night.” Deliver 16:9 landscape, 720p, exactly 30 seconds, with generated audio synced to picture. Reference locks: @Image 1 is the single source of truth for the opening frame: composition, the characters’ screen-left/screen-right placement, character scale, spacing, camera position, and lighting. @Image 2 locks the hero, Qinglei Jianzhu (“Azure Thunder Sword Adept”): same face, silver-white high ponytail, build, white/red/black lightning-pattern armor, blue-white lightning motifs, and a single straight sword. @Image 3 locks the boss, Rongjia Yanjiang (“Molten-Armor Nightmare General”): same square bronze mask, two small horns, orange eyes, massive build, black molten armor, and a single two-handed greataxe. @Image 4 locks the location for the entire piece: one rain-soaked old Chinese street, buildings on both sides, a distant pavilion, warm lanterns, wet flagstones, and cool-blue ambient light. Keep exactly these two characters on this same street for the full 30 seconds. Lock identity, face or mask, wardrobe, scale, and weapons across every shot. Keep Qinglei Jianzhu on screen left and Rongjia Yanjiang on screen right throughout the action. Maintain the 180-degree rule—no unmotivated teleports or side swaps. Sell weight, inertia, contact, and equal-and-opposite reaction. Every move must play through wind-up, acceleration, impact or dodge, follow-through, and a clean settle. 0–5 seconds: Open on the quiet standoff from @Image 1. Steady, moderate rain; lanterns sway slightly. Rongjia Yanjiang takes two slow steps forward. Each heavy footfall kicks water out of the puddles while the greataxe blade drags across the wet flagstones, throwing a few dark-gold sparks. Qinglei Jianzhu shifts her rear foot half a step and raises the straight sword into a firm guard. Dolly slowly forward roughly one meter along the street centerline, then settle into a locked frame by 00:05. 5–11 seconds: Side medium-wide. Rongjia Yanjiang drops a shoulder for the wind-up, then drives one clean horizontal sweep with the single greataxe. Qinglei Jianzhu does not plant and hard-block. She retreats on a diagonal and meets the outer edge of the axe blade at an angle with her single straight sword, redirecting the force. Show exactly one brief, readable sword-to-axe contact and a small burst of metal sparks. Sell the power difference through both characters’ arms, torsos, and footwork: Qinglei Jianzhu is driven back two steps before regaining her base; Rongjia Yanjiang carries the sweep through its full follow-through and settles. Track laterally for a short distance, then lock off as both characters come to rest. 11–18 seconds: Low-angle wide. Rongjia Yanjiang raises the greataxe overhead with both hands, drops his center of gravity to load the strike, then slams the blade straight down into the wet flagstones. Qinglei Jianzhu pushes off toward back-left before impact—no roll, no disappearance. Trigger the effects only after the blade hits: cracks radiate from that single impact point, a low dark-gold shockwave runs across the street, puddles kick outward, and the rain briefly flashes into a thin veil of steam. The shockwave edge carries Qinglei Jianzhu into a longer backward slide. She plants the sword tip against the street as a brake and stabilizes. End with Rongjia Yanjiang’s greataxe visibly buried in the ground. Use one impact shake on contact, then return to a stable frame. 18–25 seconds: Qinglei Jianzhu triggers her one signature move, “Qinglei Pozhen.” Blue-white current runs from the lightning motif on her right shoulder, down the arm, and into the straight sword; the lightning veins inside the blade intensify. Raindrops and shallow puddle water lift briefly into one thin ring around her without covering her face or body. Keep her fully visible as she makes one continuous, readable dash on a low arc, cutting in from outside Rongjia Yanjiang’s axe arm to his front-left. No teleport, clone, or second human silhouette. Rongjia Yanjiang tries to wrench the greataxe free, but the ground still holds it. Follow Qinglei Jianzhu from a rear three-quarter angle for a limited distance, keeping both full bodies and both weapons in frame throughout. 25–29 seconds: Qinglei Jianzhu exits the dash, plants cleanly, and completes one short upward sword recovery. The sword tip comes to a precise stop against the center crack in Rongjia Yanjiang’s square mask, making only light contact. Do not hit the greataxe again. On that exact contact beat, drop one vertical blue-white lightning bolt from the top of frame into the straight sword, then carry the charge through the tip into the boss’s mask and chest plate. Push the rain curtain and puddles outward in one ring. The dark-gold fissures in the black armor flash blue-white, then fade quickly. Build every effect from the sword-tip contact point. Keep Qinglei Jianzhu’s face, Rongjia Yanjiang’s mask, both characters’ hands, and both weapons unobscured and readable. 29–30 seconds: Let all intense light fall off quickly and let the rain resume falling naturally. Qinglei Jianzhu holds the final sword pose on screen left. Rongjia Yanjiang holds on screen right with the greataxe still buried in the ground. Neither character moves. Hold on a fully locked-off shot for at least one full second—no push-in, rotation, or drift. Build one continuous generated soundtrack, synced to picture: steady but restrained rain, low distant thunder, footsteps on wet flagstone, axe blade scraping on flagstone, the greataxe whoosh, one sword-to-axe metal hit, the greataxe impact, cracking stone, puddles surging outward, blue-white electrical current, and the vertical lightning strike. Underscore it with restrained low war drums. Every transient must land on the matching contact or landing beat. No dialogue, shouts, voice-over, lyrics, or chanting. Do not restart the ambience or score midway through the clip. Art direction: an original, Chinese-inspired dark-fantasy action-game aesthetic with realistic cinematic lighting, clearly rendered rain, and strong material definition for metal, leather, fabric, and wet flagstone. Keep exactly two characters. No face swaps, costume changes, location changes, scale changes, or changes in weapon count. No extra hands or feet, extra swords, extra greataxes, clones, summons, wings, aerial combos, or screen-filling particles. The straight sword and greataxe may not shorten, duplicate, morph, or pass through either body. No HUD, on-screen text, subtitles, or logos. No 360-degree orbit and no camera roll. Every camera move must resolve and lock at the end of its action beat.

スピードランプでラストスプリントへ SFX： 多層魔法詠唱、クリスタルベル、魔法爆発 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 0:21-0:27【クライマックス】 MAIN FX： 巨大衝撃波 最後の全力疾走。クリスタル尖塔へ跳躍し空中で一回転。着地と同時に杖を地面へ突き立て、都市全体へ巨大な魔力衝撃波が広がる。この瞬間のみ演出を最大化する。 CAMERA： 空中回転中はオービット → 着地後は都市全景へ大きく引く TRANSITION： ワイドショットを維持しながら衝撃波の光が徐々に消えていく SFX： 壮大な魔法クレッシェンド、クリスタル噴出音、オーケストラのインパクト ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 0:27-0:30【余韻】 MAIN FX： 残光のみ セレスティアは尖塔の頂上に静かに立ち、衝撃波から舞い降りる光の粒子がゆっくり降り注ぐ。タイトルやロゴを配置できる余白として使える締め。 CAMERA： ゆっくりとしたプッシュイン → 静止 SFX： 消えていくクリスタル共鳴、静かな魔力の余韻

This is a direct continuation that begins at the exact frame where @video1 ends — the same ride, the same day, the next stretch of desert. Every shot below is new material that happens after the source footage, not a retelling of it. Preserve exactly from @video1: the rider's identity, helmet and visor, black riding suit, gloves and boots; the hoverboard and its cyan underglow; the desert world, dune shapes and haze; the low golden sun and its direction; the colour grade; and the music, which continues unbroken in the same key, tempo and arrangement with no restart. CHARACTERS The rider: same man from @video1, full dark helmet with a clear visor and two white light strips, black armored riding suit, gloves, boots. Identical in every shot. He rides the same hoverboard, lit underneath by a continuous cyan strip. LOCATION MAP Foreground: open sand, wind-carved ripples, loose grit lifting off the crests. Midground: the ride path — dunes flattening into a cracked salt pan that runs into a post-apocalyptic ruin field of collapsed concrete slabs, leaning steel columns, half-buried vehicle hulls and broken roadway sections. Background: a low sandstone cliff wall on the far side of the ruins, and beyond it open sky with the sun sitting low on the horizon. The rider travels camera-left to camera-right in every lateral view. The sun stays low and ahead of him, camera-right, throughout. FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING Full-frame lateral profile close-up of the rider, 18°, camera tracking alongside him at his own speed, his helmet filling the right third of frame in sharp profile, dunes streaking past behind him, cyan board glow spilling up onto his boots from below. FORMAT MODE Timed multishot with HARD CUTS only at 4.0s, 8.0s, 12.0s, 15.0s, 19.0s, 23.5s and 27.0s. The camera cuts only at these points. Real-time playback everywhere except 19.0–23.5s, which is slow motion; the speed change happens only on those two hard cuts. STORYBOARD SHOT 1 (0.0–4.0s) Lateral profile close-up, 18°, camera tracking beside him at 60 km/h, level with his shoulder. Low sun rakes across the front of his visor from camera-right, leaving the far side of his helmet in deep shade. SHOT 2 (4.0–8.0s) HARD CUT to an extreme wide, 84°, camera high and static as he crosses the frame camera-left to camera-right at 60 km/h, a small figure with a cyan thread of light beneath him. Ahead of him the ruin field opens up — collapsed slabs and leaning steel standing as tall as six humans, throwing long shadows across the salt pan. SHOT 3 (8.0–12.0s) HARD CUT to a low tracking shot, 47°, camera 30 cm off the ground running with him at 70 km/h as he enters the ruins. He weaves between two leaning columns, board tilting hard onto its edge, a sheet of sand and grit fanning off the tail. Broken concrete passes close on both sides. Cyan underglow flares against the slab faces as he passes them. SHOT 4 (12.0–15.0s) HARD CUT to a medium shot from the front quarter, 29°, camera drifting backward ahead of him at 70 km/h. He drops into a deep drift, both arms out for balance, the board sliding sideways through a curve of debris, a long curtain of dust thrown out behind him and catching the low sun. His head stays locked on his line through the turn. SHOT 5 (15.0–19.0s) HARD CUT to a low rear three-quarter shot, 63°, camera accelerating with him from 70 to 110 km/h. He crouches, drives his weight forward, and the board's cyan strip brightens as it surges. Ahead of him a broken roadway section rises out of the sand at a shallow angle, its torn edge lifted clear of the ground. He hits it square and launches. SHOT 6 (19.0–23.5s) HARD CUT into SLOW MOTION. Wide side view, 47°, camera craning slowly upward with him against the low sun. He is airborne at the apex, board still under his feet, one hand gripping the front edge, knees folded. A full curtain of sand hangs suspended around and beneath him, every grain lit gold from camera-right and drifting rather than falling. The cyan glow underneath him rakes across the suspended sand. He lands hard, board slapping the sand and compressing, a burst of grit blowing outward from the impact, and he rides straight out of it at 110 km/h across the last open stretch toward the sandstone cliffs. The ruins fall away behind him. SHOT 8 (27.0–30.0s) HARD CUT to a lateral profile medium shot, 29°, camera settling alongside him and coming to rest as he does. He carves the board hard sideways and brakes, throwing a low wide sheet of sand forward and to camera-right, and stops at the cliff edge. He straightens up, squares his shoulders, and turns his helmet to face the sun sitting on the horizon. Held final frame: the rider in profile at the cliff edge, sand still settling around the board, the cyan glow steady beneath him, the sun low ahead of him. Restrained and controlled throughout — a rider who knows this ground. PHYSICS The board carries real mass and inertia. It leans into turns and rebounds on landing. Sand behaves as loose dry grain: it fans off the edge under load, hangs in a curtain in slow motion, blows outward in a burst on impact, and settles slowly at the end. Dust catches and scatters the low sun. Wind drags loose grit off the dune crests continuously. Debris in the ruins stays put; only sand and dust move. LIGHTING Fixed 3200K golden-hour sun, low on the horizon ahead of the rider and camera-right, unchanged in every shot. Hard warm key on the front of his suit and visor, deep shade on the far side, long shadows running away camera-left across the sand and the ruin floor. Airborne dust glows where it crosses the sun. Cyan board light acts as a cold practical from below, catching his boots, the sand under him and nearby slab faces. AUDIO The music from @video1 continues unbroken through the whole extension — same track, same key, same tempo, no restart and no new song. Under it: the low hum of the board, wind across open sand, grit spraying off the edge, concrete and steel echoing close in the ruins. At 19.0s the mix thins for the slow-motion shot — the music drops to a single sustained low note, and the suspended sand and the board's hum sit at the front. At 23.5s the full arrangement returns hard on the landing impact. In the final shot the music resolves and holds under open desert wind. No dialogue anywhere. They look down and realize the whole sheet is unstable and beginning to sink on one side. The crocodile circles around them in the water, occasionally brushing the edge and making the roof wobble. Shot 5, 19–24s: A rescue helicopter appears overhead through mist and rain haze. Rotor wash whips the floodwater and rattles the roof. The man and woman wave frantically with both hands, screaming for help. For the first time, hope enters the scene. Shot 6, 24–27s: The crocodile crashes into the roof again, much harder. Shot 7, 27–30s: The helicopter crew throws down a rescue ladder toward them. It swings wildly in the wind above the unstable roof. The camera holds tightly on the face of a young English woman. She is Caucasian, brunette, with delicate features and melancholy behind her eyes. She remains centered in frame and only sways subtly with the music. Around her, the crowd moves intensely and chaotically, with bodies, arms, shoulders and faces constantly passing close to camera, creating strong motion blur and a sense of pressure and overwhelm. Fast white strobe lights flash continuously, pushing the image back and forth between near-total darkness and sudden bursts of harsh illumination. In the darker intervals, only silhouettes, rim light, glints of sweat and fragmented movement are visible. Each flash briefly reveals fragments of her face—her eyes, cheekbones, wet strands of hair, and distant expression—before she disappears again into darkness. She feels strangely still and emotionally detached while the crowd around her becomes a mass of blurred bodies and flickering light. Heavy four-on-the-floor techno dominates the soundscape, loud, compressed and physically overwhelming. 8–16 seconds: She stays in this space for a moment longer, absorbing the intensity, then finally breaks her gaze, turns and begins pulling herself out of the crowd. The camera does not cut. It releases from the locked close-up and shifts into a close handheld follow shot, staying just behind and slightly beside her as she pushes through dancers. Bodies knock into her shoulders. Arms and backs occasionally obscure the frame. The camera feels intimate, bumped and instinctive, struggling through the same crowded space with her. As she leaves the center of the dancefloor, the strobing becomes less dominant and the club lighting grows dirtier and more practical. She enters a narrow back passage leading away from the main room. 16–23 seconds: She moves through a cramped, dirty corridor with graffiti-covered walls, peeling paint, torn posters, exposed pipes, damp patches, flickering fluorescent lights and littered plastic cups on the floor. People lean against the walls smoking, chatting, waiting, watching others pass. She threads through them silently. The camera stays close and observational, catching the rustle of fabric, brief shoulder contact and bodies slipping past in the narrow space. The music becomes more muffled and distant as she moves farther from the dancefloor. The heavy techno remains present only as a low, dulled throb through the walls. Footsteps, clothing friction, breathing, shuffling bodies and indistinct overlapping crowd chatter become clearer. No individual conversation is intelligible. She does not speak. 23–30 seconds: She pushes through the exit and steps into the cold London night. Outside the club, groups of people stand smoking, talking, drifting in and out of the entrance. Streetlight mixes with spill from the doorway and practical urban light. She walks to the nearest dirty exterior wall and pauses. With slightly shaky hands, she lights a cigarette. The flame briefly illuminates her face. She takes a drag, leans back against the wall, then slowly slides down into a seated position on the pavement. The camera follows her downward and settles at her level, then holds. She sits smoking in silence, looking past the moving crowd into the distance, disconnected from everything around her. People continue crossing the frame, talking, laughing and smoking nearby, but she feels completely alone inside the busy environment. The sound transitions from overwhelming club techno, to muffled bass and corridor ambience, to distant low-frequency vibration outside mixed with cigarette lighter clicks, breathing, street ambience, footsteps and indistinct smoker chatter. No dialogue. The overall image should feel raw, naturalistic and grounded, with visible film grain, slight exposure fluctuation, realistic skin texture and subtle handheld instability. Avoid glossy polish, commercial beauty lighting and music-video slickness.

items.prompt: 复制并生成 ↗ @mumaren_2 当前浏览器不支持视频播放 ▶ 提示词 日本のフルカラーアニメ映画風、シネマティックな高品質映像。 BGMなし、セリフなし、字幕なし、文字なし、環境音のみ。 # 映像スタイル 添付イラストのキャラクター本人感を最優先。 ネオレトロでフラットな2Dアニメ調。鮮やかなシアンブルーの輪郭線、ピンク系の髪と肌、やさしいパステルカラー。 ベタ塗り寄りで、過度な写実化・厚塗り・複雑な陰影は禁止。 キャラクターの顔立ち、髪型、体型、衣装、耳風アクセは変えない。 # 制約 全カットで画角とアングルを変えて単調にしない。 文字・ロゴは入れない。 過度にセクシーにせず、自然な生活感のある仕草にする。 # 登場人物 ## 女性 添付イラストの成人女性。 細身でしなやか、丸みのあるかわいいシルエット。 ピンクの短めボブ、丸いサイドの髪房、短い前髪。 左右に大きなクリーム色の丸い耳風ヘッドアクセ。 大きな青い瞳。 白いキャミソール、水色と白のボーダーショートパンツ、裸足。 深夜の部屋着姿。 # 情景 深夜のモダンなキッチン。大きな窓の外に夜景。 暖かい室内灯とコンロの弱火の灯りが混ざる。 湯気と甘い香りがただよう、静かで親密な深夜。 # シーン 深夜、女性が一人でとろとろの半熟スフレパンケーキを焼く。 Seedance2.5検証用に、料理の手順を30カットの密なマルチカットで見せる。 生地の膨らみ、ふるふる揺れる質感、粉砂糖とシロップの艶を丁寧に描く。 cut1: ワイド、斜め後方。冷蔵庫を開け、青白い光が白いキャミとピンク髪を照らす。卵を取り出す。 環境音：冷蔵庫のモーター音、夜の静けさ。 cut2: クローズアップ、俯瞰。卵を割り、白身と黄身を2つのボウルに分ける。 環境音：卵が割れる乾いた音。 cut3: クローズアップ、斜め上。黄身のボウルに薄力粉と牛乳を加え、泡立て器で混ぜる。 環境音：泡立て器がボウルを打つ軽やかな音。 cut4: クローズアップ、俯瞰。ハンドミキサーで白身を泡立て、真っ白なメレンゲが立ち上がる。 環境音：ミキサーの高い駆動音。 cut5: 超クローズアップ。泡立て器を持ち上げると、メレンゲの角がツンと立つ。 環境音：モーター音が止まり、静けさが戻る。 cut6: クローズアップ、斜め後方。髪を耳の横に整える。丸い耳風アクセが揺れる。 環境音：夜の静けさ、遠くの換気扇の音。 cut7: クローズアップ、俯瞰。メレンゲを黄身生地に3回に分けてさっくり混ぜ込む。 環境音：ゴムベラがボウルをこする音。 cut8: 超クローズアップ、床すれすれ。裸足がキッチンの床を歩く。 環境音：足音、夜の静けさ。 cut9: クローズアップ、斜め上。弱火のフライパンに生地をこんもりと落とす。 環境音：生地がフライパンに落ちるとろりとした音。 cut10: クローズアップ。フライパンに蓋をして、隙間から蒸気がふわりと立ちのぼる。 環境音：蓋を閉じる音、弱火のジリジリという音。 cut11: ミディアム、真後ろ。蒸し焼きを待つ後ろ姿。キャミの肩紐、ピンクのボブ、耳風アクセが見える。 環境音：フライパンの弱火の音。 cut12: クローズアップ、顔アップ。蓋の隙間から中をのぞき込み、頬が緩む。 環境音：かすかな蒸気の音。 cut13: クローズアップ、斜め上。生地の側面がぷっくりと膨らんでいく様子。 環境音：じわじわと膨らむ弱い蒸気音。 cut14: クローズアップ。フライ返しをそっと差し込み、生地を優しくひっくり返す。 環境音：フライ返しが生地の下に入る音。 cut15: クローズアップ、俯瞰。ひっくり返した瞬間、生地がふるんと大きく揺れる。 環境音：静かな余韻、ふるんと揺れる気配。 cut16: クローズアップ、斜め上。再び蓋をして、もう片面を蒸し焼きにする。 環境音：蓋を閉じる音、弱火の音。 cut17: ミディアム、正面やや斜め上。暑そうにキャミの裾を軽くつまんで空気を入れる。 環境音：遠くのフライパンの音。 cut18: クローズアップ、高角度。蓋を開けて出来上がりを確認し、満足げに微笑む。 環境音：蓋を開ける音、蒸気の抜ける音。 cut19: クローズアップ。フライ返しでそっとパンケーキを持ち上げ、皿へ滑らせる。 環境音：パンケーキが皿に触れる柔らかい音。 cut20: クローズアップ、俯瞰。2枚目、3枚目と同じ手順を早回しのように重ねて積み上げる。 環境音：フライパンの音がリズミカルに数回繰り返される。 cut21: クローズアップ。積み上がったパンケーキの高さに、目を丸くする。 環境音：夜の静けさ。 cut22: クローズアップ、斜め上。粉砂糖の缶を振り、雪のように振りかける。 環境音：粉砂糖がさらさらと落ちる音。 cut23: クローズアップ、俯瞰。バターの塊をパンケーキの頂上にちょこんとのせる。 環境音：バターが生地に触れる小さな音。 cut24: クローズアップ。溶けたバターがつやつやと側面を伝い落ちる。 環境音：静かな滴る音。 cut25: クローズアップ、斜め上。メープルシロップの瓶を傾け、とろりと円を描いて注ぐ。 環境音：シロップがとろりと流れる粘度のある音。 cut26: クローズアップ、顔アップ。垂れたシロップを指先でぬぐい、小さく舐める。 環境音：夜の静けさ。 cut27: ミディアム、正面。完成した皿を両手で持ち上げ、窓辺の夜景を背に掲げる。 環境音：遠くの夜景の静けさ。 cut28: クローズアップ。フォークで断面を切ると、ふるふると大きく揺れて沈み込む。 環境音：フォークが柔らかい生地に沈む音。 cut29: クローズアップ、顔アップ。一口食べて、目を閉じてとろけるような表情になる。 環境音：かすかな咀嚼音。 cut30: クローズアップ、浅い被写界深度。フォークを置き、満足げな吐息をこぼす。手が引き、皿だけが暖かい光の中に残る。 環境音：吐息が夜の静寂へフェードしていく。

動き：下唇を軽く歯で噛み、すぐに離す 質感・しっとり感：唇に薄い艶があり、肌全体が湿ったように微かに光る Cut6 1s 画角：ミディアムショット 構図：肩から胸元を中心に、肩紐が画面の焦点 カメラワーク：ゆっくりと右にパンしながらわずかに寄る ライティング：月光が肩に斜めに落ち、影が鎖骨を強調 動き：左手でキャミソールの肩紐を指先で軽くずらす 質感・しっとり感：目元と頬に薄い汗の光沢、肌がしっとりと湿った感じ Cut9 1s 画角：ミディアムショット（胸から上） 構図：胸元をやや下から見上げるローアングル気味 カメラワーク：固定、息に合わせてごくわずかに上下 ライティング：月光が鎖骨と胸の谷間に落ち、影が深くなる 動き：深く息を吐き、胸がゆっくり上下する 質感・しっとり感：肌全体に薄い汗の膜、特に鎖骨周りがしっとりと光る Cut10 カメラワーク：ゆっくりと右回りに弧を描くように移動 ライティング：背中に月光が当たり、腰の曲線に影 動き：腰をわずかにひねり、鏡で後ろ姿を確認する 質感・しっとり感：背中と腰の肌が湿って光り、ネグリジェが肌に張り付く質感 Cut12 1s 画角：超クローズアップ 構図：鎖骨を斜めに横切る指先が中央 カメラワーク：固定、フォーカスが指先にピント 質感・しっとり感：目元の肌が湿ったように微かに光り、まつ毛に細い光が乗る Cut14 1s 画角：ミディアムショット 構図：体を反らした上半身が斜め構図、胸から腰のライン強調 カメラワーク：ゆっくりと下から上へティルト ライティング：月光が体の前面に当たり、曲線を立体的に見せる 動き：軽く後ろに体を反らし、伸びをする 質感・しっとり感：伸ばした瞬間に肌が張り、汗の膜で全体がしっとりと光る items.prompt: 复制并生成 ↗ @M1RA_A_Project 当前浏览器不支持视频播放 ▶ 提示词 キャンバス上にある情報を全て使い、以下の内容の動画を作って。 （以下） Seedance 2.5用プロンプト｜占獣・一人芝居版 生成目的 参照画像50枚を用い、約15.18秒、16:9の高品質な日本製2Dセルカラーアニメーションを生成する。元プレビズの編集点、カメラ軸、画角、被写体サイズ、手の軌道、札の位置、廊下の消失点、動作の緩急を維持しながら、登場人物をオリジナル作品『占獣 / SENJYU』の主人公・我妻學へ置換する。 この映像に存在する人間は我妻學ただ一人である。敵役、対戦相手、廊下奥の人物、分身、残像、影人間、鏡像、反射内の人物、背後の人物、観客、通行人を一切生成しない。前半の正面顔、手元、背面、後半の廊下内の背面人物は、すべて同一時刻の同一人物・我妻學である。カメラが切り替わっただけであり、二人が向かい合っている場面ではない。無人廊下の奥には何者も存在しない。 参照画像の読み方 Image 1〜24はセルカラーの時間順キー画像。Image 25〜48はImage 1〜24と同一番号で対になる深度マップ。Image 49は我妻學のキャラクター固定資料。Image 50は占術札の固定資料。 各カラー画像と深度画像は必ず一対として扱う。カラー画像から顔、衣装、線、色、札の意匠、背景素材を取得し、同番号の深度画像から前後関係、被写体距離、手と顔の重なり、札同士の奥行き、廊下の消失点を取得する。深度画像の白は近景、黒は遠景。深度画像の無彩色を完成映像の色として採用しない。 キャラクター固定 我妻學は小学生男子。短く乱れた黒髪、鮮やかな青い瞳、少年らしい小柄で細身の体格。濃紺の半袖夏制服、白いパイピング、濃紺の短パン。すべてのカットで顔、年齢、髪型、目の色、体格、袖丈、襟、服の配色を固定する。成人化、長身化、筋肉質化、別人化、女性化を禁止。手前に大きく写る手も必ず學本人の手であり、第三者の手ではない。手指は片手につき5本。手首、肘、肩の接続を自然に保ち、指の増殖、癒着、欠損、左右反転を避ける。 占術札固定 トランプではなく『占獣』独自の占術札。黒藍色の薄い長方形、細いシアン発光縁、九星・羅針盤・星図を抽象化した幾何学意匠。ハート、スペード、ダイヤ、クラブ、ジョーカー、数字、英字、読める文字、既存カードゲームの記号を表示しない。札は硬質な紙または薄い術式媒体として扱い、ゴムのように曲げない。浮遊時は各札が独立した平面を保ち、互いに貫通しない。発光は輪郭と術式線に限定し、画面全体をネオンで白飛びさせない。 映像スタイル 完成された劇場品質の2Dセルアニメ。鮮明で整理された線画、2〜3段階のセル影、抑制された濃紺・青緑・シアンの色設計。写真、実写、3DCGレンダー、ゲーム画面、モーションコミック、ラフ絵、鉛筆線へ変化させない。背景は暗い施設廊下だが黒潰れさせず、壁、床、扉、天井灯、奥行きを読める状態にする。被写界深度は強くしすぎず、参照キーにある手、顔、札の輪郭を維持する。 ショット構成 Shot 01｜0.000〜0.346秒｜極端な顔寄り Image 1からImage 2へ。學の片目、顔の一部、上げた手を極端な近距離で捉える。カメラ位置を動かさず、呼吸と視線の微細な緊張だけを補間する。手前の手は學本人の手。別人物のPOVや、誰かが顔を覆っている構図に解釈しない。Image 2の直後にハードカット。 Shot 02｜0.346〜1.093秒｜占術札の手元 Image 3からImage 4へ。札群と學の手だけを俯瞰寄りで映す。人物の顔や別の身体を追加しない。手の圧と術式反応によって札の重なりがわずかに変化する。札は同じデザイン、同じ枚数感、同じ平面性を維持。次ショットへハードカット。 Shot 03｜1.093〜4.042秒｜正面で札を制御 Image 5→6→7→8。正面寄りの學が、顔の横に掲げた札を指先で制御し、手首を下げ、指を組み替え、解放直前の形へ移行する。カメラは基本固定。學の頭部位置と肩線を安定させ、手だけが弧を描いて動く。Image 5〜8のポーズ間を滑らかに補間するが、過剰な中割りで手をぐにゃぐにゃ変形させない。表情は冷静で集中。口パクなし。 Shot 04｜4.042〜4.768秒｜札群の空間展開 Image 9からImage 10へ。人物は画面に存在せず、占術札だけが暗い空間に複数の距離層で浮遊する。札の移動は小さく鋭い。各札の前後関係は対応深度に従う。新しい札を無制限に増やさない。画面中央に敵や召喚獣を出さない。 Shot 05｜4.768〜6.621秒｜背面から右手操作 Image 11→12→13。學を背後から捉える。右肩、前腕、手首、指先が連動し、空中の札を整列させる。背後に見えるのは無人空間と札だけ。正面にもう一人の學を置かない。背中、首、右肩の接続を固定し、腕の長さを変えない。カメラは固定し、微細なプッシュインのみ許可。 Shot 06｜6.621〜7.605秒｜正面の腕・拳 Image 14→15→16。ハードカットで正面へ戻り、學が腕を伸ばした状態から指を巻き込み、拳を上げる。右手の軌道、顔の中心位置、肩幅を参照どおりに維持。拳は顔を完全に隠さない。決意は目線と手の収束で表現し、叫びや口パクを追加しない。 Shot 07｜7.605〜8.642秒｜デジタル表示 Image 17からImage 18へ。壁面表示だけのインサート。人間、手、影、反射を追加しない。表示面は同一位置で、発光の変化だけを見せる。画面上に字幕、UI、説明文、ロゴを追加しない。表示を読ませることより、緊張の時間圧を伝える。 Shot 08｜8.642〜10.028秒｜無人廊下への前進 Image 19からImage 20へ。完全に無人の長い廊下。中央消失点へ向かう直線的で高速なドリーイン。扉、天井灯、床線の間隔が物理的に縮まり、正しい遠近法で加速を示す。廊下奥に人物、標的、怪物、影を生成しない。左右へ蛇行、ロール、手持ち揺れを加えない。 Shot 09｜10.028〜15.148秒｜背面投擲 Image 21→22→23→24。無人廊下の手前に學一人だけが背中を向けて立つ。開始時に右肩と前腕で投擲準備。次に複数の占術札を片手の周囲へ浮上させ、両腕のバランスを取りながら投擲方向を定める。札が腕の振りと同期して無人廊下の消失点へ高速移動し、最後は學が腕を伸ばしたフォロースルーで終える。札は画面奥へ小さくなり、正しい遠近縮小とモーションブラーを持つ。札が向かう先に人物や標的を出さない。學の身体は一体のみで、残像による複数腕や複数身体を作らない。 編集・時間・カメラ 総尺は元動画と同等の約15.18秒。9つの編集ショットはすべてハードカットで接続し、異なるアングル間をモーフィングしない。各ショット内部のみSTART→ACTION KEY→ENDを補間する。カメラ移動を許可するのは、Shot 08の直線ドリーインと、参照から読み取れるごく小さな寄りのみ。勝手な旋回、360度回転、オービット、魚眼化、ズームアウト、別アングル追加を禁止。廊下の左右反転を禁止。 動作と物理 人物の重心、肩から肘、肘から手首、手首から指の連鎖を保つ。札が手を貫通しない。札同士が融合しない。札は投擲方向へ速度を得た後、慣性に従って廊下奥へ進む。発光軌跡は短く、札の数を誤認させる長い残像を作らない。髪、襟、袖には動作に応じた最小限の追従を付ける。床接地が見える場合は足を滑らせない。 絶対除外 二人目の人物、敵、対戦相手、廊下奥の人影、同じ學の複製、黒い分身、幽霊、残像人物、鏡像、反射人物、群衆、手だけの第三者、別キャラクター、成人、女性、顔の変化、衣装変更、長袖化、別制服、トランプ、ハート、スペード、ダイヤ、クラブ、既存カードゲーム、銃、ナイフ、剣、流血、接触戦、人物への攻撃、召喚獣、字幕、台詞テロップ、ロゴ、透かし、読める文章、画面分割、絵コンテ枠、参照番号表示、低解像度、実写、3DCG、粘土質、過度なグロー、色飛び、黒潰れ、指の増殖、腕の増殖、身体の複製、顔の溶解、札の融合、背景のワープ、廊下の左右反転。 最終到達像 完成映像は、我妻學一人が占術札を静かに支配し、無人の長い廊下へ一斉投擲する、一人芝居の高速アクションである。人物同士の戦闘にはしない。元プレビズのショット順、カメラ軸、動作ピーク、時間圧を保ちつつ、すべてを『占獣』固有のセルカラー世界へ変換する。

故事发生在暴雨深夜的一座废弃山寺。青石庭院积满雨水，屋檐不断滴水，破损灯笼在风中摇晃，暖黄色火光与冷蓝色月光形成强烈对比。男主约三十岁，黑发高束，穿深靛蓝色窄袖短袍、黑色长裤和旧皮护腕，身形精悍，神情冷静，右手握一把带有磨损痕迹的窄刃长刀。二十余名蒙面敌人穿统一黑色夜行衣，从山门、回廊和屋顶逐渐包围男主，分别使用短刀、长枪、铁棍和锁链。所有人物外形、服装、兵器、伤势和位置前后保持一致，敌人数量随着战斗逐渐减少，不得凭空增加。 15-30秒：四名持短刀敌人从正面和两侧同时夹击。镜头采用贴身手持跟拍，男主侧身避开第一刀，用刀鞘撞开第二人的手腕，反手拔刀格挡第三人的横斩，金属碰撞迸出短促火星。他不做多余动作，连续使用肩撞、肘击、扫腿和刀背重击，将三名敌人迅速击倒。第四名敌人从背后扑来，男主听到脚步声，低头避开刀锋，转身用刀柄击中对方面部，再借对方身体挡住迎面刺来的长枪。镜头绕男主半圈，其他敌人立刻收紧包围，没有停下来等待。 30-45秒：六名长枪敌人组成半圆枪阵，同时向男主逼近，枪尖不断封锁他的退路。男主没有正面硬拼，而是快速退向庭院狭窄石阶，引诱枪阵收缩。第一排长枪同时刺出时，他踩着湿滑石阶侧身滑下，刀锋由下向上连续斩断两根枪杆，随后抓住断裂枪杆向侧面拨打，令另外三支长枪互相碰撞。他踩上一尊倾斜的石狮，借高度越过低扫的枪杆，落下时以膝撞击倒一名枪手。镜头从低角度跟随落地动作，雨水被双脚猛烈溅开。 45-60秒：屋顶上的敌人突然跃下，前后夹击男主。镜头迅速仰拍，两道黑影穿过灯笼和雨幕落向庭院。男主翻身滚过地面，刀锋贴着敌人的靴底掠过，顺势来到回廊入口。他利用廊柱阻挡多人围攻，让敌人无法同时展开。两名敌人一左一右贴近，男主用刀背压住左侧短刀，抬腿踢中右侧敌人的膝弯，再借廊柱反弹转身，将左侧敌人撞进后方人群。一个灯笼被刀锋割断，从空中落下，在积水中熄灭，画面短暂陷入半明半暗。 60-75秒：战斗进入第一次高潮。剩余敌人分成前后两队，在回廊中高速追击男主。镜头采用侧面长距离跟拍，男主一边后退一边格挡连续刀击，刀锋、雨水和火星在画面中交错。他突然踢翻长凳，迫使前排敌人跳跃躲避，自己从长凳下方滑过，起身后连续击中两人的腰腹和手腕。另一名敌人从柱后偷袭，男主用左手抓住对方持刀手臂，将其带向廊柱，迫使刀锋嵌入木柱，再用肩膀将其撞倒。动作紧凑、真实、清晰，不出现无意义旋转。 75-90秒：山门外的弩手突然射击。弩箭穿过雨幕击碎回廊木窗，男主迅速掀起一张木桌作为盾牌。镜头紧贴木桌另一侧，数支弩箭接连穿透桌面，箭头距离男主面部只有几厘米。男主顶着木桌向前冲撞，将两名敌人压倒在台阶上，随后把木桌推向弩手方向，趁遮挡翻滚进入大殿。敌人紧随其后冲进殿内。最后一支弩箭擦过男主左肩，划破衣袖，留下明显但不过度血腥的伤口。从此刻开始，男主左臂活动受到轻微影响，呼吸逐渐沉重。 90-105秒：大殿内部空间狭窄，残破佛像和木柱形成复杂障碍。一个身材魁梧的敌人挥舞铁棍迎面砸下，男主横刀抵挡，却被巨大力量震退，长刀脱手滑到佛像台阶下。魁梧敌人连续挥棍横扫，男主俯身闪避，铁棍击碎木柱表面。男主贴近对方，让长兵器无法发挥，用掌根、肘击和膝撞连续攻击对方胸腹，然后抓住铁棍中段借力旋转，将魁梧敌人摔过肩膀，砸碎旁边长桌。男主没有时间拾刀，只能夺下一根断裂枪杆作为短棍迎敌。 105-120秒：四名敌人在大殿中同时围攻。男主使用断枪进行近身棍法，挡住两把短刀，利用枪杆两端分别打击敌人的手腕、喉前和膝盖。镜头在木柱之间快速横移，通过柱子遮挡完成自然转场。男主故意露出破绽，引诱两名敌人同时进攻，最后一刻侧身闪开，让二人的兵器互相卡住。他用断枪横扫二人腿部，再踩住掉落的短刀，将短刀踢到手中。另一名敌人从佛像上方扑下，男主举起短刀格挡，巨大的冲击让两人同时摔出殿门，重新落入暴雨庭院。 120-135秒：男主在积水中翻滚起身，敌人首领终于从回廊阴影中走出。首领身材高瘦，使用一把带锁链的弯刃，动作冷静而危险。剩余敌人退到四周封锁出口。首领甩动锁链，弯刃贴着地面划过，激起一道水浪。男主连续后退闪避，弯刃缠住他的短刀并猛然拉走。首领第二次甩出锁链，缠住男主脚踝，将他拖倒在湿滑地面。男主在被拖动过程中抓住一块破碎瓦片，割开缠绕脚踝的布带，翻身避开从上方劈落的弯刃。弯刃重重砸进青石地面，火星和雨水同时炸开。 135-150秒：三名剩余敌人趁男主倒地同时冲来。男主已经疲惫，左肩受伤，动作明显不再轻松。他故意保持半跪姿势，引诱第一人靠近，突然抓住对方手腕，将其带入首领再次甩来的锁链轨迹。锁链缠住敌人的兵器，造成短暂混乱。男主利用湿滑地面低身旋转扫腿，使另外两人失去平衡，再用刀鞘和拳肘连续击倒。最后一名敌人试图从背后刺击，男主在积水倒影中看见对方，头也不回地向后撞肘，随后转身用掌根将其击倒。庭院里只剩男主与首领相对而立。 150-165秒：最终决斗。雷声骤然炸响，首领抽回锁链弯刃，发动连续快速攻击。镜头在广角全景和刀锋特写之间切换：弯刃横扫、锁链回旋、男主侧闪、格挡、翻滚，每一次动作都清晰连贯。男主捡回落在庭院边缘的长刀，用刀身缠住锁链，却被首领猛力拉近。两人在极近距离展开拳肘搏斗，首领击中男主伤肩，男主痛苦后退，长刀再次险些脱手。首领高举弯刃完成最后一击时，画面短暂升格，男主没有后退，而是突然向前贴身进入锁链内圈，用护腕架开首领手臂，以刀柄重击其胸口。 165-180秒：恢复正常速度。首领踉跄后退仍想挥刀，男主踩住落在积水中的锁链，旋身夺下弯刃，再用长刀精准架在首领颈侧，动作突然停止。雨声重新变得清晰，首领手中的兵器缓缓掉落，跪倒在地。男主没有补刀，只是收刀入鞘。镜头缓慢拉远，庭院中敌人全部失去战斗能力，兵器散落在雨水里，没有血腥特写。男主扶着受伤的左肩穿过山门，破晓的微光从远处云层后出现。最后一个镜头停留在积水中的刀痕和逐渐平静的波纹上，远处传来男主渐行渐远的脚步声，画面自然淡出。 镜头要求：整段战斗保持明确的空间方向和人物位置，使用大远景交代战场，中近景呈现攻防动作，适量使用贴身手持跟拍、低角度跟拍、环绕移动、遮挡转场和关键动作升格；不要频繁无意义快切，不要让镜头晃动到看不清动作。敌人必须采取包围、夹击、枪阵、远程掩护和多人协同，不能排队等待男主逐个攻击。男主通过地形、廊柱、石阶、长凳、木桌和敌人之间的位置关系化解人数劣势。 声音设计：全程保留真实暴雨声、雷声、急促脚步声、衣料摩擦声、呼吸声、刀剑碰撞声、木材碎裂声和兵器落地声。配乐以前半段低沉鼓点和弦乐持续积累，中段加入快速鼓点，最终决斗时音乐达到高潮；首领跪倒后音乐立刻停止，只保留雨声和脚步声。 禁止出现：仙术、飞行、能量波、武器发光、夸张爆炸、血腥肢解、现代物品、字幕、文字、LOGO和水印；禁止人物脸部突变、服装变化、额外肢体、兵器凭空出现或消失、敌人数量突然增加、同一个敌人重复出现、动作穿模、无重力漂浮、连续无意义空翻以及男主毫发无伤。整段必须像一场真正拍摄完成、叙事清楚、动作连贯、逐步升级的3分钟电影级武打戏。

45-60秒：屋顶上的敌人突然跃下，前后夹击男主。镜头迅速仰拍，两道黑影穿过灯笼和雨幕落向庭院。男主翻身滚过地面，刀锋贴着敌人的靴底掠过，顺势来到回廊入口。他利用廊柱阻挡多人围攻，让敌人无法同时展开。两名敌人一左一右贴近，男主用刀背压住左侧短刀，抬腿踢中右侧敌人的膝弯，再借廊柱反弹转身，将左侧敌人撞进后方人群。一个灯笼被刀锋割断，从空中落下，在积水中熄灭，画面短暂陷入半明半暗。 75-90秒：山门外的弩手突然射击。弩箭穿过雨幕击碎回廊木窗，男主迅速掀起一张木桌作为盾牌。镜头紧贴木桌另一侧，数支弩箭接连穿透桌面，箭头距离男主面部只有几厘米。男主顶着木桌向前冲撞，将两名敌人压倒在台阶上，随后把木桌推向弩手方向，趁遮挡翻滚进入大殿。敌人紧随其后冲进殿内。最后一支弩箭擦过男主左肩，划破衣袖，留下明显但不过度血腥的伤口。从此刻开始，男主左臂活动受到轻微影响，呼吸逐渐沉重。 90-105秒：大殿内部空间狭窄，残破佛像和木柱形成复杂障碍。一个身材魁梧的敌人挥舞铁棍迎面砸下，男主横刀抵挡，却被巨大力量震退，长刀脱手滑到佛像台阶下。魁梧敌人连续挥棍横扫，男主俯身闪避，铁棍击碎木柱表面。男主贴近对方，让长兵器无法发挥，用掌根、肘击和膝撞连续攻击对方胸腹，然后抓住铁棍中段借力旋转，将魁梧敌人摔过肩膀，砸碎旁边长桌。男主没有时间拾刀，只能夺下一根断裂枪杆作为短棍迎敌。 105-120秒：四名敌人在大殿中同时围攻。男主使用断枪进行近身棍法，挡住两把短刀，利用枪杆两端分别打击敌人的手腕、喉前和膝盖。镜头在木柱之间快速横移，通过柱子遮挡完成自然转场。男主故意露出破绽，引诱两名敌人同时进攻，最后一刻侧身闪开，让二人的兵器互相卡住。他用断枪横扫二人腿部，再踩住掉落的短刀，将短刀踢到手中。另一名敌人从佛像上方扑下，男主举起短刀格挡，巨大的冲击让两人同时摔出殿门，重新落入暴雨庭院。 120-135秒：男主在积水中翻滚起身，敌人首领终于从回廊阴影中走出。首领身材高瘦，使用一把带锁链的弯刃，动作冷静而危险。剩余敌人退到四周封锁出口。首领甩动锁链，弯刃贴着地面划过，激起一道水浪。男主连续后退闪避，弯刃缠住他的短刀并猛然拉走。首领第二次甩出锁链，缠住男主脚踝，将他拖倒在湿滑地面。男主在被拖动过程中抓住一块破碎瓦片，割开缠绕脚踝的布带，翻身避开从上方劈落的弯刃。弯刃重重砸进青石地面，火星和雨水同时炸开。 135-150秒：三名剩余敌人趁男主倒地同时冲来。男主已经疲惫，左肩受伤，动作明显不再轻松。他故意保持半跪姿势，引诱第一人靠近，突然抓住对方手腕，将其带入首领再次甩来的锁链轨迹。锁链缠住敌人的兵器，造成短暂混乱。男主利用湿滑地面低身旋转扫腿，使另外两人失去平衡，再用刀鞘和拳肘连续击倒。最后一名敌人试图从背后刺击，男主在积水倒影中看见对方，头也不回地向后撞肘，随后转身用掌根将其击倒。庭院里只剩男主与首领相对而立。 150-165秒：最终决斗。雷声骤然炸响，首领抽回锁链弯刃，发动连续快速攻击。镜头在广角全景和刀锋特写之间切换：弯刃横扫、锁链回旋、男主侧闪、格挡、翻滚，每一次动作都清晰连贯。男主捡回落在庭院边缘的长刀，用刀身缠住锁链，却被首领猛力拉近。两人在极近距离展开拳肘搏斗，首领击中男主伤肩，男主痛苦后退，长刀再次险些脱手。首领高举弯刃完成最后一击时，画面短暂升格，男主没有后退，而是突然向前贴身进入锁链内圈，用护腕架开首领手臂，以刀柄重击其胸口。 165-180秒：恢复正常速度。首领踉跄后退仍想挥刀，男主踩住落在积水中的锁链，旋身夺下弯刃，再用长刀精准架在首领颈侧，动作突然停止。雨声重新变得清晰，首领手中的兵器缓缓掉落，跪倒在地。男主没有补刀，只是收刀入鞘。镜头缓慢拉远，庭院中敌人全部失去战斗能力，兵器散落在雨水里，没有血腥特写。男主扶着受伤的左肩穿过山门，破晓的微光从远处云层后出现。最后一个镜头停留在积水中的刀痕和逐渐平静的波纹上，远处传来男主渐行渐远的脚步声，画面自然淡出。 镜头要求：整段战斗保持明确的空间方向和人物位置，使用大远景交代战场，中近景呈现攻防动作，适量使用贴身手持跟拍、低角度跟拍、环绕移动、遮挡转场和关键动作升格；不要频繁无意义快切，不要让镜头晃动到看不清动作。敌人必须采取包围、夹击、枪阵、远程掩护和多人协同，不能排队等待男主逐个攻击。男主通过地形、廊柱、石阶、长凳、木桌和敌人之间的位置关系化解人数劣势。 声音设计：全程保留真实暴雨声、雷声、急促脚步声、衣料摩擦声、呼吸声、刀剑碰撞声、木材碎裂声和兵器落地声。配乐以前半段低沉鼓点和弦乐持续积累，中段加入快速鼓点，最终决斗时音乐达到高潮；首领跪倒后音乐立刻停止，只保留雨声和脚步声。 禁止出现：仙术、飞行、能量波、武器发光、夸张爆炸、血腥肢解、现代物品、字幕、文字、LOGO和水印；禁止人物脸部突变、服装变化、额外肢体、兵器凭空出现或消失、敌人数量突然增加、同一个敌人重复出现、动作穿模、无重力漂浮、连续无意义空翻以及男主毫发无伤。整段必须像一场真正拍摄完成、叙事清楚、动作连贯、逐步升级的3分钟电影级武打戏。

150-165秒：最终决斗。雷声骤然炸响，首领抽回锁链弯刃，发动连续快速攻击。镜头在广角全景和刀锋特写之间切换：弯刃横扫、锁链回旋、男主侧闪、格挡、翻滚，每一次动作都清晰连贯。男主捡回落在庭院边缘的长刀，用刀身缠住锁链，却被首领猛力拉近。两人在极近距离展开拳肘搏斗，首领击中男主伤肩，男主痛苦后退，长刀再次险些脱手。首领高举弯刃完成最后一击时，画面短暂升格，男主没有后退，而是突然向前贴身进入锁链内圈，用护腕架开首领手臂，以刀柄重击其胸口。 165-180秒：恢复正常速度。首领踉跄后退仍想挥刀，男主踩住落在积水中的锁链，旋身夺下弯刃，再用长刀精准架在首领颈侧，动作突然停止。雨声重新变得清晰，首领手中的兵器缓缓掉落，跪倒在地。男主没有补刀，只是收刀入鞘。镜头缓慢拉远，庭院中敌人全部失去战斗能力，兵器散落在雨水里，没有血腥特写。男主扶着受伤的左肩穿过山门，破晓的微光从远处云层后出现。最后一个镜头停留在积水中的刀痕和逐渐平静的波纹上，远处传来男主渐行渐远的脚步声，画面自然淡出。 镜头要求：整段战斗保持明确的空间方向和人物位置，使用大远景交代战场，中近景呈现攻防动作，适量使用贴身手持跟拍、低角度跟拍、环绕移动、遮挡转场和关键动作升格；不要频繁无意义快切，不要让镜头晃动到看不清动作。敌人必须采取包围、夹击、枪阵、远程掩护和多人协同，不能排队等待男主逐个攻击。男主通过地形、廊柱、石阶、长凳、木桌和敌人之间的位置关系化解人数劣势。 声音设计：全程保留真实暴雨声、雷声、急促脚步声、衣料摩擦声、呼吸声、刀剑碰撞声、木材碎裂声和兵器落地声。配乐以前半段低沉鼓点和弦乐持续积累，中段加入快速鼓点，最终决斗时音乐达到高潮；首领跪倒后音乐立刻停止，只保留雨声和脚步声。 禁止出现：仙术、飞行、能量波、武器发光、夸张爆炸、血腥肢解、现代物品、字幕、文字、LOGO和水印；禁止人物脸部突变、服装变化、额外肢体、兵器凭空出现或消失、敌人数量突然增加、同一个敌人重复出现、动作穿模、无重力漂浮、连续无意义空翻以及男主毫发无伤。整段必须像一场真正拍摄完成、叙事清楚、动作连贯、逐步升级的3分钟电影级武打戏。

items.prompt: 复制并生成 ↗ @SeiraHisada 当前浏览器不支持视频播放 ▶ 提示词 ジャパニーズホラーの空気感。彩度を落とした病的な緑と灰色のアンダートーンによるカラーグレーディング。腰から上のトラッキングショットのワンカット長回し。青いストライプのボタンダウンシャツにカーキのチノパンを着た少年が、霧に沈んだ静まり返った日本の田舎の集落の通りを走っている。少年の顔は静かな恐怖に震え、目には今にもこぼれそうな涙が光り、口は声にならない嗚咽をこらえるように薄く開いている。カメラはゆっくりとした意図的な手持ちの動きで少年に寄り添うように漂う。集落は不気味なほど静か。濃い白い霧が家々の間に低く垂れ込め、すべての音を吸い込んでいる。通りのあちこちに、苔・蔦・絡まった緑の葉で全身が覆われた人型の存在が、ゆっくりと硬直したゾンビのような歩き方で、濡れた路面に足を引きずりながら歩いている。その動きは機械的で不自然。一部は少年が通り過ぎると顔のない苔の頭をゆっくりと回し、別の個体は不気味な遅延動作で蔦の腕を伸ばす。音楽はなし、濡れた足音とかすかな水滴の音だけ。少年は通りの植物人間をすり抜け、木造家屋の間の狭い路地へ入る。カメラは薄暗い通路を追う。路地にも数体の植物人間が同じ遅いゾンビ歩きでのろのろと移動しており、苔むしたシルエットが薄暗い中で黒い木の壁と見分けがつかない。少年は脇をすり抜け、必死に日本家屋の引き戸を押し開けて中に入る。カメラは室内へ続く——薄暗い和風建築の内部が一瞬映る。板張りの廊下がまっすぐ奥へ伸び、両側の部屋は開いた襖の向こうに畳の間が見え、壁には黒カビのシミ、あらゆる表面に湿気が光り腐敗を暗示する。廊下や部屋の中を植物人間が同じ硬直したゾンビ歩きでゆっくりと移動している。苔の体がほぼ暗闇の中で蠢く。少年はすぐに奥の出口を見つける——廊下の突き当たりの木の戸。軋む板張りの廊下を駆け抜ける。廊下にいた植物人間がゆっくりと体を回し、少年が通り過ぎる際に苔の腕を伸ばす。少年は裏手の戸を引き開け、家の裏の灰色の曇天の下に広がる畑へとよろめき出る。カメラは地面近くまで下がり、ニンジンの葉や大根の葉の列の間から向こう側を覗く。背景に少年が畑を横切って走る姿が霧の中にぼんやり見える。長く居心地の悪い間。やがて手前の葉が震え始める——激しくではなく、ゆっくりと忍び寄るような震え。暗く湿った土の中から、実物と同じサイズの大根・ニンジン・カブが、腕や脚のような根の形をして音もなく地面から這い出してくる——どれも拳ひとつ分から前腕ほどの実際の野菜の大きさ。最初はゆっくりと現れ、青白い体から土がぼろぼろと崩れ落ち、やがて速度を上げて土の上をよちよちと歩き出す。囁きと叫びの間のような細く甲高いキーキー音を発する。畑のあらゆる畝から数百体が姿を現す。カメラがゆっくりと上がり少年を捉える。少年は立ち止まっている。足元を見下ろす。表情が困惑から純粋な恐怖へと変わる。小さな根菜たちが足元に群がり、何十本ものニンジン・白い大根・丸いカブが靴にしがみつきズボンの裾をよじ登る。少年は震えながら振り払おうとするが、四方八方からさらに押し寄せる——キーキー鳴く小さな野菜の潮流が黒い土の上を流れるように少年へ向かってくる。少年は膝をつく。カメラがゆっくりと安定した軌道で少年を中心に回り始める。Jホラー映画のような冷静な客観性をもって。根菜たちが細い鳴き声の合間の沈黙の中で積み重なっていく——胴体をよじ登り、腕をつかみ、肩と背中に群がる。少年の嗚咽が空っぽの畑に響く。少年は仰向けに倒れ込み、まだ弱々しく根菜を押し返そうとしている。カメラは急がない軌道で回り続け、根菜が層を成して少年を埋めていく——脚が消え、胸が覆われ、腕が飲み込まれる。叫びがくぐもり、やがて無音になる。青いストライプシャツの最後の一片が、数百体の小さな野菜が蠢く塚の下に消える。カメラが緩やかにやや高い位置へと上昇する——真俯瞰ではなく、軽いハイアングルで脈打つ根菜の塚を見下ろす。この視点から畑の全体が四方に広がる。あらゆる畝、あらゆる溝から、無数の小さな根菜——ニンジン、大根、カブ——が根の足で土から出てきて、中央の塚に向かって静かに途切れることなく行進を続けている。果てしない、音のない行列。音響：濡れた足音、水滴、木の軋み、かすかな風、遠い囁きのように層を成す細い甲高い鳴き声、土が静かに裂ける音、少年の叫びがくぐもった沈黙へと消えていく、土の上を根が這う静かなざわめき。

She slowly raises her sword and prepares for battle. 3–4 seconds — Dinosaur Reveal: Suddenly, a massive realistic T-Rex emerges from behind the jungle trees and roars aggressively. Strong cinematic camera movement follows the sword. 8–10 seconds — Epic Jump: The dinosaur attacks again. The girl jumps onto a large fallen tree and then leaps into the air above the dinosaur. Her hair and clothing move naturally in slow motion. Camera rotates around her as she raises the sword for the final strike. 10–12 seconds — Final Strike: She lands a powerful cinematic sword strike against the dinosaur's armored hide. No dialogue. Do not include text, captions, logos, watermarks, brand names, duplicated spectators, warped faces, extra fingers, changing clothing, inconsistent body size, floating objects, rubbery metal, impossible physics, sudden camera teleportation, or artificial slow motion. The final result must look photographic, grounded, spontaneous, and genuinely filmed at a live competition.

items.prompt: 复制并生成视频 ↗ @AmControo 当前浏览器不支持视频播放 ▶ 提示词 15 seconds, 16:9 landscape video. Blend authentic handheld live-action footage of a cluttered bedroom workspace with rough frame-by-frame 2D crayon, colored-pencil, marker, and torn-paper animation. The concept is cute, absurd, relatable, and emotionally healing: a nearly empty computer battery icon refuses to keep working, escapes from the laptop, and takes a tiny “recharge vacation” through the real room before returning fully energized. The real environment is a slightly messy bedroom office at late afternoon. Visible objects include a real laptop, wireless mouse, charging cable, ceramic mug, notebook, pencils, desk lamp, small potted plant, rolling desk chair, window, curtains, bed, pillow, and a wall outlet. Warm natural window light mixes imperfectly with the laptop screen and desk lamp. Shoot entirely from the protagonist’s first-person perspective. Only real hands and occasional forearms are visible. The live-action footage must feel accidentally captured on a smartphone: mild hand shake, delayed reframing, imperfect autofocus, visible low-light grain, auto-exposure breathing, rolling-shutter wobble during quick pans, uneven horizon, and natural motion blur. The camera is always slightly late, reacting to the animation rather than predicting it. Do not make the scene feel like a commercial, music video, or polished visual-effects demo. [Animated Character Identity] The main animated character originates from the laptop’s red low-battery icon. Its consistent identity markers are: a rounded rectangular battery-shaped body rough white hand-drawn outline red interior fill when tired two tiny black dot eyes one short charging-port tail a small sky-blue vacation cap a yellow lightning-bolt patch on its side Every transformation must preserve at least three clear identity markers: the white outline, sky-blue cap, yellow lightning patch, battery shape, or charging-port tail. All additional figures must be temporary doodles created by the battery character. Do not introduce unrelated characters. [0.0–3.0 seconds — The Battery Quits] First-person close-up of the real laptop on the desk. The protagonist’s right hand types slowly while the other hand rests near the mouse. The laptop screen displays a plain, generic work page with no readable text, no logos, and no recognizable interface branding. A small red low-battery icon blinks in the screen corner. The protagonist reaches for the charging cable, but before the cable connects, the icon turns toward the camera and shakes its body “no.” The red battery icon peels away from the screen like a rough paper sticker. Its edges curl visibly as it climbs over the real laptop bezel and drops onto the keyboard. During the fall, two tiny crayon legs redraw beneath it, followed by dot eyes, a sky-blue cap, and a yellow lightning patch. It lands on a real key, compresses flat like a paper accordion, springs back up, wipes imaginary sweat from its forehead, and pulls out a tiny hand-drawn cardboard sign reading only “BREAK.” The word exists physically on the sign and is not an overlay. The protagonist points at the charging cable in confusion. The battery pushes the cable plug away with both tiny hands, places its cap firmly on its head, and runs across the keyboard. Camera: initially static and tired, then a delayed handheld pan follows the battery after it has already begun running. Sound: real keyboard taps, laptop fan, cable brushing against the desk, tiny paper footfalls, one soft comedic spring squeak. Transition: the running battery leaps from the keyboard toward the notebook. [3.0–6.0 seconds — The Desk Becomes a Vacation Route] The battery lands on the protagonist’s real open notebook. At each footstep, quick turquoise crayon waves appear across the paper. The notebook page transforms only visually through hand-drawn overlays into a tiny seaside map while remaining physically real. The battery removes its sky-blue cap, flips it upside down, and the cap rapidly redraws into a miniature blue rowboat. The battery hops inside. Two yellow pencil-line oars grow from its sides. It rows across the notebook’s hand-drawn turquoise waves. Small white paper fish leap from one page fold to another. A real pencil lying across the notebook becomes a bridge through animated interaction only; it remains a real pencil. The battery boat passes beneath the pencil bridge, then reaches the notebook’s edge. The drawn water pours over the edge like a flat crayon waterfall without wetting the real desk. Mid-fall, the blue rowboat folds into a paper parachute. The battery dangles beneath it by two rough red marker strings and floats toward the ceramic mug. Camera: overhead handheld view of the notebook, then a slightly late tilt downward following the parachuting battery. Focus briefly hunts between the real pencil and the animated character. Sound: tiny pencil-scratch rowing, paper-water swishes, soft fish pops, page flutter, gentle parachute rustle. Transition: the battery swings around the mug handle and disappears behind the mug for a moment. [6.0–9.5 seconds — The Plant Recharging Spa] The protagonist quickly moves the camera around the mug. The battery swings from the real mug handle using one red marker string, releases, and lands inside the leaves of the real potted plant. The plant remains completely real. Hand-drawn lime-green veins begin glowing softly across only the leaf beneath the battery. The battery removes its cap, lies back comfortably on the leaf, and unfolds into a tiny battery-shaped deck chair while keeping its face and lightning patch. A hand-drawn yellow sunbeam squeezes through the real window blinds as a wobbly ribbon. It travels across the desk, climbs the plant stem, and connects gently to the battery’s charging-port tail. The battery’s red interior begins filling gradually from bottom to top: red → orange → yellow → bright green. As the charge increases, tiny colored-pencil flowers pop into existence around the plant pot. Each flower has a simple face and stretches toward the sunbeam. One flower offers the battery a tiny doodled drink made from a blue paint droplet with a bendy straw. The battery sits upright, takes one sip, and instantly overcharges for a comedic beat. Its body expands like a puffy paper balloon, its cap spins, and small yellow lightning doodles orbit its head. It exhales, settles back to normal size, and now glows healthy green. Camera: gentle push toward the plant, but with imperfect handheld micro-shakes and a small exposure adjustment as the window enters frame. Sound: real room ambience, curtain movement, leaf rustle, soft electrical hum, colored-pencil scribbles, liquid sip, tiny cheerful charging “bloop,” subtle paper balloon squeak. Transition: the fully charged battery spots the laptop across the room and snaps its cap back on. [9.5–12.5 seconds — The Ride Back to Work] The battery jumps from the plant. While falling, its body stretches horizontally and redraws into a tiny green hand-drawn scooter. The sky-blue cap becomes a small front windscreen, the charging-port tail becomes an exhaust pipe, and the yellow lightning patch remains on the side. The scooter lands on the real charging cable running across the desk. Two rough white wheels grip the cable as though it were a raised road. The battery character’s face appears on the scooter’s front panel. It races along the cable, leaning dramatically around the mug and pencils. Small yellow lightning-shaped road signs grow briefly from the desk surface, bend as the scooter passes, then erase themselves stroke by stroke. At the desk edge, the cable descends toward the real wall outlet. The scooter speeds down it like a roller coaster. The protagonist moves quickly to follow, bumping the rolling chair slightly. The camera dips, shakes, and briefly loses the battery behind the chair leg. The battery-scooter emerges from behind the chair, drives up the real charging plug, and launches toward the laptop in an exaggerated slow arc. Midair, the scooter folds inward through visibly redrawn lines, becoming the original green battery character again. Camera: delayed chase movement, quick pan, slight motion blur, momentary occlusion by the real chair, then a rough push back toward the laptop. Sound: tiny scooter motor buzz made from mouth-like doodle noises, cable vibration, miniature bell ring, chair wheel squeak, air whoosh, paper-folding flaps. Transition: the battery reaches the laptop screen and presses itself flat against it. [12.5–15.0 seconds — A Healthier Return] The battery character sticks to the laptop screen like a paper decal, then slowly sinks through the glass surface while waving at the protagonist. It returns to its original screen position as a fully green battery icon, but the sky-blue cap and tiny yellow lightning patch remain visible for one playful beat before tucking inside the icon. The protagonist moves their hand back toward the keyboard. Before typing resumes, the battery icon extends one thin white doodle arm from the screen and gently lowers the laptop lid halfway, refusing immediate overwork. A second white doodle arm emerges and points toward the real window. Rough colored-pencil lines rapidly sketch a small glowing sunset, two birds, and a cup of tea across the wall beside the desk. The protagonist pauses, removes both hands from the keyboard, picks up the real ceramic mug, and leans back. The battery icon gives a satisfied green blink. A tiny paper blanket unfolds inside the screen corner. It pulls the blanket over itself, places the sky-blue cap beneath its head as a pillow, and closes its eyes. The laptop screen dims naturally but does not shut off completely. The hand-drawn sunset lines remain softly glowing on the wall while the real curtain moves in the breeze. Final image: imperfect handheld framing of the quiet desk, half-closed laptop, warm mug in the protagonist’s hand, real plant beside it, and the tiny sleeping green battery visible through the dim screen. Camera: slow unplanned pull-back, slight tilt, natural focus shift from the sleeping icon to the plant and window. Deep black satin slip dress completely open down the front, thin straps slipped off both shoulders, deep cleavage fully exposed and fabric hanging by a thread, high slit pulled higher revealing garter clips and stocking tops. One hand holding a glass of champagne, the other casually holding the open dress closed at the waist as if deciding whether to let it fall. White walls, modern art, and dramatic spotlighting behind, ultra-detailed satin sheen, soft gallery lighting, photorealistic. H3: A sophisticated art gallery with soft warm museum lighting. A beautiful elegant red-haired woman wearing a flowing black evening dress stands directly in front of a large modern abstract painting while holding a champagne flute. She looks directly into the camera with a warm, confident, slightly flirtatious smile. She pauses naturally for a brief moment before gently tilting her head back and taking a graceful sip of her champagne. As she lowers the glass, she turns toward the painting behind her and calmly takes several elegant steps forward. Instead of colliding with the canvas, her body slowly melts seamlessly into the surface of the painting as though the artwork is absorbing her. The transition is magical, smooth, and dreamlike, with no visible portal or special effects—she simply becomes part of the artwork. By the final second, the gallery is empty except for the painting. Inside the painting is now a painted version of the woman, frozen in the exact pose she had after taking her sip, rendered in the identical brushwork, colors, and artistic style of the abstract painting. Only the upper portion of her body is visible because the bottom of the painting crops her below the knees, making it appear she has always belonged inside the artwork. Static camera throughout. No cuts. Smooth cinematic motion. Museum lighting remains consistent. Premium film quality. The transformation should feel subtle, elegant, and mysterious rather than flashy.

高い斜め上から濡れた黒石床へ寄り、上側に現実の閉じた扉、下側に開いた反射扉を同じ奥行き軸で保つ。反射の青い縁から一本の細い光線が床を走り、胸元の青い宝石の輪郭へ連続する。その円弧を境に細いタイルが非対称に組み替わり、宝石の近景、右手と柄の近景、鞘の青い象嵌を順に見せる。各タイルの縁は顔を横切らない。右手が柄へ触れた瞬間だけ黒革の小さな擦れ、銀鎖の短い硬質な触れ音、レースの微かな衣擦れを同期させる。刀は完全に鞘の中へ残す。 影ワイプの後、扉の縦辺を硬いマスクにして、少女の右斜め前、目線よりわずかに低い胸上近景へ戻る。カメラは短く静かに寄り、表情を、目が異常を認識する、眉がごくわずかに締まる、まぶたが静かに細くなる、口元が冷静な決意へ整う、視線が現実の閉じた扉へ上がる、の順で読ませる。無表情の人形顔、恐怖、パニックにせず、瞳の層と小さなキャッチライトを保つ。右手は柄を握るが抜刀せず、青い鞘の縁が一度だけ画面を横切る硬いラインマスクになる。 音楽は既存曲を模倣しない完全オリジナル。低いドローンと張り詰めた細いハイハットから始め、低いキック、断片的なウォーキングベース、短いバリトンサックスと切ったブラスへ冷静に展開する。終盤は緊張和音とドラム一打だけに絞り、その低い残響をタイトル保持へ残す。反射扉が開いて見える瞬間には透明な結晶エネルギーの短い共鳴、歩行には濡れた石床へ接するブーツの乾いた靴音、右手を柄に置く瞬間には黒革の軋み、銀鎖が一度だけ小さく鳴る音、布擦れをそれぞれ同期する。現実の木扉は動かないので開閉音を出さない。台詞、ナレーション、歌唱なし。 最終画は静かな余韻とモチーフ回帰。カメラは正面より少し左、目線の高さの胸上構図。少女を画面左へ置き、反対側の余白をタイトル専用にする。右手は柄に静止し、刀一本は左腰で完全に納刀、現実の扉は閉じたまま、床反射の扉だけが開いた青い奥行きで停止する。少女は閉じた扉の方向へ視線を固定し、呼吸と毛先とレースだけがごく小さく動く。右側へ正確に「MOONLIT BLUE BUTTERFLY」を一度だけ表示し、その下へ「COMING SOON」を一度だけ表示する。完成したタイトルプレートを固定して保持し、新しい人物、蝶、小物、文字を入れない。緊張和音とドラム一打の低い残響が完全に消える正確なフレームで黒へハードカットする。

items.prompt: 复制并生成视频 ↗ @haruuraeadss 当前浏览器不支持视频播放 ▶ 提示词 Create a 15-second cute, funny, educational creative animation video for kids ages 3 to 7. Concept: Teach the letter B using the word “Butterfly” with two major visual highlights: 1. a slow, satisfying, highly engaging transformation from the word “Butterfly” into a cute butterfly 2. a slow, magical transformation from the stylized animated world into a fully realistic natural scene with a realistic butterfly The video should feel beautiful, colorful, charming, educational, and visually mesmerizing. The transformations must not feel rushed. They should be the centerpiece of the video and should unfold clearly enough for children to enjoy and understand. Main learning message: “B is for Butterfly.” Visual style at the beginning: Use a premium kid-friendly animated style with soft pastel skies, rounded shapes, bright happy colors, smooth motion, clean composition, playful details, expressive design, and a light sense of humor. The early part should feel like a beautiful storybook mixed with polished modern animation. Animation priorities: The word-to-animal transformation must be gradual, elegant, readable, and creatively staged. Children should be able to see how the letters slowly become parts of the butterfly. The stylized-to-realistic transformation must also happen gradually and beautifully, as if the animated world is blooming into real life. Timing and scene flow: 0:00–0:02 Open on a soft dreamy pastel background with floating flowers, tiny sparkles, and gentle clouds. A large uppercase “B” appears in the center with a smaller lowercase “b” beside it. Both letters bounce softly into place with a cheerful and friendly feeling. The narrator says slowly and clearly: “B is for Butterfly.” Hold the letters long enough for recognition. 0:02–0:04 The word “BUTTERFLY” writes itself slowly across the screen in large rounded colorful letters. Each letter fills with a different beautiful pattern, such as gradients, dots, stripes, floral shapes, and soft wing-like textures. Keep the word fully readable and centered. Let the audience admire the full word before the transformation begins. 0:04–0:09 This is the main highlight. The word “BUTTERFLY” transforms slowly and satisfyingly into the butterfly. The transformation must be gradual, staged, and visually delicious to watch: The “B” gently opens outward and unfolds into the top wings. The “U” stretches and curves into one lower wing. The first “T” and second “T” slim down and merge into the butterfly’s long body. The “E” softens and reshapes into decorative wing markings. The “R” curls upward into one antenna. The “F” reshapes into the second antenna with a playful wobble. The “L” and “Y” arc outward and become the final wing edges and tail details. Important: Do not transform everything at once. Let each part morph one after another in a smooth chain reaction. The letters should bend, curl, unfurl, rotate, stretch, and softly glide into their new forms. The child should still sense the original word during the transformation. Use sparkling trails, flowing color transfer, and soft elastic motion to make it deeply satisfying. The morph should feel magical, clear, and creatively intelligent. 0:09–0:11 The butterfly is now a fully formed cute stylized cartoon butterfly. It has lovely colorful wings, a tiny smiling face, big friendly eyes, and soft funny charm. It flutters gently in a playful little loop, hovers above a flower, almost sneezes from pollen in a cute funny moment, then recovers and smiles. Show the word “Butterfly” below it briefly for reinforcement. The narrator repeats: “Butterfly.” 0:11–0:14 This is the second major highlight. The entire animated scene slowly transforms into a realistic world. The butterfly flaps its wings in slow motion. With each flap, realism increases gradually: its wing textures become more detailed the colors gain natural variation the body becomes more lifelike the flowers gain realistic petals and depth the background softens into a real sunlit garden the lighting becomes natural and golden the air gains subtle movement and realistic depth of field This transformation should feel breathtaking, seamless, and immersive. Do not cut abruptly from cartoon to realistic. Instead, let the animated world gently bloom into reality in layers. The viewer should feel they are witnessing imagination turn into nature. 0:14–0:15 End on a beautiful realistic butterfly resting on a real flower in warm sunlight. Display the text: “B is for Butterfly” The narrator says warmly: “B is for Butterfly.” The butterfly gently flutters once, then lifts off lightly. Style and quality requirements: Keep the letter B and the word “BUTTERFLY” clearly readable before and during transformation. Make the word-to-animal morph slow, rich, and visually rewarding. Make the stylized-to-realistic transformation equally slow, smooth, and magical. Use polished motion design, soft easing, beautiful color transitions, gentle humor, and strong visual clarity. Maintain a child-friendly tone throughout. Use clean typography, stable spelling, and seamless morphing. Audio direction: Use cheerful, soft, magical music. Add delicate sparkles, soft pops, flutter sounds, a tiny comedic sniffle or sneeze, and a gentle emotional swell during the realism transition. Voiceover should be warm, clear, slow, and easy for children to follow. Avoid: rushed transformations, unreadable letters, clutter, hard cuts, scary expressions, excessive camera motion, chaotic effects, or anything visually confusing for children.

items.prompt: 复制并生成视频 ↗ @strength04_x 当前浏览器不支持视频播放 ▶ 提示词 Create an approximately 15-second, 16:9 grounded street-racing action-film scene. All dialogue is spoken naturally in English. Late at night inside a private custom garage in an industrial area of Los Angeles, Roman and Tej sit shoulder to shoulder on the front bumper of a black high-performance muscle car. Each holds an ordinary paper coffee cup. Several heavily modified street-racing cars surround them. Their bodywork reflects cool blue work lights and warm tungsten fixtures. A hydraulic vehicle lift slowly descends in the background. Tools occasionally clink in the distance while an engine produces a steady, low idling rumble. The scene has the grounded texture of a street-racing action movie: dark metallic tones, a faint layer of garage haze, an oil-stained concrete floor, realistic automotive reflections, and restrained shoulder-mounted camerawork. The image should feel physical and substantial, not like a polished car commercial. Keep the camera at chest height and begin with a steady medium two-shot. Use only subtle human-operated movement and natural breathing in the frame. There are no chases, explosions, or exaggerated actions. The humor comes entirely from the serious performances, eye contact, and pauses. Roman turns toward Tej with a completely sincere and genuinely concerned expression. There is no irony in his performance, and he does not realize that the question might be funny. He treats it as a serious concern about the future of the entire team. ROMAN, speaking with complete sincerity: “Do you think AI is gonna replace us?” Tej slowly raises his eyes from his coffee cup. The camera makes an almost imperceptible push toward him. He pauses and looks directly into Roman’s eyes. Tej appears tired but composed, answering with extremely restrained deadpan delivery. TEJ: “Roman, AI can’t replace you. Nothing can replace you.” Roman slowly nods. His shoulders relax, and he is visibly relieved. He looks down and seriously processes the statement. He then looks back at Tej and carefully asks for confirmation. ROMAN: “Because I’m that good?” Tej stares at Roman without moving. Hold a long, quiet, uncomfortable pause. Do not use music or editing to emphasize the joke. During the silence, the idling engine in the background gives a small mechanical cough before returning to its steady rumble. Tej slowly looks down at his coffee as though searching for an escape from the conversation. He takes a small breath, then raises his eyes back to Roman. TEJ, with an extremely flat and exhausted delivery: “...Sure. Let’s go with that.” Roman nods with satisfaction, fully accepting the answer. Looking reassured, he takes a sip of coffee. The camera does not follow Roman. Instead, it slowly pushes closer to Tej’s face. After his final line, hold on Tej’s expressionless face for one full beat. He looks straight ahead, his eyes communicating exhaustion, resignation, and a brief reconsideration of every life choice that brought him here. Cut directly to black. Performance requirements: Roman remains completely earnest and serious throughout. He never smirks, winks, looks into the camera, or recognizes the joke. Tej’s humor comes only from restrained eye movement, flat vocal delivery, and precisely timed pauses. He never rolls his eyes, makes an exaggerated expression, or visibly performs the comedy. Audio requirements: All dialogue is delivered in natural, clear American English with accurate lip synchronization. Preserve the subtle rustle of the paper cups, the garage’s spatial reverb, distant tool sounds, and the low engine rumble. Maintain the specified pauses between lines. No background music, laugh track, narration, or subtitles. Continuity requirements: Roman and Tej remain seated in the same positions throughout. Each coffee cup stays in its owner’s hand, with realistic wrist movement, weight, inertia, and liquid behavior. Preserve the characters’ faces, body types, clothing, hairstyles, background vehicles, lighting direction, and camera axis. Negative prompt: exaggerated comedy acting, changing identities or faces, distorted fingers or coffee cups, rapid action editing, explosions or car chases, subtitles, text, logos, watermarks.

items.prompt: 复制并生成视频 ↗ @higana_yogana 当前浏览器不支持视频播放 ▶ 提示词 Prompts: [Core Concept] 15s, 160 BPM, 4/4, 40 beats. Industrial Hyperpop × Deconstructed Club: hard kicks, metallic snares, glitch hi-hats, distorted bass, sliced vocals. A timeline-based reality where rhythm controls space and motion. [Character Identity] Single androgynous dancer with short black hair, silver eyebrow mark, asymmetric black jacket, wide pants, red stitching. Maintain identical face, body, hairstyle and outfit. Multiple figures are only past-frame projections. [World Logic] Each kick compresses the timeline toward the dancer. Each snare duplicates previous movements into adjacent frames. Moving against the timeline transforms the 2D interface into a foldable 3D structure. The dancer escapes the repetition loop. [Visual Language] Black, cold white, warning red. Glass timelines, metal rails, glowing frame lines, scanning grids. Extreme wide-angle, low angles, top-down shots, Dutch angles, dolly moves, impossible perspective. 3D words COPY, SAME, TREND, OUTSIDE exist as physical architecture, not subtitles. [Motion Rules] Use anticipation → attack → overshoot → settle. Kick drives spatial compression, snare breaks frames, hi-hats animate cursors and fragments, bass bends time. Build with glitch cuts, then explode into an impossible continuous long take during the drop. [Restrictions] No character changes, extra people, random text, subtitles, logos, outfit changes, bad anatomy, flat camera angles, or meaningless flashes.

[0–2 seconds] Display the complete skateboard selection interface from the front. NOVA is in the selected and active state, the four ports at the bottom emit green light. HOTDOG and SHARK are in the unselected state, completely stationary. [2–4 seconds] The player presses the right selection key. SHARK ROCKET RIDER slides from the right preview slot into the middle selected module, NOVA JET GLIDER simultaneously slides from the middle into the left preview slot, HOTDOG DASH moves to the right preview slot. As soon as NOVA leaves the middle selected module, the green light immediately turns off and stops. After SHARK enters the middle, orange flames appear at the tail. The skateboard name, attribute bars, and SELECTED label update synchronously. [4–6.5 seconds] The player switches the selection again. HOTDOG DASH moves horizontally from the side preview slot to the middle selected module, SHARK ROCKET RIDER simultaneously slides into the other side slot, NOVA moves to the remaining side slot. As soon as SHARK loses the selected state, the orange flame immediately turns off. After HOTDOG becomes the selected item, facing the camera, it barks twice accurately, then turns around in place once. [6.5–8 seconds] The bottom CONFIRM button is clicked by the player. The button compresses downwards and bounces back, the right arrow extends forward. HOTDOG DASH becomes the final confirmed selection. The two unselected skateboards on the left and right continue to stay in the fixed preview slots, completely stationary. [8–10 seconds] The middle fixed selected module expands towards the depth of the screen. The light-colored display area inside the central card naturally transforms into the World Plaza. The complete world has been fully loaded, with no texture popping, placeholder models, or unfinished buildings. At the same time, the UI displays as the in-game HUD. [10–12 seconds] The camera enters the third-person game perspective, with HOTDOG DASH located under the protagonist’s feet. During normal gliding and preparation actions, both feet of the protagonist are standing on HOTDOG DASH. The game HUD appears at this time: mini-map in the top right corner, speed and health status in the bottom left corner, action and combo slots in the bottom right corner, mission route markers and interactive prompts appear ahead. [12–15 seconds] The protagonist enters the world riding the running HOTDOG DASH, passing pedestrians, stairs, slopes, railings, and multiple explorable routes. HOTDOG jumps before a low slope, completes a rotation action in the air, and upon landing, the protagonist’s feet are still standing on HOTDOG DASH, the combo count and TRICK prompt briefly increase in the HUD. Subsequently, lean to bypass street obstacles, then perform a small directional jump, and then continue sliding forward. Sound Design: Use pure instrumental music mixed with electronic arcade sounds, no vocals. UI switching corresponds to crisp key press sounds, card slot sliding sounds, sticker slapping sounds, and attribute bar update sounds. When SHARK is selected, ignition and propulsion sounds appear, and stop immediately when losing selection. When HOTDOG is selected, two barks are played accurately, and light footsteps are added when spinning around. After entering the world, add city ambient sounds, wind sounds, running footsteps, shoe friction sounds when pedaling to accelerate, and jump and landing feedback sounds.

items.prompt: 复制并生成视频 ↗ @karankendre 当前浏览器不支持视频播放 ▶ 提示词 [FORMAT] Create a 15-second, 16:9 live-action and hand-drawn doodle composite. First-person smartphone footage in one continuous handheld take, set in a rain-wet Busan harbor alley at blue hour. The real world remains fully photoreal; only the drawings are animated. [ASSETS] No external assets. [IDENTITY] Preserve throughout: the photoreal right hand, dark navy rain sleeve, paint-stained fingertips, small cream pocket sketchbook, short cobalt wax pencil, thin wrist cord, natural hand anatomy, and consistent wet reflections. The doodles use imperfect cobalt-blue pencil lines, variable pressure, doubled contours, open gaps, loose hatching, subtle line boil, and flat transparent color. They must look freshly drawn by hand, never like polished digital stickers. [BEATS] [0–3 seconds] Close POV while walking. The hand draws a tiny sailboat inside the damp sketchbook. Show every stroke forming in real time: hesitant curves, overlapping corrections, graphite crumbs, and pressure changes. The finished boat wiggles, climbs over the page edge, and slides toward the ground. [3–6 seconds] The camera dips quickly. The doodle boat lands in a shallow stream beside the curb, creating a real circular ripple. Scene 1 (0–3s): Deep inside an ancient bamboo forest, a fearless Panda Ninja in a black ninja robe with a red waist sash slowly unsheathes a razor-sharp katana. Across the forest, the legendary Monkey King lands on a swaying bamboo stalk, spinning his golden staff with incredible speed. Close-up shots of determined eyes, leaves drifting through the air, intense silence before the battle. Scene 2 (3–6s): Both warriors launch simultaneously, performing impossible high-speed jumps across bending bamboo trees. The camera follows from below as they sprint, flip, and ricochet from one bamboo stalk to another before colliding mid-air. Katana and golden staff crash together, creating bright sparks and a powerful shockwave. Scene 3 (6–10s): A breathtaking martial arts battle unfolds across the bamboo canopy. The Monkey King attacks with lightning-fast spinning staff combinations while the Panda Ninja counters with elegant katana techniques, dodges, wall-runs, aerial flips, and rapid sword slashes. Fast cinematic camera movements, slow-motion impact moments, and dynamic close-ups emphasize every strike. Scene 4 (10–13s): The fight reaches a gigantic waterfall. Both warriors leap through the mist, running across wet rocks above the roaring water. They exchange one final series of attacks as water splashes dramatically around them. Scene 5 (13–15s):In epic slow motion, the Panda Ninja delivers a perfectly timed finishing katana strike while the Monkey King blocks with his golden staff. A massive burst of sparks and flying bamboo leaves fills the screen. Both land on opposite cliffs overlooking the waterfall, silently staring at each other with respect as the camera slowly pulls back to reveal the breathtaking bamboo valley. Cinematic ending, legendary warrior atmosphere.

制作方針｜途中の短い日本語タイポグラフィはすべて映像内へ直接表示する。屋台名、商品名、店名、説明看板などの不規則な文字は一切生成しない。タイポグラフィは字幕ではなく、厚紙、和紙、半透明紙、蛇腹紙を使った立体的な紙オブジェとして空間内に存在させる。 主人公設定｜成人の日本人女性。20代後半〜30代前半に見える、上品で自然な美しさ。白地に藍色と薄水色の朝顔・流水模様をあしらった浴衣。帯は深い藍色、差し色に淡い赤または金色を少量。髪は柔らかなまとめ髪で、控えめな花の髪飾り。小さな巾着を持つ。全カットで顔、髪型、浴衣、帯、体型を完全に維持する。過度な色気を避け、透明感、期待感、懐かしさを表情で見せる。 空間設定｜開始時は床、背景、天井の境界が曖昧な広大なオフホワイトの紙空間。現実の道路、建物、屋台、神社、商店街は存在しない。祭りを構成するすべての要素は、床の切れ込み、折り目、紙の層からポップアップ式に立ち上がる。前景・中景・背景の距離を大きく取り、紙の厚み、断面、折り目、カール、重なり、吊り糸、落ち影を明確に見せる。 紙素材｜上質な厚紙、和紙、半透明紙、蛇腹紙、折り紙、紙テープ。紙の端、断面、折り目、切り込み、貼り合わせ部分を見せる。しわくちゃ、古紙、汚れた紙にはしない。清潔で精密な現代ペーパーアート。 色設計｜序盤はオフホワイト、藍色、淡い水色を中心に抑える。中盤から提灯の朱赤、レモンイエロー、朝顔の青紫、水風船のシアン、金魚の赤を追加。終盤は群青の夜空、暖色の提灯、赤・黄・青・白の紙花火を組み合わせる。 正面寄りの広角中景、滑らかな後退トラッキング。女子高生が夕暮れの道を軽快に歩き、0.00秒からカメラへリップシンク「画/面/が/光/る そ/の/瞬/間/に」。胸元で持ったスマートフォンの画面が点灯し、青白い光が顔と紺色の長い髪を下から柔らかく照らす。0.00秒、画面下部の人物と重ならない位置へ、歌詞「画面が光る その瞬間に」を一続きの正確な文字列として薄い青白色で表示する。歌唱開始と同時に一本の走査光が文字列の左端から右端へ滑らかに進み、発音中の文字だけを順番に明るく発光させる。「画面が光る」から「その瞬間に」まで文字を分割、消去、再生成せず、同じ一続きのモーションを維持する。1.56秒の「その」では走査光がそのまま後半へ進み、「瞬間」で光量が一度だけ強くなる。彼女はスマートフォンからカメラへ視線を上げる。3.16秒、走査光が最後の「に」へ到達した瞬間、全文が青いピクセルへ変化して画面右へ流れる [cut] 3.16-6.08s: 横からの側角中景。最初の0.08秒は短い息継ぎ。3.24秒から口元が見える斜め横顔でリップシンク「私/の/名/前/が 生/ま/れ/た/の」。前カットの青いピクセルが画面右側へ集まり、3.24秒に歌詞「私の名前が」を正確に再構築する。「名前」の部分だけ淡いピンク色の輪郭光が走る。スマートフォンから細いデジタル光が立ち上がり、彼女の周囲を一周して抽象的な光の紋章へ変化する。実際の人名は表示しない。4.82秒、「私の名前が」が中央から外側へ開いて消え、同じ位置に歌詞「生まれたの」が正確に出現する。彼女が胸へ手を添えると、胸元の光と「生まれたの」が同期して一度だけ鼓動のように緩やかに拡大する。文字色は青白色から柔らかなピンク色へ変化する。6.08秒、文字が小さな光粒となって足元へ落ちる。カメラは側面から緩やかに正面へ回り込む [cut] 6.08-6.46s: 無歌唱の短い転換。歌詞文字は表示しない。全身の全景へ素早く引き、足元へ落ちた文字の光粒からピンク色のデジタル花びらが一斉に発生する。花びらの上昇方向に合わせてカメラを軽くティルトアップ [cut] 6.46-8.12s: 正面の腰上中景、後退トラッキングを再開。女子高生が歩き続け、明るい表情でリップシンク「バ/ー/チ/ャ/ル/な/花/び/ら」。6.46秒、画面下部の緩やかな弧に沿って歌詞「バーチャルな花びら」をピンク色で正確に表示する。文字の輪郭から小さなデジタル花びらが少しずつ剥がれ、桜のように周囲を舞う。花びらの反射が頬と髪に小さな光を走らせる。歌詞と花びらは口元と両目を遮らず、画面下部と被写体の奥を中心に配置する。8.12秒、歌詞がピンク色の花びらへ完全に変化する [cut] 8.12-9.54s: 全身の全景、中心構図。8.12-8.32秒の無歌唱部分で女子高生が一歩踏み込み、ターンを開始。8.32秒からカメラを捉え続けながらリップシンク「ま/い/お/ど/り」。同時に、旋回する花びらの中心から歌詞「まいおどり」を正確に表示する。文字は読みやすい水平状態を維持し、その周囲だけを花びらが半円状に旋回する。身体は軽やかに回転し、スカートと紺色の長い髪が慣性で美しい弧を描く。カメラが反対方向へ短く旋回し、回転中も顔を斜め正面に保つ。「おどり」で文字の外縁が花びらへ変わり、9.54秒に文字全体が大きな一枚の花びらへ変形してレンズ方向へ飛ぶ [cut] 9.54-9.82s: 無歌唱の転換。歌詞文字は表示しない。大きなピンク色の花びらがレンズの直前を横切って画面を一瞬覆い、その遮蔽を利用して極低角度の構図へ切り替える [cut] 9.82-12.64s: 低角度の腰上中景。女子高生が夕暮れ空へ片手を伸ばし、顔と口元をカメラへ向けたままリップシンク「新/し/い/世/界/が 始/ま/る/よ」。9.82秒、人物の頭上へ歌詞「新しい世界が」を青白く正確に表示する。文字間隔が中央から左右へ徐々に広がり、閉じていた扉が開くように動く。指先から青白い光粒が放たれ、空へ溶け込みながらピンクと青の光の門を形成する。11.40秒、「新しい世界が」が左右へ開いて光の門へ吸収され、同じ位置から歌詞「始まるよ」が正確に手前へ現れる。「始まる」で文字色が青白色から虹色へ変化し、「よ」で文字が最も明るく発光する。虹色の光が背面リムライトとなり、髪と制服の輪郭を輝かせる。カメラは手元から顔へゆっくりラックフォーカスし、希望に満ちた笑顔を捉える [cut] 12.64-13.00s: 歌唱後の余韻。「始まるよ」の文字が読み取れる形を失い、細長い虹色の光の帯へ変形する。指先の光粒と合流した帯がレンズ前を横切り、画面全体を一瞬満たす。次の“コメントの帯”へ形状マッチできる一本の光だけを残し、暗転気味に終了する。 全編を通して人物の顔、紺色の長い髪、藏青の制服、スマートフォンの形状を維持する。リリックモーションは画面に固定し、カメラ移動による歪み、反転、ちらつき、文字の増殖を発生させない。歌唱中の口元の遮蔽、余分な人物、衣装変更、過度なモーションブラーを避ける。指定された歌詞以外の文字、実在する企業ロゴ、企業名、商品名、アプリマークを入れない。

[cut] 9.54-9.82s: 無歌唱の転換。歌詞文字は表示しない。大きなピンク色の花びらがレンズの直前を横切って画面を一瞬覆い、その遮蔽を利用して極低角度の構図へ切り替える [cut] 9.82-12.64s: 低角度の腰上中景。女子高生が夕暮れ空へ片手を伸ばし、顔と口元をカメラへ向けたままリップシンク「新/し/い/世/界/が 始/ま/る/よ」。9.82秒、人物の頭上へ歌詞「新しい世界が」を青白く正確に表示する。文字間隔が中央から左右へ徐々に広がり、閉じていた扉が開くように動く。指先から青白い光粒が放たれ、空へ溶け込みながらピンクと青の光の門を形成する。11.40秒、「新しい世界が」が左右へ開いて光の門へ吸収され、同じ位置から歌詞「始まるよ」が正確に手前へ現れる。「始まる」で文字色が青白色から虹色へ変化し、「よ」で文字が最も明るく発光する。虹色の光が背面リムライトとなり、髪と制服の輪郭を輝かせる。カメラは手元から顔へゆっくりラックフォーカスし、希望に満ちた笑顔を捉える [cut] 12.64-13.00s: 歌唱後の余韻。「始まるよ」の文字が読み取れる形を失い、細長い虹色の光の帯へ変形する。指先の光粒と合流した帯がレンズ前を横切り、画面全体を一瞬満たす。次の“コメントの帯”へ形状マッチできる一本の光だけを残し、暗転気味に終了する。 全編を通して人物の顔、紺色の長い髪、藏青の制服、スマートフォンの形状を維持する。リリックモーションは画面に固定し、カメラ移動による歪み、反転、ちらつき、文字の増殖を発生させない。歌唱中の口元の遮蔽、余分な人物、衣装変更、過度なモーションブラーを避ける。指定された歌詞以外の文字、実在する企業ロゴ、企業名、商品名、アプリマークを入れない。

items.prompt: 复制并生成视频 ↗ @liyue_ai 当前浏览器不支持视频播放 ▶ 提示词 Create a 15-second cinematic text-animation video built around the quote: “Every great change begins quietly, grows through courage, and becomes impossible to ignore.” The quote should appear gradually as a visual story. Each new phrase must transform the design, atmosphere, movement, and emotional intensity of the scene. Use elegant typography, accurate spelling, cinematic lighting, smooth transitions, and perfectly readable text. 0:00–0:03 | “Every great change” Begin with a completely black screen. A tiny point of warm light slowly appears in the center, like the first spark of an idea. The words “Every great change” emerge softly from the darkness, one word at a time. Use thin, elegant serif typography with wide letter spacing. “Every” fades in gently. “Great” grows slightly larger. “Change” forms from small drifting particles that gather into solid letters. Keep the scene quiet, minimal, and mysterious. 0:03–0:06 | “begins quietly,” The camera slowly moves closer to the text. The previous words shrink and reposition toward the upper-left corner as the phrase “begins quietly,” appears in delicate lowercase letters. Animate the phrase as though it is being written by an invisible hand. Each letter should create a subtle ripple in the darkness. Introduce faint textures, soft shadows, floating dust, and gentle light rays. The comma should appear last and create a small circular pulse. 0:06–0:09 | “grows through courage,” The pulse expands and transforms the scene from darkness into a rich sunrise gradient with deep orange, red, and golden tones. The words “grows through courage” rise upward from the bottom of the frame. Animate “grows” by gradually increasing its size and weight. Animate “through” along a curved path. Animate “courage” in bold uppercase letters that push through a translucent barrier, causing it to crack into geometric fragments. The movement should feel powerful but controlled. 0:09–0:12 | “and becomes” The fragments rotate in slow motion and reorganize into a clean editorial grid. The phrase “AND BECOMES” appears across the frame in condensed sans-serif typography. Animate the letters with fast tracking changes, vertical stretching, masking, and perspective movement. The camera accelerates forward through the center of the word “BECOMES.” The sound and visual energy should steadily build. 0:12–0:14 | “impossible to ignore.” Reveal a vast bright space filled with light, moving shapes, and large-scale typography. The words “IMPOSSIBLE TO IGNORE” appear one after another. “IMPOSSIBLE” expands beyond the edges of the screen. “TO” remains small and perfectly centered. “IGNORE” slams into place with strong visual impact, briefly shaking the surrounding grid and shapes. Use bold contrast, dramatic scale, sharp shadows, and synchronized motion. 0:14–0:15 | Final quote All movement stops instantly. The complete quote appears centered on a clean off-white background: “Every great change begins quietly, grows through courage, and becomes impossible to ignore.” Use refined black typography with “change,” “courage,” and “impossible” highlighted in deep red. Hold the final composition clearly for the last second. Maintain one continuous visual journey from darkness to light, silence to impact, and simplicity to complexity. Keep every phrase connected through visual transformations rather than hard cuts. Use realistic motion blur, precise kerning, clean masks, stable letterforms, smooth camera movement, subtle film grain, cinematic sound design, rising ambient music, soft particles, controlled color transitions, and a final deep impact sound. Avoid misspelled words, warped letters, duplicated characters, unreadable text, random symbols, excessive flickering, chaotic layouts, inconsistent fonts.

items.prompt: 复制并生成视频 ↗ @eggmaya_ai 当前浏览器不支持视频播放 ▶ 提示词 Cinematic anamorphic 21:9 LIGHT: KAISER — DIGITAL TRANSPORT · 15s · 24fps · 2.35:1 SUBJECT: young man, dark t-shirt, black face mask, seated at a desk, hands on keyboard. He is the only living thing in frame at any point. PALETTE: near-black base. Teal-cyan is structure — panel frames, glass edges, wireframe. Spring green is data — panel content, text. Amber is alert — status lines only, sparingly. Ultraviolet is connection — leader lines only. Maximum two accents in frame at once. LIGHT: screens are the only source after 2.5s. Face lit from below, shadow climbing upward under the brow. Soft teal rim on the left shoulder, dying at the deltoid. No fill. Nothing bounces. FOCUS: mid-plane panels stay sharp. The face stays slightly soft. Background bokeh stays fully soft. No rack, no refocus, ever. GRADE: crushed blacks, cool blue shadows, desaturated cooled skin. Green panel content blooms with soft halation. DEPTH LAW: panels are anchored in the room, not to the lens. Near panels sweep faster than far panels. Left-edge panels exit frame. Rear panels barely shift. MOTION LAW: panels blur only while in transit and are razor sharp when they settle. Nothing is blurred while at rest. GLITCH LAW: two-frame tearing occurs on panel interface content only. The face, hands, mask and bokeh never tear, never displace. PHASE 1 — REAL · slow 01 · 0.000 · Wide. Dark room, one desk lamp. He sits, hands on keys. No holograms. Camera static. He presses one key. 02 · 1.500 · Macro. The keycap bottoms out. A thin teal line crawls out from under it across the desk surface. PHASE 2 — TRANSPORT · one unbroken shot, no cut 03 · 2.500 · Camera pushes in slowly on his back, unbroken. The teal line reaches the walls. Room surfaces resolve into wireframe — desk edges, wall corners, doorframe — then the solid material falls away and the wireframe holds in void. The lamp is the last thing to go. He does not move. The room leaves; he stays. Holographic panels ignite around him in sequence, near ones first, far ones rippling outward into darkness. Each arrives sharp and holds. PHASE 3 — REVEAL · slow 04 · 5.000 · Slow orbit right around him. He turns his head, looking up and across at panels stacked in depth. Near panels sweep past the lens fast, far panels barely shift. Screen glow climbing his face. 05 · 6.800 · His POV. Panels in every direction, above and below, receding into black. Camera drifts, slight handheld weight. Nothing cuts. Nothing glitches yet. PHASE 4 — THE HACK · rapid, cut on the beat 06 · 8.000 · Hands slam onto keys. Cut on the impact. 07 · 8.400 · Macro. A panel status block flips green to amber. 08 · 8.800 · Wide. Six panels tear for two frames, content scrambling, frames intact. 09 · 9.200 · Macro. His eye, screen light across it. Sharp. 10 · 9.600 · Panels multiply outward in a wave, near to far. 11 · 10.000 · Camera pushes straight through a panel, glass smearing past the lens. 12 · 10.400 · Ultraviolet leader lines shoot between panels, connecting them into a lattice. 13 · 10.800 · Whip pan left. Panels streak into pure light. 14 · 11.200 · Macro. Fingers, individual strokes, no arm sway. 15 · 11.600 · The lattice pulls in toward one central panel, everything else dimming. 16 · 12.000 · Two frames of hard tearing across every panel at once. Face untouched. 17 · 12.400 · Total stillness. Panels frozen. No drift, no glow change. One second of absolute silence in the image. PHASE 5 — LOCK · one long hold 18 · 13.000 · Panels snap inward and lock into a single wall of light in front of him. A shockwave ripples outward through every glass surface. Camera recoils, then locks. He is centred, motionless. One amber line reads across the central panel. Everything else holds still. Hold to black. NEGATIVE: no other people, no crowd, no desk clutter, no plants, no cables, no lifestyle context. No captions, subtitles, watermarks, logos. No smoke, mist, dust, particles, lens flare, rain. No warm key light, no orange grade, no lifted blacks. No focus pull to the face. No head turn outside shot 04. No glitching on face, hands or mask. No camera roll. No colour outside teal, green, amber, ultraviolet.
